items.title: CVE-2026-76466: Cisco TelePresence Video Communication Server (VCS) Expressway remote code execution as root in database service (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. A flaw in the database service of Cisco Expressway Series (the Expressway-C and Expressway-E devices) lets an attacker run operating system commands as root on the underlying system. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-123890: VMware vCenter authentication bypass in directory service (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. An authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service affects VMware vCenter, as well as VMware Telco Cloud Platform and Telco Cloud Infrastructure. An attacker can exploit it remotely, without logging in, to skip authentication, which could give them full control over the affected systems.

items.title: CVE-2026-49869: Kestra code execution via auth bypass in AuthenticationFilter (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Kestra, an open-source orchestration platform, has an authentication bypass that lets an attacker create and run arbitrary workflows, giving them remote code execution as root inside the Kestra worker container. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and because the bug is listed in CISA's catalog of known exploited vulnerabilities, attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2024-10441: Synology DiskStation Manager remote code execution in system plugin daemon (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) and BeeStation OS (BSM) have a flaw in the system plugin daemon, caused by improper encoding or escaping of output, that lets an attacker run arbitrary code. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in, and the bug is listed as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-90817: Vanderbilt University REDCap remote code execution in survey routing (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. REDCap, from Vanderbilt University, has a flaw in its survey routing and data import handling that lets an attacker run their own code on the server by sending crafted web requests, remotely and without logging in, as long as they know a valid public survey hash. This bug is listed by CISA as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-40217: LiteLLM remote code execution via guardrails test endpoint (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. LiteLLM from BerriAI has a flaw that lets an attacker run arbitrary code on the server by abusing bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code endpoint. It can be reached remotely over the network with only a low-privilege login, and it is listed by CISA as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-119618: Apache HTTP Server remote code execution in mod_http2 via race condition (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 module has a race condition in its assign_headers() routine that can corrupt heap memory. A remote attacker who can reach the server without logging in can exploit it to run arbitrary commands on the server, take control of the server process, and access or modify sensitive information. Public exploit code exists for this flaw.

items.title: CVE-2022-4140: Welcart e-Commerce unauthenticated arbitrary file read in file output handler (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Welcart e-Commerce WordPress plugin does not validate user input before using it to output a file's contents, which lets an unauthenticated attacker read arbitrary files on the server. The flaw can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available.

items.title: CVE-2024-5806: Progress MOVEit Transfer authentication bypass in SFTP module (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. A flaw in the SFTP module of Progress MOVEit Transfer lets an attacker bypass authentication. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in or any user action, and public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2016-8869: Privilege escalation via user registration (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. The Users component in Joomla! has a flaw in its registration code that lets remote attackers gain privileges by misusing unfiltered data submitted when registering on a site. Attackers can reach it over the network without logging in or any user action, and public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-126714: PHP remote code execution via partially written session files (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. PHP's default file-based session handler can leave a session file with a mix of new and old data if a write is interrupted, so an attacker who can influence session data may inject objects and, if the application contains a suitable gadget chain, run code on the server. The attacker can reach this remotely without logging in, though the attack depends on interrupting a write at the right moment.

items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A use-after-free flaw in PHP, from the PHP Group, can let an attacker corrupt memory, crash the PHP worker or, in some cases, run arbitrary code. It can be reached remotely without logging in, by sending enough request data to influence memory allocation while a fatal error such as exceeding the memory limit occurs during a magic method call, when argument collection for backtraces is left on (...

items.title: CVE-2026-129496: PHP remote code execution in timezone cache (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A use-after-free bug in the timezone cache of PHP (from the PHP Group), in non-thread-safe builds where a startup warning is written to a file-based error log, lets an attacker crash PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php or CGI workers. Arbitrary code execution may also be possible. The attacker can reach it remotely, without logging in, by sending a crafted request.

items.title: CVE-2026-114952: MySQL authentication bypass in client programs (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the client programs component of Oracle's MySQL Server and MySQL Cluster lets an attacker read, change, create, or delete critical data that these products can access. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and no action from a user is needed.

items.title: CVE-2025-24983: Microsoft privilege escalation in Win32 kernel subsystem (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The Windows Win32 Kernel Subsystem, a core component of Microsoft Windows, contains a flaw that lets a user with local access gain higher privileges on the affected system. An attacker who already has some authorized access to the machine could exploit this to take greater control than they are permitted.

items.title: CVE-2025-57819: endpoint remote code execution via SQL injection in admin panel (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Attackers are exploiting a flaw in the FreePBX endpoint module, which lets anyone reach the FreePBX Administrator over the network without logging in. From there they can change the database at will and run code remotely, potentially with root-level access.

items.title: CVE-2026-115731: Perforce Puppet Enterprise remote code execution in report deserialization (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Puppet Server's report-processing code is affected by a deserialization flaw that lets a client holding a CA-signed agent certificate run arbitrary code on the server as its service user. If the certificate authority autosigns requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker could obtain such a certificate and exploit this.

The $currenturl variable in news-details.php is constructed using unencoded REQUEST_URI and HTTP_HOST server variables and echoed directly into the href attributes of social share links. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this by crafting a URL containing HTML metacharacters to break out of the href attribute and execute arbitrary HTML or JavaScript in the context of the victim's browser.

items.title: CVE-2026-126822
items.summary: Description: When BIG-IP APM is provisioned, an Access Profile is configured as a SAML SP (Service Provider) and is applied to a virtual server, undisclosed requests can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate. Impact: Traffic is disrupted while the TMM process restarts. This vulnerability allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the BIG-IP system. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

items.title: CVE-2026-109857
items.summary: CAST Imaging is vulnerable to authentication bypass in the TenantFilter class. The TenantFilter processes the X-ISSUER-LOCATION HTTP header and dynamically registers an OpenID Connect issuer based on its value. An unauthenticated remote attacker can register a malicious identity provider, create users matching existing administrative usernames, and obtain valid JWTs which will be accepted by the application. This results in complete authentication bypass and privilege escalation to administrative access. The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versi…

items.title: CVE-2026-130695
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows holders of revoked OAuth access tokens to authenticate as first-party sessions by presenting them through the session header. Attackers can bypass revocation, client-existence, route allowlist and granted_resources scope checks to modify victim profiles, upload to storage, and force global sign-outs.

items.title: CVE-2026-130730
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows OAuth token holders to act as full sessions because OAuth access tokens are signed with the instance JWT secret. Attackers can present a narrowly scoped OAuth token to the session strategy, short-lived-token exchange, or NocoSocket handshake to gain the granting user's full privileges.

items.title: Buffer overflow in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder enables unauthenticated RCE
items.summary: CVE-2026-114938, which the researcher Calif is calling Java4Shell, is a buffer overflow in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder. The optimized decoder miscalculates the store mask for the padded tail of its input and writes past the end of the output buffer. The bug lives in the JIT-compiled fast path behind java.util.Base64.Decoder , so any application that decodes attacker-controlled Base64 can reach it. Login headers and file uploads are the obvious entry points. items.title: CVE-2024-0264: SourceCodester Clinic Queuing System authorization bypass in LoginRegistration.php formToken (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the SourceCodester Clinic Queuing System lets an attacker bypass authorization through the formToken argument of its LoginRegistration.php file. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, and public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-113425: F5 NGINX Plus memory corruption in mail proxy module (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source, when configured as a mail proxy, contain a use-after-free bug that a remote attacker can trigger over the network without logging in. Successful exploitation may crash an nginx worker process or corrupt its memory, disrupting service, and remote code execution is a potential impact.

items.title: CVE-2026-123634: F5 NGINX Plus remote code execution in resolver via use-after-free (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source are affected when configured as a proxy with variables in the proxied server name and an SSI or mirror directive that sends a subrequest to a location resolving that same name. A remote attacker, without logging in, can send a specially crafted HTTP request to crash a worker process, corrupt its memory, or potentially execute code.

items.title: CVE-2026-12507: Zoho remote code execution via SQL injection in Reports module (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Zohocorp AssetExplorer, ServiceDesk Plus, ServiceDesk Plus MSP, and SupportCenter Plus contain a flaw in the Reports module that lets an attacker run arbitrary commands on the underlying server. The attacker reaches it over the network with a high-privilege login, specifically an account that has the Create Query Reports permission, by sending specially crafted database queries.

items.title: CVE-2026-114938: Oracle Java SE remote takeover via heap overflow in compiler (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, and Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition contain a flaw in the Compiler component. A remote attacker with no credentials can reach it over the network by supplying crafted data to an API, such as through a web service; the attacker can overwrite heap memory, read it to leak sensitive data, and potentially achieve remote code execution, though the flaw is har...

items.title: CVE-2026-115560: PHP remote code execution in session serializer
items.summary: PHP has a flaw where session upload progress data, when enabled, can be read back with a mismatched session serializer, letting an attacker inject objects into the application. A remote attacker who can submit a multipart upload, without logging in, could use this to run code if the application contains a suitable gadget chain, or to corrupt sessions or cause a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-130929: Google Chrome remote code execution in Chromoting (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A use-after-free flaw in Chromoting in Google Chrome lets an attacker run arbitrary code outside the browser's sandbox. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network by sending crafted network traffic, without logging in or any action from the user.

items.title: CVE-2026-130963: Google Chrome remote code execution in WebView (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Google Chrome on Android has a use-after-free flaw in its WebView component. A remote attacker can send crafted network traffic to run arbitrary code outside the sandbox.

items.title: CVE-2026-131020: Google Chrome remote code execution in WebView on Android (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A use-after-free flaw in WebView in Google Chrome on Android lets an attacker run arbitrary code outside the browser's sandbox. The attacker can reach it remotely by sending crafted network traffic, without logging in or any action from the user.

items.title: CVE-2026-131037: Google Chrome remote code execution in Chromoting (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A flaw in the Chromoting component of Google Chrome may allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox by sending crafted network traffic. Versions of Chrome released before the fix are affected.

items.title: CVE-2021-4473: Tianxin Internet Behavior Management System unauthenticated command injection in Reporter endpoint (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Tianxin Internet Behavior Management System from Beijing Topsec Network Security Technology Co., Ltd. has a command injection flaw in its Reporter component endpoint. A remote attacker without logging in can run arbitrary commands by sending a crafted objClass parameter, which lets them write malicious PHP files into the web root and gain remote code execution with the web server's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2025-40553: SolarWinds Web Help Desk remote code execution through deserialization (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a deserialization flaw that lets an attacker run commands on the host machine. The attack can be launched remotely over the network without logging in.

items.title: CVE-2020-4450: IBM WebSphere Application Server remote code execution via deserialization (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. IBM WebSphere Application Server versions 8.5 and 9.0 traditional are affected. A remote attacker can run arbitrary code on the system by sending a specially crafted sequence of serialized objects, and can do so without logging in.

items.title: CVE-2016-0638: Oracle Fusion Middleware unauthenticated remote compromise in WebLogic Server JMS (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. An unspecified flaw in the Oracle WebLogic Server component of Oracle Fusion Middleware, related to Java Messaging Service, lets remote attackers affect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system. The flaw can be reached remotely, without logging in and without any action from a user.

items.title: ZDI-26-1039: Oracle PeopleSoft register Incorrect Authorization Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
items.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Oracle PeopleSoft. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 9.9. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-35273.

items.title: CVE-2024-21410: Microsoft Exchange privilege escalation in mail server (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Microsoft Exchange Server, the email and collaboration software used by organizations, is affected by this vulnerability. An attacker who can access the server could potentially gain higher privileges than they are authorized to have, allowing them to perform actions reserved for administrators.

items.title: CVE-2019-19006: Authentication bypass in admin web interface (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Sangoma FreePBX has an access control flaw that lets an attacker bypass authentication on the admin web interface, which could lead to rogue admin accounts, exposure of extension secrets and misuse of the phone system. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, mainly on systems whose admin portal is exposed to the internet, and attacks are happening, since it is listed in CISA's Known Exp...

items.title: CVE-2026-134679
items.summary: WeddingShare through 1.8.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the anonymous MediaViewerController.GalleryItem action that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve item upload paths without the gallery secret key. Attackers can enumerate sequential integer item ids to learn paths and uploader names, then download photos and videos from key-protected galleries served as static files.

items.title: CVE-2026-134654
items.summary: Mailflare before 48957fb contains a host header injection vulnerability in the password-reset request handler that allows unauthenticated attackers to poison reset links when APP_URL is unset. Attackers can submit a reset request for a victim's email with a malicious Host header, capturing the single-use token when the victim clicks the link to take over the account.

items.title: CVE-2026-134451
items.summary: Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows non-admin users with settings:edit permission to modify OIDC provider configuration due to an improper permission check. Attackers can send a PUT request to /api/auth/oidc/ setting adminClaim to their own OIDC group, gaining full admin access on their next OIDC login.

items.title: CVE-2026-125294
items.summary: The Nexter Blocks Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.10 via the `tpgb_ajax_register_user()` function. This is due to a byte-level denylist on the `tpgb_acf_key[]` and `tpgb_acf[]` parameters that fails to block Unicode look-alike characters — such as U+1E87 and U+00E7 in a key like `ẇp_çapabilities` — whose UTF-8 byte sequences do not match any ASCII-based pattern check, while the database's default accent-insensitive collation (`utf8mb4_unicode_ci` / `utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci`) treats the decorated key as equivalent to the canoni…

items.title: CVE-2026-134461
items.summary: Web-Token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.10, 4.0.0 before 4.0.7, and 4.1.0 before 4.1.7 contain an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in PBES2AESKW::unwrapKey(), which passes the attacker-controlled p2c JWE header value to hash_pbkdf2() without an upper bound. Unauthenticated attackers can send a JWE using a PBES2-HS*+A*KW algorithm with a huge p2c iteration count to force lengthy PBKDF2 computations and exhaust server CPU.

items.title: CVE-2026-134352
items.summary: Rclone from 1.51.0 before 1.76.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in serve sftp --auth-proxy because the generateCacheKey cache key omits the authentication method. Attackers knowing a victim's base64 public key can submit it as a password from the same client IP to reuse the cached entry and gain read-write VFS access.

items.title: CVE-2026-134318
items.summary: better-auth 1.5.5 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in the organization plugin, where the creator role check compares the raw invitation role string while later checks trim it. Admins or other non-creator roles that can invite can submit a padded role such as " owner" that becomes owner on acceptance, allowing deletion of the organization and removal of original owners.

items.title: CVE-2026-134253
items.summary: Grav API plugin from 1.0.0 before 1.1.4 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows publishers with media and page write rights to write theme template files through the blueprint-upload endpoint. Attackers can upload a file into a theme's Twig templates folder and include it from sandboxed page Twig to execute commands as the web-server user.

items.title: CVE-2026-134287
items.summary: OpenRemote core before 1.34.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in UserAssetProvisioningMQTTHandler that allows unauthenticated attackers to impersonate provisioned devices without proof of private key possession. Attackers can publish a known device's public certificate to the provisioning request topic, authenticating their anonymous MQTT connection as the device's service account to read and modify assets.

items.title: CVE-2026-134249
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain Administrator role by spoofing X-Forwarded-For through a loopback-trusted reverse proxy. Attackers can send requests with Host set to localhost and X-Forwarded-For set to 127.0.0.1 to read private note-history contents via the /history/*path route when no lock-screen password is set.

items.title: CVE-2026-134349
items.summary: Rclone from 1.46.0 before 1.76.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the remote control server that allows unauthenticated clients to crash rclone by sending oversized JSON bodies. Attackers can POST large JSON payloads to protected RC methods, which handlePost decodes before authorization checks, triggering out-of-memory termination and interrupting transfers.

items.title: CVE-2026-134348
items.summary: Rclone from 1.56.0 before 1.76.0 contains a timing side-channel vulnerability in its htpasswd authentication middleware that allows unauthenticated attackers to enumerate valid usernames. Attackers can send HTTP Basic Auth requests with wrong passwords and measure response times, because bcrypt verification runs only for existing users, enabling targeted password guessing.

items.title: CVE-2026-134347
items.summary: actix-files before 0.7.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to read hidden files by requesting Windows 8.3 short-name aliases. Attackers can request short names like ENV~1 or GIT~1/config to bypass the leading-dot check in actix_files::Files and retrieve .env secrets and .git contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-134341
items.summary: actix-http 3.0.0 before 3.20.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to exhaust memory by sending large-window brotli request bodies. Attackers can send an 850-byte body with Content-Encoding: br declaring a 2^30 window, forcing about 1 GiB of decoder allocation per request and OOM-killing servers.

items.title: CVE-2026-134325
items.summary: ArcadeDB before 26.11.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the Redis protocol handler, which neither replies to nor closes a pre-authentication connection when it receives an array whose first element is not a string. Unauthenticated attackers can resend such an array just within the 30-second socket idle timeout to hold connections open indefinitely and exhaust RedisNetworkExecutor threads.

items.title: CVE-2026-134314
items.summary: better-auth 1.3.7 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains a race condition in the emailOTP plugin attempt counter, collision-prone email change code keys, and accent-insensitive email lookups. Unauthenticated attackers can send concurrent guesses exceeding allowedAttempts to brute-force OTPs and sign in or reset passwords, signed-in users can verify addresses they do not own, and attackers receiving mail at accent-variant addresses can reset victims' passwords.

When the two disagree, the router can route a request to a handler covered by a middleware mount while middie skips that middleware, so an unauthenticated client reaches a handler that an authentication, authorization, or rate-limiting middleware was meant to protect, with no special configuration required. items.title: CVE-2026-134259
items.summary: Admidio from 5.0.16 before 5.0.18 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with folder upload rights to store JavaScript by uploading SVG files served inline. Attackers can upload a script-bearing SVG that downloadFile() serves as image/svg+xml inline without nosniff or CSP, executing on the Admidio origin for viewers including unauthenticated visitors.

items.title: CVE-2026-134245
items.summary: SiYuan 3.8.0 before 3.8.10 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the serveAssets route that allows unauthenticated attackers to read password-protected document assets via name collisions. Attackers can request GET /assets/ when a visible document references the same relative asset name, retrieving the protected file's contents on public-publish instances with Basic Auth disabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-134244
items.summary: SiYuan 3.8.0 before 3.8.10 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in LAN sync that allows adjacent unauthenticated attackers to obtain device metadata by advertising a counterfeit peer with a replayed discovery tag. The client sends the sync scope ID, device name, OS, app version, and TLS client certificate to /peer-sync/v1/session/open before validating the server proof.

items.title: CVE-2026-134378
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 12.7.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 stores imported Italian supplier e-invoices as public files in the Regional module, which the server returns without authentication. Unauthenticated attackers can request predictable file URLs built from the supplier's VAT number and invoice sequence to read supplier names, VAT numbers, bank account details and line items.

items.title: CVE-2026-134299
items.summary: SurrealDB 3.0.4 before 4.0.0 does not apply operator-configured WebSocket frame, message, and buffer size limits to the GraphQL WebSocket upgrade handler at GET /graphql, falling back to permissive library defaults. Unauthenticated remote attackers who supply the target namespace and database in request headers can hold up to 64 MiB of in-flight data per concurrent connection, exhausting server memory and degrading availability.

items.title: CVE-2026-132089
items.summary: The Newsletter WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not keep a subscriber's secret key out of the redirect it returns after a subscription request when double opt-in is enabled, allowing unauthenticated attackers to confirm a subscription for any email address without access to its mailbox and, when the address already has an unconfirmed subscription, to reset that record with their own details.

items.title: CVE-2026-132081
items.summary: The Titan Anti-spam & Security WordPress plugin before 7.5.5 does not protect or remove the diagnostic archive it writes to the uploads folder when an administrator exports its logs, and names it after the export date alone, allowing unauthenticated visitors to download the Titan Anti-spam & Security WordPress plugin before 7.5.5's logs, including visitor IP addresses, and the site's system information.

items.title: CVE-2026-131983
items.summary: The FluentCommunity WordPress plugin before 2.13.0 does not apply the per-link visibility rules of space sidebar links when listing spaces in its space discovery feature, allowing unauthenticated visitors to retrieve the titles and URLs of links restricted to logged-in users or specific memberships, as well as disabled links, for every public and private space.

items.title: CVE-2026-131971
items.summary: The Payment forms, Buy now buttons, and Invoicing System | GetPaid WordPress plugin before 2.8.63 does not check that the visitor is allowed to view an invoice before rendering it through its single-invoice shortcode, and its payment-form embed page lets unauthenticated users render that shortcode for any invoice ID, disclosing customers' names, billing addresses, phone numbers, line items and payment status.

items.title: CVE-2026-130892
items.summary: The Newsletter WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not properly validate the destination of the redirect performed when a subscriber changes their list membership from a newsletter link, checking only that it begins with the site's URL, allowing unauthenticated attackers to redirect users to external sites whose address starts with the site's URL.

items.title: CVE-2026-130891
items.summary: The Newsletter WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not check that a visitor is really the subscriber before showing them newsletters marked as private, and accepts a weaker subscriber identifier that anyone can obtain by submitting a known subscriber's email address to the public subscription form, allowing unauthenticated attackers who know a subscriber's email address to read every private newsletter sent to that subscriber.

items.title: CVE-2026-126039
items.summary: The Hide My WP Ghost WordPress plugin before 7.0.19 does not limit one of its HTML output rewriting patterns to the markup it targets, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject HTML attributes through a comment author name that execute as Stored XSS for any visitor, including logged-in administrators, on pages that list recent comments.

items.title: CVE-2026-123663
items.summary: The ProfilePress WordPress plugin before 4.18.1 takes the role for an account registered through a combined login and registration form from the separate registration form that shares its numeric ID, allowing unauthenticated users to register with the elevated role, such as Editor, assigned by an unpublished registration form.

items.title: CVE-2026-121155

items.title: CVE-2026-114436

items.title: CVE-2026-19030
items.summary: Observable Discrepancy vulnerability in Drupal CAPTCHA for Drupal 7 allows unauthenticated attackers to test login credentials despite CAPTCHA protection. When CAPTCHA is enabled on Drupal login forms, normal form validation can still run after a missing or incorrect CAPTCHA response. This may expose credential validation feedback and allow an attacker to distinguish invalid credentials from valid credentials paired with a failed CAPTCHA. This issue affects CAPTCHA for Drupal 7: from 7.x-1.0 through 7.x-1.7.

items.title: CVE-2026-134171
items.summary: Cesanta Mongoose 7.21 before 7.24 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in rx_ip6() checksum validation that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to read past received packets by sending IPv6 extension headers. Attackers can send a single IPv6 TCP or ICMPv6 packet with extension headers, causing tcp6csum_ok() and icmp6csum_ok() to use the full payload length and read adjacent receive-buffer memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134169
items.summary: Qwik City before 1.20.3 (@builder.io/qwik-city) and @qwik.dev/router before 2.0.0-rc.4 contain an improperly controlled object modification vulnerability in formToObj that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite built-in function properties. Attackers can send a form POST with nested field names traversing inherited members of string values, breaking Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call process-wide until server restart.

items.title: CVE-2026-134164
items.summary: probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an algorithmic-complexity denial of service vulnerability in lib/exif_utils.js that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying self-referencing EXIF IFDs. Attackers can submit a crafted 9.6 KB JPEG with repeated ExifIFD and InteropIFD pointers to block the Node.js event loop for about 23 seconds.

items.title: CVE-2026-134163
items.summary: probe-image-size 7.4.0 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in lib/common/svg_header.js that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to block the event loop via crafted SVG doctypes. Attackers can supply SVGs with an unclosed internal subset followed by many ']' characters to trigger quadratic backtracking in probe.sync, probe(stream) or probe(url), causing repeated event loop stalls.

items.title: CVE-2026-76533
items.summary: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17 on Ubuntu and AlmaLinux, an unauthenticated user who obtains a valid Splunk Web session cookie before the affected user logs out could continue using the cookie after logout to access data and perform actions available to that user. The vulnerability is possible because the logout flow does not invalidate the associated session token on affected deployments. The attacker must obtain the valid session cookie before the affected user logs out of Splunk Web. The issue was reproduced in Splunk Enterprise installations on Ubunt…

items.title: CVE-2026-131196
items.summary: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, an unauthenticated user who can connect to a Splunk-to-Splunk (S2S) data forwarding receiver could cause the Splunk daemon to terminate unexpectedly. The unexpected termination interrupts data indexing and access to the management API and Splunk Web until the Splunk Enterprise process restarts. The vulnerability is possible because the S2S data forwarding receiver does not validate an optional field in forwarded event data, which results in a null pointer dereference when the field is missing. items.title: CVE-2026-131195
items.summary: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, an unauthenticated user could send repeated HTTP PubSub channel subscription requests that cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by permanently increasing memory usage until Splunk Enterprise exhausts available memory. The vulnerability affects instances that turn on the [pubsubsvr-http] stanza in server.conf because the HTTP PubSub broker does not release memory associated with a channel after the client disconnects.

items.title: CVE-2026-131192
items.summary: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.1, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, an unauthenticated user could access live event data from the indexing pipeline through the Representational State Transfer (REST) API on a standalone instance or a search head that is not an indexer cluster member. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk Enterprise accepts an empty shared key during service authentication.

items.title: CVE-2026-120271
items.summary: InfoScan contains an unauthenticated information disclosure vulnerability in its mobile-enumeration and version-reporting endpoints. A remote attacker can send HTTP requests without authentication to retrieve system configuration information, including usernames and display names, multifactor authentication configuration status, session settings, application version information, server details, hardware module firmware versions, and the BACnet/IP port used by the installation.

items.title: CVE-2026-133246
items.summary: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a local file inclusion vulnerability that allows administrators to include arbitrary server files by storing ../ sequences in the content manager file name. Unauthenticated requests to shop_content.php then pass the stored path to include(), executing embedded PHP in uploaded content files or images as the web server user.

items.title: CVE-2026-82339
items.summary: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to missing authentication in the SharePoint S-TAP RelayService, allowing an unauthenticated network attacker to inject forged audit events and access the active monitoring policy.

items.title: CVE-2026-133311
items.summary: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker, with knowledge of a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content, to conduct an unauthorized access attack due to improper authentication mechanisms. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to obtain sensitive information. The vulnerability is limited to the affected functionality and does not provide unrestricted access to arbitrary files elsewhere on the system. This is MTLVULN-1863.

items.title: CVE-2026-77379
items.summary: Bolt is a fully open source, adaptable platform for building and running modern websites. Prior to 6.1.4, the public Relation API lacks an access-control filter. Unauthenticated users can query its REST endpoints and GraphQL endpoints to discover metadata about unpublished, draft, and viewless content. This issue is fixed in version 6.1.4.

items.summary: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to leverage pre-staged malicious content to conduct an XML injection attack due to insufficient parameter validation. items.title: CVE-2026-133275
items.summary: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct an arbitrary file upload attack due to insufficient file type validation. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to upload arbitrary files to the target system. This is MTLVULN-1861.

items.title: CVE-2026-123890
items.summary: VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service. Affected versions: 9.1.x (fixed in 9.1.1.0200); 9.0.x (fixed in 9.0.2.0200); 8.0 (fixed in 8.0 U3m); 5.x (fixed in 5.2.5). Telco Cloud Platform 3.0, 4.x, 5.0.x, 5.1.x, 5.2 and Telco Cloud Infrastructure 3.0 are also affected (see KB463116).

items.title: CVE-2026-133243
items.summary: node-soap before 1.14.1 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in WSDL.xmlToObject that allows unauthenticated attackers to pollute Object.prototype via an XML element with id="__proto__". Attackers can send a single crafted SOAP request to a soap.listen() server, or return a malicious response to a client, causing all subsequent SOAP parsing to fail until process restart.

items.title: CVE-2026-133241
items.summary: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject iframe attributes via the maxheight parameter of the GET /oembed endpoint. Attackers can supply a single quote in maxheight to inject an onload handler into the returned html, executing script in third-party oEmbed consumers that embed it unsanitized.

items.title: CVE-2026-133239
items.summary: OpnForm before 2.8.2 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to move other forms' shared assets by supplying their URLs in file upload fields. Attackers can submit a public form with another form's cover or logo URL, causing Storage::move() to relocate it into submissions and break that asset.

items.title: CVE-2026-133237
items.summary: Manyfold 0.124.0 before 0.154.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to make the instance fetch internal URLs by supplying malicious ActivityPub actor icon.url and image.url fields. Attackers can deliver Create or Update activities to the inbox, causing the Shrine remote_url plugin to request internal or cloud metadata hosts and store responses as creator avatar or banner attachments.

items.title: CVE-2026-133234
items.summary: Stoatchat before 0.16.5 contains an unbounded JXL image decoding vulnerability in revolt_files decode_image that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory via the january /proxy endpoint. Attackers can request a small hosted JXL file declaring 12000x12000 pixels through /proxy to trigger huge allocations, OOM-killing january and denying proxy and embed service.

items.title: CVE-2026-129938
items.summary: An improper neutralization of delimiters in the MongoDB C# driver's DNS SRV connection-string resolution lets an unauthenticated party who can answer the client's DNS SRV query place a host outside the trusted domain into the client's server list. When an application resolves the connection string through the affected API and connects with the result, application data, authentication credentials and query results may pass through that host. This may result in unintended disclosure of data and credentials and in forged query results.

items.title: CVE-2026-132858
items.summary: A flaw was found in gdm. The CreateRemoteDisplay D-Bus method fails to perform proper authorization checks when initiating a remote display session. A local attacker with access to the login screen environment can invoke this method with an arbitrary username to bypass standard automatic login verification checks. This vulnerability allows the attacker to achieve privilege escalation and start an unauthorized session as any user on the system, including root.

items.summary: A flaw was found in quarkus-vertx-utils. When a client disconnects while receiving a streaming response, the server fails to detect the closed connection and continues processing the data indefinitely. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this issue by repeatedly initiating streaming requests and disconnecting, exhausting worker threads and resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

items.title: CVE-2026-22310
items.summary: When the setting for saving requests to non-existent pages (404) is enabled, JTL-Shop stores the raw requested URL in its redirect table, and the administration backend renders it without output encoding in the form used to edit a redirect. The setting is disabled by default in new installations but may still be enabled in older ones.

items.title: CVE-2026-15353
items.summary: SOAP information disclosure through malformed array dimensions. The SOAP extension reads an uninitialized array position when decoding an encoded array whose arraySize attribute is empty, whitespace-only or non-numeric, or when such dimensions come from a WSDL definition. Four bytes of unrelated heap data can then be used as an integer key in the decoded array. An unauthenticated remote client can trigger this with a crafted request to a SoapServer endpoint, and a malicious SOAP server with a response to SoapClient. Heap memory is disclosed only if the application returns or otherwise exposes…

items.summary: PHP-CGI out-of-bounds read and write during PATH_INFO correction. The PHP CGI binary (php-cgi), in CGI and FastCGI mode with cgi.fix_pathinfo enabled (the default), can perform an out-of-bounds read and write when the path removed from SCRIPT_FILENAME or PATH_TRANSLATED is longer than the supplied PATH_INFO, or when PATH_INFO is empty. This requires a web server mapping that passes such inconsistent values, or a FastCGI listener reachable by untrusted clients. An unauthenticated remote attacker can crash the process, may obtain process memory if the application exposes PATH_INFO or PATH_TRANSL…

items.title: CVE-2026-129506
items.summary: SOAP use-after-free when processing DTD entity references. The SOAP extension frees the document type definition (DTD) of a parsed XML document while attribute values can still refer to entities it owns, and can then read freed memory. Removing the DTD also bypasses the SOAP server's rejection of documents that contain one. An unauthenticated remote attacker who can send a crafted request to a SOAP endpoint, or who controls a WSDL or schema document loaded by the application, can crash the PHP process and cause denial of service. Memory disclosure and code execution have not been confirmed. Th…

When the status endpoint is enabled, an unauthenticated remote attacker can store markup in a worker's scoreboard entry with an ordinary request, for example through the username of an HTTP Basic authentication header that the web server forwards to PHP-FPM, or through the script filename where the attacker can influence it. When the front end reuses backend connections, which is not the default in nginx or Apache (for example nginx with fastcgi_keep_conn on, or Apache mod_proxy_fcgi with enablereuse=on), PHP-FPM can parse the leftover bytes as a new FastCGI request. items.title: CVE-2026-123058
items.summary: The web installer of JTL-Shop executes its state-changing installation tasks without checking whether the shop is already installed, and was not removed or locked after the installation. An unauthenticated remote attacker who can reach the installer directory can supply their own database credentials, create administrator and synchronisation accounts and overwrite the shop configuration. This can lead to a full takeover of the shop, including code execution on the server.

items.title: CVE-2026-22311
items.summary: The failed-login limiter of the JTL-Wawi synchronisation interface of JTL-Shop derives the client identity from the client-controlled X-Forwarded-For header and counts requests without credentials as failed logins. An unauthenticated remote attacker can block the synchronisation between JTL-Shop and JTL-Wawi with a few requests and repeat this indefinitely, so that orders are no longer handed over to JTL-Wawi. No data is disclosed and no code is executed.

items.title: CVE-2026-129315
items.summary: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). In 0.31.0 and earlier, the hosted installer and manual installation instructions set /etc/dokploy to mode 0777, allowing a local non-root user on a shared host to replace root-owned schedule or Traefik configuration directories. Dokploy subsequently consumes those paths as trusted configuration and can execute substituted scheduled-task scripts as root, resulting in local privilege escalation.

items.title: CVE-2026-127222
items.summary: SGLang through 0.5.23, fixed in commit 7b5fb39, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST /load_lora_adapter_from_tensors HTTP endpoint, which lacks the @auth_level(AuthLevel.ADMIN_OPTIONAL) decorator applied to its sibling admin endpoints, allowing unauthenticated network-reachable attackers to invoke it without an API key. Attackers can load a LoRA adapter from attacker-supplied serialized tensors to manipulate the served model, and when combined with a separately documented deserialization bypass, achieve unauthenticated remote code execution as root.

items.title: CVE-2026-128668
items.summary: An Unrestricted File Upload vulnerability in the admin panel of PHPGurukul News Portal Project V4.1 allows authenticated attackers to upload files with arbitrary content by bypassing weak filename extension validation in add-post.php and change-image.php. Although files are renamed with an image extension upon storage, the lack of MIME type and content validation enables content spoofing, storage of malicious markup, and creates a vector for Remote Code Execution (RCE) with server misconfigurations or secondary Local File Inclusion.

items.title: CVE-2026-131914

items.title: CVE-2026-130753
items.summary: heym before 0.0.142 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the Playwright step-mode node where _resolve_expressions_in_code substitutes workflow values directly into generated Python source. Authenticated non-admin users can craft step field values that break out of string literals to execute arbitrary Python as root inside the backend container.

items.title: CVE-2026-59964
items.summary: uftpd is a UNIX FTP and TFTP server. Prior to 2.16, uftpd's compose_path function in src/common.c can overflow the fixed dir[PATH_MAX] stack buffer when the server runs without chroot and prepends the configured home directory to a near-PATH_MAX attacker-supplied path using memmove. A logged-in FTP client, including an anonymous or guest client where enabled, can trigger the out-of-bounds write through commands such as CWD, RETR, STOR, or LIST, causing memory corruption and a reliable service crash. Remote code execution has not been demonstrated. This issue is fixed in version 2.16.

items.title: CVE-2026-110521
items.summary: IBM Engineering AI Hub 1.0.0 through 1.4.0 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to embed arbitrary JavaScript code in the Web UI thus altering the intended functionality potentially leading to credentials disclosure within a trusted session.

items.title: CVE-2026-130785
items.summary: Incus from 7.3.0 before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the /dev/incus guest API that allows a process in one container to impersonate another by creating a cgroup named with a forged lxc.monitor. component. Attackers can read the target container's user.* and cloud-init.* configuration and devices, subscribe to its events, mark it ready, and export images across projects.

items.title: CVE-2026-130778
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to authenticate as any trusted certificate by appending its public certificate to their presented TLS client chain. Attackers can append the server's or a cluster member's certificate to gain cluster-level access, bypass authorization, modify trust store entries, and influence scriptlet-based authorization decisions.

items.title: CVE-2026-130774
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability: rebuilding a never-started unprivileged container makes it boot without a user namespace. Root processes inside the container run as host uid 0, keeping capabilities like sys_module, with no device cgroup restriction, letting them load kernel modules and compromise the host.

items.title: CVE-2026-130789
items.summary: SemanticMediaWiki from 7.3.0 before 7.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the smwtask API check-query task that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass object-level authorization by relying on the wiki-wide edit right. Attackers can supply arbitrary subject titles, including protected pages, to run synchronous Semantic MediaWiki queries with caller-controlled conditions, limit, offset, and querymode parameters.

items.title: CVE-2026-130765
items.summary: Obot before 0.27.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass same-site validation of the rd parameter by inserting a tab character. Attackers can craft sign-in or sign-out links on the Obot domain that browsers resolve to external hosts, redirecting victims to phishing pages.

items.title: CVE-2026-130760
items.summary: Fleet before 4.86.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory via unbounded BER recursion in PKCS#7 parsing. Attackers can send deeply nested indefinite-length structures to Apple MDM check-in, enrollment, SCEP, or OTA endpoints to crash the entire Fleet instance.

items.title: CVE-2026-128662
items.summary: PHPGurukul Employee Leaves Management System V2.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability because database backup files are stored within the publicly accessible web root. An unauthenticated remote attacker can download the SQL backup files and retrieve sensitive database contents, including employee personally identifiable information and password hashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-128661
items.summary: PHPGurukul Employee Leaves Management System v2.1 contains an insufficient verification vulnerability in the password recovery functionality in forgot-password.php. The application allows an unauthenticated user to access the password-change workflow by providing a valid employee ID and corresponding email address without requiring an additional out-of-band verification mechanism.

items.summary: An insecure password reset vulnerability in the Admin Password Recovery Module of PHPGurukul News Portal Project v4.1 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to change an administrator or sub-administrator account password by providing the corresponding username and email address. Attackers can pass OS commands through the cmd parameter, which are executed via /bin/sh with insufficient filtering of & and $() characters, achieving remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

items.title: CVE-2019-25786
items.summary: Gnuboard5 5.0.1 before 5.3.3.3 and 5.4.0.1 before 5.4.0.2 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the arr_ajax_msg parameter. Attackers can craft GET requests to /plugin/sms5/ajax.sms_emoticon.php, where common.php's @extract($_GET) injects the value into the echoed JSON output, executing script in victims' browsers. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

items.title: CVE-2019-25784
items.summary: FineCMS versions 5.0.4 before 5.0.11 contain an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the data2 API action handled by list_tag in libraries/Template.php. Attackers can send GET requests to index.php?c=api&m=data2 with a valid auth hash and the param action=sql sql='...' to execute arbitrary SELECT queries and extract database information. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

items.title: CVE-2019-25783
items.summary: Tiny Tiny RSS before commit c68ac04 (2019-03-03) contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users through the unvalidated 'return' parameter. Attackers can craft requests to /public.php?op=login with an absolute external URL in 'return', which is placed in the Location header to send victims to attacker-controlled sites. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-02-26.

items.title: CVE-2019-25782
items.summary: ThinkPHP 5.0.0 before 5.0.24 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute commands by setting _method=__construct in POST data to overwrite the Request filter property. Attackers can send POST requests to endpoints reached via ?s=captcha or ?s=index/index/index with filter[]=system and server[REQUEST_METHOD] values to execute arbitrary system commands. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

items.title: CVE-2012-20007
items.summary: ThinkPHP 2.0 through 2.2 and 3.0 Lite mode contains an eval injection vulnerability in the Dispatcher PATH_INFO parsing, which uses preg_replace with the /e modifier and a double-quoted replacement. Unauthenticated attackers can send crafted requests to index.php with a malicious 's' parameter containing PHP expressions to execute arbitrary code on the server. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

items.title: CVE-2010-20126
items.summary: Virtual Keyboard plugin for SquirrelMail through 0.9.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script by supplying unsanitized input in the passformname parameter. Attackers can craft GET requests to /plugins/vkeyboard/vkeyboard.php with script payloads in passformname to execute code in victims' browsers and steal session cookies. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

items.title: CVE-2026-118521
items.summary: The Toolbox for Asgaros Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the replace_temp_pics function in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.4. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). This vulnerability is only reachable when the site administrator has enabled the Inline Image Upload feature (disabled by default).

items.title: CVE-2026-110009
items.summary: The Unzer Payments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account Takeover in all versions up to, and including, 2.2.1. The vulnerability exists because the Google Pay Express Checkout endpoint (`/?wc-api=google_pay_express`), handled by `startCheckoutDataWithNormalizedCustomerData`, accepts an attacker-controlled `paymentData.email` value and passes it to `createOrGetGuestCustomer()`, which resolves the submitted email to any existing WordPress user via `get_user_by('email', ...)` and then calls `wp_set_current_user()` and `wp_set_auth_cookie()` for the resolve…

items.title: CVE-2026-130750
items.summary: Network-AI from 5.11.0 before 5.17.2 contains a CORS misconfiguration in McpStreamableServer that reflects localhost Origins into Access-Control-Allow-Origin regardless of bind interface. Attackers controlling a localhost-origin page or DNS-rebinding name can read unauthenticated /tools and /health responses, exposing tool catalogs and bridge metadata on non-loopback binds.

items.title: CVE-2026-116446
items.summary: Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an out-of-bounds memory vulnerability in the NAS NFS service that an unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit to cause a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-95787
items.summary: Vulnerabilities in the PAPI protocol of AOS-10 could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to circumvent existing authentication controls. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to gain administrative access, modify system configurations, and access or manipulate sensitive data.

items.title: CVE-2026-130744
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows page editors to escape the Twig sandbox by sending requests with a Host: pages header. Attackers can write configuration YAML through page folders and media .meta.yaml sidecars to register an unsandboxed Twig namespace and run shell commands as the web server user.

items.title: CVE-2026-130675
items.summary: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.4 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in ImageTransforms::normalizeTransform() that allows attackers to instantiate arbitrary classes by supplying class:null with a __class key. Attackers can reach the method through Craft Commerce's payments/pay redirect template calling customer.photo.getUrl() with a crafted transform to instantiate classes like yii\rbac\PhpManager and execute PHP.

items.title: CVE-2026-132125
items.summary: Weblate 5.0 through 2026.11.2 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability where deleting a component list leaves stale Group.projects rows, widening team scope to whole projects. A user with componentlist.edit who deletes a list grants 'From component list' team members their full role, including project.edit, across possibly private projects.

items.title: CVE-2026-130747
items.summary: Grav before 1.7.53.7 and 2.x before 2.2.18 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows anonymous visitors to create super-admin accounts because UserCollection::count() uses an unescaped glob() pattern. On installs whose path contains brackets or a backslash, the account count returns zero, so attackers can send requests to POST /api/v1/auth/setup or the classic admin registration form to create or overwrite administrator accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-130736
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows publishers to bypass the media action allowlist using scoped method names in Markdown image URLs. Attackers can chain actions like self::addMetaFile into static calls such as Process::fromShellCommandline to read files and run shell commands as the web server user.

items.title: CVE-2026-107644
items.summary: The Bizuno Accounting – ERP/Accounting/CRM (for WordPress) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass via Password Reset Token Disclosure in all versions up to, and including, 7.4.5 via the `bizUser` parameter of the `validateReset()` function on the `portal/api/lostPW` endpoint. This is due to `portalCtl::goAPI()` failing to call `loadBusinessCache()` before invoking the handler, which causes `isMailConfigured()` to read an empty business cache and return false regardless of the site's actual mail configuration, causing the fully-qualified reset URL — containing the victim's…

items.title: CVE-2026-130749
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to fill the disk by varying the HTTP Host header. Attackers can send requests with distinct Host values to create per-host compiled configuration, blueprint, language and page index caches, causing session, upload and logging failures.

items.title: CVE-2026-130739
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows user managers and Flex editors to overwrite, create, or delete accounts by supplying client-controlled storage keys. Attackers can abuse the create form username, cross-type form flash replay, or __META storage key rename to gain super-admin accounts or delete account files.

items.title: CVE-2026-130738
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows user managers with admin.users.update to take over super admin accounts by disabling the super-granting group. Attackers can set the group's enabled field to false via the Flex user-groups form, then reset the victim's password through the user-accounts form to gain super admin access.

items.title: CVE-2026-130737
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows user managers to grant super-admin rights by nesting access maps under a YAML merge key. Attackers with admin.users.create or api.users.write can submit ', that bypass super-grant filtering and gain full site control.

items.title: CVE-2026-130732
items.summary: Traefik from 2.11.58 before 2.11.61 contains a resource leak vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust resources by sending Authorization headers with NTLM or Negotiate schemes. Attackers can open many short-lived connections that each allocate a dedicated backend transport never released, exhausting memory, file descriptors and backend connections.

items.title: CVE-2026-92535
items.summary: The Make Connector plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.6 via the include_custom_fields. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract arbitrary admin-selected user, post, comment, and term metadata exposed via core REST endpoints — including active session tokens with source IP, user-agent, login and expiry timestamps, capability sets, and any other admin-selected private meta keys including protected underscore-prefixed entries. This is exploitable because the plugin's meta picker queries all meta key…

items.title: CVE-2026-129323
items.summary: The Masteriyo LMS – LMS Course Builder, Quizzes & Certificates plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.5.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. On a default install, any unauthenticated visitor can self-register as a Masteriyo Student through the plugin's public /account/signup/ form with…

items.title: CVE-2026-129961
items.summary: LMS (Lan Management System) is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in its e-mail-based Helpdesk ticket intake. The mail parser does not reject Apache .htaccess configuration files or PHP-executable files when saving ticket attachments. A remote unauthenticated attacker can e-mail a Helpdesk ticket with such an attachment; in the default configuration, anyone can request the uploaded file's URL which executes attacker-supplied code with the privileges of the web server process. No operator interaction or LMS client session is required. The issue was fixed in commit d5059b1.

items.title: CVE-2026-127142
items.summary: LMS (Lan Management System) is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution via unrestricted upload of dangerous file types in the service ticket feature of the client panel. The application does not verify the type or name of files attached to service tickets. An authenticated attacker can upload an .htaccess file to bypass the access restrictions on the storage directory, together with a PHP script. Visiting the uploaded PHP file's URL leads to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the web server. This issue was fixed in commit 89dd3f7.

items.title: CVE-2026-127143
items.summary: LMS (Lan Management System) is vulnerable to privilege escalation in the lmsd daemon. The daemon loads the libraries listed in the LMS database without checking that they come from a trusted location. An attacker with access to the web server process or with write access to the LMS database can register a malicious library and trigger a configuration reload, causing lmsd to load and execute it. Because the example systemd unit does not set a separate user, lmsd runs as root, allowing the attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges. This issue was fixed in commit 89dd3f7. The lmsd c…

items.title: CVE-2026-124977
items.summary: The Flexible PDF Invoices for WooCommerce & WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'billing_address.first_name / extensions.wpdesk-flexible-invoices-checkout._billing_vat_number' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Execution requires an administrator to open the invoice edit page for the attacker's order and interact wit…

items.title: CVE-2026-130682
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.10 persists a table block's caption attribute into IAL properties without HTML sanitization, causing stored cross-site scripting upon import or sync. Attackers can inject an entity-encoded caption with an onerror handler that executes in the Electron client's nodeIntegration context to achieve remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-130674
items.summary: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.4 contains an incomplete blocklist fix that allows attackers who can author entry type title formats to write arbitrary files using ZipArchive or XMLWriter classes. Attackers can abuse the non-sandboxed renderObjectTemplate() renderer to write attacker-controlled content into the web docroot, achieving remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-18553
items.summary: Mattermost versions 11.11.x <= 11.11.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2 fail to sanitize terminal escape sequences when rendering server logs via {{mmctl logs}}, which allows an unauthenticated attacker to hijack a system administrator's clipboard or spoof terminal output via a crafted HTTP request whose logged content is later viewed with {{mmctl logs}}. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00753

items.title: CVE-2026-109859
items.summary: CAST Imaging has a missing authentication vulnerability in the "/api/auth/keycloak/users/{username}" endpoint. An unauthenticated remote attacker can modify the email address of an arbitrary Keycloak user and access sensitive account information, including the API authentication token hash. This can lead to account takeover, user impersonation and user enumeration. The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

items.title: CVE-2026-19707
items.summary: A bug in the Airlock Gateway (8.5.2 and earlier, and 8.6.0) allows attacker-controlled HTML in a backend response to exploit the Smart Form Protection feature, possibly leading to a Denial of Service (DoS) or Remote Code Execution (RCE) attack against the Airlock Gateway. The issue has been fixed in Airlock Gateway version 8.5.3 and 8.6.1. For an attack to be executable, the Airlock Gateway needs to have 'Smart Form Protection' (or the corresponding expert settings) enabled on a mapping whose backend returns a response containing certain multi-byte HTML character references. The buffer overflo…

items.title: CVE-2026-63189
items.summary: Dialoqbase is an application for creating chatbots. Prior to 1.11.5, the unauthenticated GET /api/v1/view/* route in server/src/routes/api/v1/view/root.ts resolves its attacker-controlled wildcard path without normalization or containment, allowing traversal outside the intended uploads directory and arbitrary server file reads. Reading environment files can disclose DB_SECRET_KEY, the application’s JWT signing key, which permits forged administrator tokens and takeover of bots, conversations, integrations, and stored third-party credentials. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.5.

items.title: CVE-2026-48728
items.summary: The GLPI Inventory Plugin handles network discovery, inventory, software deployment, and data collection for GLPI agents. Prior to 1.6.8, the /b/deploy, /b/collect, and /b/esx agent API endpoints do not authenticate requests before processing Deploy, Collect, and ESX task operations. An unauthenticated remote attacker can enumerate jobs and manipulate their status through these endpoints, disclosing job information and interfering with task processing. This issue is fixed in version 1.6.8.

items.title: CVE-2026-130723
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access attachments of filtered-out records through the shared view attachment-download endpoint. Attackers holding a public share link can enumerate sequential primary keys to obtain signed download paths for files on records the view's row filter excludes.

items.title: CVE-2026-130720
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access records hidden by a shared view's row filter by supplying arbitrary primary keys. Attackers with the share link can request attachment downloads and many-to-many or has-many link listings for excluded records to obtain their attachment files and linked record identities.

items.title: CVE-2026-130719
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated shared-base link holders to read the base's stored plaintext password through the general base metadata endpoint. Attackers with a share link can query the base read or list responses in bases.controller.ts, which skip password stripping in sanitizeBase.ts, to obtain reusable plaintext passwords.

items.title: CVE-2026-130714
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains a user enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to determine registered email addresses by observing differing sign-up endpoint responses. Attackers can submit addresses to signup in users.service.ts and compare error messages to identify existing accounts and pending Enterprise invitations, even under invite-only signup.

items.title: CVE-2026-130713
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains a user enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to identify pending invitees through a distinct sign-in error message. Attackers can submit sign-in requests where validateUser in auth.service.ts skips password comparison for saltless invited accounts, confirming the email address has an account.

items.title: CVE-2026-130710
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the job status polling endpoint of jobs.controller.ts that lacks an @Acl decorator. Unauthenticated attackers with a job id can read buffered status messages and completion payloads, exposing signed export download URLs or new base identifiers.

items.title: CVE-2026-130705
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated shared view link holders to read hidden columns by grouping on physical column names. Attackers can supply a hidden column's physical name or the unchecked sub-group parameter to the public group-by endpoint to reveal hidden values, counts, and column existence.

items.title: CVE-2026-130703
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read hidden columns by supplying comma-separated group-by column lists. Attackers with a shared view link can pair a visible and hidden column to bypass restrictSharedViewColumnReferences and retrieve hidden values tied to individual rows.

items.title: CVE-2026-119634

This is due to the function storing the `post_content` parameter via `wp_insert_post()` without the protected-shortcode allow-list check that was introduced in 4.3.14 for the sibling `submit_post()` handler — a gap that `wp_kses` filtering does not close, as it strips only HTML tags while leaving shortcode text such as `[wpuf-reg…

items.title: CVE-2026-130691
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to download data exports by reconstructing predictable file paths under nc/uploads/data-export. Attackers can derive paths from the table id, base, table and view titles, and export time to read full exports, including fields hidden from public shared views.

items.title: CVE-2026-130685
items.summary: vLLM from 0.28.0 before 0.33.0 contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the shared EngineCore by sending out-of-range prompt token ids when served with --skip-tokenizer-init. Attackers can submit a large positive token id to /v1/completions, /v1/embeddings, or /pooling, bypassing the tokenizer-gated vocab check and causing a fatal embedding index error that denies service to all tenants.

items.title: CVE-2026-130684
items.summary: vLLM before 0.33.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows malicious model publishers to redirect the served model and tokenizer by setting speculators_config verifier.name_or_path in config.json. Attackers can point this field at another local checkpoint directory to leak its tokenizer vocabulary via unauthenticated /detokenize requests and gain query access to private models.

items.title: CVE-2026-130650
items.summary: WWBN AVideo through c3edcc274c389816d434acadac07ee78eaf330c1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability because the default node socket server relays autoEvalCodeOnHTML without the PHP-only filter. Unauthenticated attackers can obtain an anonymous socket token and send a spoofed MSG_BATCH message to trigger client eval() in administrators' browsers for account takeover.

items.title: CVE-2026-87789
items.summary: Latvijas Valsts radio un televīzijas centrs (LVRTC) eParakstītājs 3.0 version 1.10.0 for macOS allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with the privileges of the current user by convincing the user to open a PDF with a crafted filename and select Send. The application embeds the attachment path in AppleScript source without neutralizing AppleScript syntax, allowing injected do shell script expressions to execute.

items.title: CVE-2026-120049
items.summary: The Link Library plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'linkfile[name]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.10.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires an administrator to have enabled the "Link File" option within the plugin's settings, which activates the vulnerable file upload field on the public add-link form.

items.title: CVE-2016-20105
items.summary: Lucee Server versions 5.0.0.0 before 5.3.4.46 contain an insecure default configuration that allows unauthenticated attackers to set the initial admin password via the first-run form on /lucee/admin/web.cfm and /lucee/admin/server.cfm. Attackers can access the 'New Password' set-password form before any password is configured to seize administrative control of the server. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-24.

items.summary: The Team VCard generator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.0 via the 'photo' parameter parameter.
