items.title: CVE-2026-134543
items.summary: A flaw has been found in jprocms up to 1.7.7. Affected is the function StrUtil.format of the component Database Backup Module. Executing a manipulation of the argument host/port/username/password/dbName can lead to os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-134450
items.summary: Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a clickjacking vulnerability because src/hooks.server.ts never sets X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors headers on responses. Attackers on a same-site origin can embed the UI in an invisible iframe to trick authenticated users into stopping stacks, deleting resources, or changing settings.

items.title: CVE-2026-134448
items.summary: Finsys Dockhand 1.0.7 before 1.0.57 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows low-privileged users to read and write arbitrary files by setting an unvalidated envPath on a stack source. Attackers with stacks:edit permission can point envPath to files like /etc/shadow or SSH keys, then use GET or PUT on /api/stacks/[name]/env/raw to read or overwrite them.

items.title: CVE-2026-134536
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in Drakeling Labs Operation Harsh Doorstop up to 0.14.2.1 Build 19523588. The impacted element is the function LaunchURL of the component Workshop Configuration. This manipulation causes unrestricted upload. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 0.14.2.2 Build 26092794 is sufficient to resolve this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

items.title: CVE-2026-134389
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 6.18.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Payment Requests that lets authenticated Accounts User role holders read source documents they lack permission to access. Attackers can create a Payment Request through the generic record interface that references another company's document, then email its loaded content to an address they choose.

items.title: CVE-2026-134387
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 12.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module dashboard chart source that returns account balance history without checking chart or account permissions. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no roles, can send crafted requests naming any account to read general ledger balance history of any company.

items.title: CVE-2026-134367
items.summary: pypdf 2.4.2 before 7.0.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in its handling of XFA forms that allows attackers to cause excessive memory consumption. Attackers can supply a crafted PDF containing XFA forms with many small fields so that loading the forms consumes large amounts of memory, causing a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134006
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in Moonshot AI Kimi Code up to 2.7.2. This vulnerability affects the function guardToolExecution of the file packages/agent-core-v2/src/features/plan/planService.ts of the component Plan Mode Permission Guard. Executing a manipulation can lead to improper authorization. The attack requires local access. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-115589
items.summary: This CVE ID has been rejected or withdrawn by its CVE Numbering Authority.

items.title: CVE-2026-134534
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in Skyvern-AI Skyvern 1.0.56. The affected element is the function classify_url of the file skyvern/forge/sdk/browser_egress_policy.py. The manipulation results in server-side request forgery. The attack may be performed from remote. Upgrading to version 1.0.57 is sufficient to fix this issue. The patch is identified as 10b8d829c2750ebf62f2b70dec0e288297e752dd. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-134366
items.summary: pypdf before 7.0.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to cause large memory usage by supplying crafted PDF cross-reference streams. Attackers can craft a PDF whose cross-reference stream offsets all point to one large object, exhausting memory in applications parsing the file.

items.title: CVE-2026-134355
items.summary: AzuraCast before 0.24.1 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the /api/station/{station_id}/profile/edit endpoint that exposes and accepts Icecast/Shoutcast passwords for users holding Manage Station Profile without Manage Station Broadcasting. Authenticated station users can read the admin, source, relay and streamer passwords via GET to administer Icecast or broadcast to listeners, or overwrite them via PUT to lock out operators.

items.title: CVE-2026-134335
items.summary: ArcadeDB 21.10.1 before 26.11.1 contains a resource-limit bypass vulnerability that allows restricted users to evade per-group readTimeout because limits are applied to shared cached statements and plans. Attackers can run SQL text previously cached by an unrestricted principal to skip timeouts, or impose their own timeout and limit on root and other users.

items.title: CVE-2026-133988
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Chaterm up to 0.12.2 on Windows. The affected element is an unknown function of the file resources/app-update.yml of the component Auto-Update Mechanism. Such manipulation leads to download of code without integrity check. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. This attack is characterized by high complexity. The exploitability is described as difficult. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-133993
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17b02. This affects the function FUN_0040efb0 of the file gena.cgi of the component GENA Subscription Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument service results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-134273
items.summary: Vikunja from 2.6.0 before 2.8.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the Planka migration converter that multiplies task allocations for duplicate list IDs. Attackers controlling a Planka server can return boards with duplicate list IDs and many cards to exhaust memory and OOM-kill the Vikunja process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134269
items.summary: Vikunja from 0.18.0 before 2.8.0 contains a resource amplification vulnerability in pkg/models/export.go that allows authenticated users to exhaust server memory by exporting heavily related tasks. Attackers can relate many tasks to one task with a large description and request a user export, causing an out-of-memory crash for all users.

items.title: CVE-2026-134268
items.summary: Vikunja from 0.21.0 before 2.8.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows authenticated users to trigger instance-wide database writes by setting a project position below 0.1. Attackers can repeatedly send PUT requests to /api/v2/projects/{id} so recalculateProjectPositions updates every user's root projects, holding SQLite's write lock and degrading availability.

items.title: CVE-2026-134457
items.summary: Hysteria 2.5.0 before 2.8.2 contains a memory allocation vulnerability when sniffing is enabled, allowing authenticated users to trigger out-of-memory conditions. Attackers with a valid password can forward a crafted QUIC packet with a huge crypto length, causing the server to exhaust memory and crash.

items.title: CVE-2026-134456
items.summary: Hysteria 2.5.0 before 2.9.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the HTTP sniff implementation that fails to limit header size. Attackers can continuously send excessively large HTTP headers without terminating them, exhausting server memory and causing out-of-memory crashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-134455
items.summary: Hysteria 1.0.0 before 2.9.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in FragUDPMessage where UDP fragmentation fails to handle headers larger than the maximum datagram payload size. Authenticated clients can advertise a small max_datagram_frame_size and trigger a UDP response, causing a slice bounds panic that crashes the server.

items.title: CVE-2026-134454
items.summary: Hysteria from 2.0.0 before 2.9.2 contains an ACL bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated clients to reach blocked UDP destinations by reusing an established UDP session. Attackers can open a session to an allowed destination, then send later packets to localhost or private-network addresses to access internal-only UDP services.

items.title: CVE-2026-134453
items.summary: Dockhand before 1.0.50 contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows authenticated unprivileged users to read restricted data by querying API endpoints lacking RBAC checks. Attackers can access /api/users, /api/license, and /api/hawser/connect to obtain user emails and roles, the full license key, and environment details, while an invalid license grants all users admin rights.

items.title: CVE-2026-134449
items.summary: Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to perform state-changing actions by exploiting missing Origin header validation and absent CSRF tokens. Attackers can lure authenticated users to a same-site attacker page that submits forged POST requests to stop, start, or delete stacks, modify settings, and change credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-134436
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.8.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an endpoint shared across modules that returns transaction child table rows without checking permissions on the child table or parent document. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without roles, can supply document types and filter conditions to read business document line details and probe record values.

items.title: CVE-2026-134435
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext before 15.124.2 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that records bank clearance dates, which checks only a broad role permission before writing to caller-named payment documents. Authenticated Accounts Users can send crafted requests naming payment documents of other companies, outside their User Permissions, or already submitted, to alter clearance dates and compromise bank reconciliation integrity.

items.title: CVE-2026-134434
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 16.0.0 before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Manufacturing module endpoint that allows authenticated users to cancel Stock Reservation Entries without record-level write permission. Low-privilege attackers can send crafted requests naming manufacturing documents of other companies or outside their User Permissions to release reserved stock and disrupt stock allocation.

items.title: CVE-2026-134433
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext before 15.124.2 and 16.x before 16.53.0 fails to enforce record-level authorization in several endpoints, reports and forms, allowing authenticated low-privilege users to access data beyond their role. Attackers can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other companies' financial, stock, pricing and contact data or make constrained changes to those records.

items.title: CVE-2026-134432
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module import endpoint that does not check whether the caller may create inserted records or download a named file. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no roles, can send crafted import requests to read file contents and create Serial No and Batch records.

items.title: CVE-2026-134431
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 7.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in endpoints that build part of a query from caller-supplied sort parameters without validation. Authenticated low-privilege users can send crafted requests whose sort parameter holds SQL that the database executes as part of the query, extracting sensitive information.

items.title: CVE-2026-134430
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 12.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns the parsed content of private import-format files without checking permission on the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read those private files.

items.title: CVE-2026-134429
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a CRM and Support module endpoint that returns Communications of documents without checking whether the caller may read them. Authenticated attackers with a common operational role can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read their email communications and relink them away from their original documents.

items.title: CVE-2026-134428
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that returns Item master records without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to retrieve complete item data including costing and purchase rates.

items.title: CVE-2026-134427
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.53.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Assets module endpoint that returns cost and quantity fields of purchase and stock transactions without record-level permission checks. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read these fields.

items.title: CVE-2026-134426
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.x 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns Sales Order and Purchase Order values and counterparties without checking permissions on the requested records. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read their order values and counterparties.

items.title: CVE-2026-134425
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that returns item valuation rates without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to retrieve their valuation rates.

items.title: CVE-2026-134424
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 8.2.5 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that returns on-hand stock quantities without checking record-level permissions. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without roles, can send crafted requests naming restricted records to disclose stock quantities and confirm item existence.

items.title: CVE-2026-134423
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 6.26.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that returns stock data without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read per-warehouse and company-wide stock quantities and confirm item existence.

items.title: CVE-2026-134422
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a POS endpoint that returns POS Opening Entries without verifying record-level read permissions. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming other records to read open POS sessions of other users.

items.title: CVE-2026-134421
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Selling module endpoint that returns Loyalty Program terms without checking permission on the requested records. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other customers' Loyalty Program terms.

items.title: CVE-2026-134420
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 10.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns Payment Term settings without checking whether the caller may read the specific records requested. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read Payment Term settings.

items.title: CVE-2026-134419
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 10.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns Payment Terms Template rows without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read Payment Terms Template data.

items.title: CVE-2026-133120
items.summary: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. In versions before 4.0.10, the plugin passes Express a request URL that does not always match the path Fastify's router dispatched, so path-scoped Express middleware can be skipped while the route handler still runs. Several request forms trigger the mismatch, including percent-decoding that rewrites a backslash to a slash or double-decodes an encoded percent sign, and a request target that begins with an asterisk, so the middleware and the handler disagree on the path or on parameter a…

items.title: CVE-2026-133990
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in Cockpit-HQ Cockpit up to 2.14.1. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file cron.php of the component Web Worker. Such manipulation of the argument token leads to missing authentication. The attack can be executed remotely. The attack requires a high level of complexity. The exploitation is known to be difficult. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-134418
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 4.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns the taxes and charges of documents without checking record permissions. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no roles, can request arbitrary document types and records to read tax rows beyond their permitted scope.

items.title: CVE-2026-134417
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns uploaded bank statement file content without checking record-level permissions. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their scope to read full statement file contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-134416
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.55.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns a company's Chart of Accounts without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read any company's Chart of Accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-134415
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Selling module endpoint that returns customer loyalty point balances without checking the caller's permission on the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read other customers' loyalty point balances.

items.title: CVE-2026-134414
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 5.0.0 before 15.122.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that allows authenticated users to read Taxes and Charges Template rows without permission checks. Attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read account heads and tax rates.

items.title: CVE-2026-134413
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read POS Profile cashier lists by calling a POS endpoint lacking record permission checks. Attackers, including portal users or users with no roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope POS Profiles to retrieve their cashier data.

items.title: CVE-2026-134412
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 8.0.0 before 15.123.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that allows authenticated users to read restricted warehouse data. Attackers with a common operational role can send crafted requests naming warehouses excluded by their User Permissions to obtain stock quantities and stock values.

items.title: CVE-2026-134411
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 11.1.7 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Regional module endpoint that returns private e-invoice files after checking only document-type permissions, not per-record User Permissions. Authenticated attackers with a common operational role can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other companies' private e-invoice files.

items.title: CVE-2026-134410
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that returns Serial No and Batch ledger entries without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to obtain item codes, quantities, warehouses, batch and serial numbers.

items.title: CVE-2026-134409
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 5.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Projects module endpoint that returns employee costing and billing rates without record-level permission checks. Authenticated users, including portal users or users without roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other employees' activity cost rates.

items.title: CVE-2026-134408
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 16.0.1 before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock dashboard chart endpoint that returns site-wide stock value when the caller has no permitted warehouse. Authenticated users with common operational roles can send crafted requests naming records outside their scope to read stock value data beyond their permissions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134406
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.94.2 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in a supplier portal endpoint whose party identity check ignores party type, failing to distinguish a Customer and a Supplier that share a name. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read buying-portal records.

items.title: CVE-2026-134405
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns Bank Transaction metadata of other companies without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to retrieve that metadata.

items.title: CVE-2026-134404
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 6.3.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the customer and supplier portal list endpoint, which returns complete selling documents and RFQs without checking permission on the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without roles, can request out-of-scope records to read valuation, margin, and other bidder details.

items.title: CVE-2026-134403
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 7.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the customer portal Projects list, which returns every field without checking permission on the requested records. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read project costing and margin data.

items.title: CVE-2026-134400
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 13.49.0 before 14.0.0, 14.17.2 before 15.124.0, and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Selling module endpoint that returns Sales Order line items without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope Sales Orders to read their line item data.

items.title: CVE-2026-134398
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.87.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that changes Period Closing Voucher job status without permission checks and accepts a request method triggerable cross-site. Authenticated users without an Accounts role, or cross-site pages opened by authenticated users, can send requests naming a scheduled job to stop accounting jobs from completing.

items.title: CVE-2026-134397
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.10.4 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that checks whether an inventory number exists and creates missing Serial No and Batch master records without verifying create permission. Authenticated users can send a crafted request with a new number to create these records outside their role, affecting inventory data integrity.

items.title: CVE-2026-134396
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that reconciles Bank Transactions against caller-named vouchers, checking permission only on the Bank Transaction and not on each voucher. Authenticated users with the Accounts User role who can edit a Bank Transaction can send crafted requests naming vouchers outside their permitted scope to change the reconciliation state of vouchers belonging to other companies or outside their User Permissions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134395
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns Bank Transaction amounts and bank accounts without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated users with a common operational role can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read Bank Transaction data of other companies.

items.title: CVE-2026-134394
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 14.44.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Accounts module's payment unreconciliation endpoint, which does not check the caller's permission on the vouchers it unreconciles. Authenticated users with the Accounts User role can send crafted Unreconcile Payment requests naming vouchers from other companies or outside their User Permissions to remove their reconciliation.

items.title: CVE-2026-134393
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 10.1.41 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Manufacturing module endpoint that replaces BOMs without checking whether the caller may modify either BOM or the affected assemblies. Authenticated users who can create a BOM Update Log can send a crafted request naming two BOMs to replace the first with the second in every assembly site-wide.

items.title: CVE-2026-134392
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing validation vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that fails to verify reserved item rows belong to the target Sales Order. Authenticated users with the Stock User role can send crafted reservation requests naming another order's item row to reserve stock beyond that order's limits, creating mismatched Stock Reservation Entries.

items.title: CVE-2026-134391
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 12.2.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Assets module endpoint that returns Asset details without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read restricted asset details.

items.title: CVE-2026-134390
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the make_merge_log endpoint that allows authenticated users to read POS Invoice data. Attackers can supply POS Invoice names outside their permitted scope to retrieve each invoice's customer, posting date, and grand total.

items.title: CVE-2026-134388
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 14.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the CRM module because notes on Leads and Opportunities are saved without passing through the HTML sanitiser. Authenticated users with the Sales User role can save a note containing a crafted payload that executes in another user's session when they open the record, acting with that user's permissions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134386
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.111.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.22.0 before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns item rows of a caller-named inter-company invoice or order and accepts a caller-supplied document type without checking read permission. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no roles, can send crafted requests naming another company's document to read Sales Invoice, Purchase Invoice and order items.

items.title: CVE-2026-134385
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 6.3.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint used to choose a Tax Rule, which returns party address details without permission checks. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no roles, can send crafted requests naming arbitrary customers, suppliers, or Addresses to obtain their city, state, postal code, and country.

items.title: CVE-2026-134384
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.124.2 and 16.x before 16.53.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that returns item cost data without checking the caller's permissions on the item, company, or warehouse. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users restricted to other warehouses, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope items, companies, or warehouses to obtain valuation rates and average purchase costs.

items.title: CVE-2026-134383
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 14.47.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Accounts module where a method on accounting vouchers creates and submits Repost Accounting Ledger documents with permission checks skipped. Authenticated users with read access to a Sales Invoice, Purchase Invoice, Payment Entry, Journal Entry, or Purchase Receipt can call it to delete and repost that voucher's General Ledger entries, an action restricted to System Managers.

items.title: CVE-2026-134382
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 5.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in a Selling module endpoint that checks only document-type write permission, not permission on each Sales Order, when closing or reopening Sales Orders. Authenticated users restricted by User Permissions can send crafted requests naming another company's Sales Order to close or reopen it outside their restriction.

items.title: CVE-2026-134381
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 5.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the Buying module: the endpoint that closes and reopens Purchase Orders checks only document-type write permission, not per-document User Permissions. Authenticated users with Purchase Order write access can send crafted requests naming another company's Purchase Order to change its status.

items.title: CVE-2026-134379
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 8.2.5 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in Manufacturing module endpoints that check only document-type write access, not permission on each Work Order. Authenticated users restricted by User Permissions can send crafted requests naming another company's Work Order to stop, resume or close it.

items.title: CVE-2026-134377
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 7.1.0 before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Projects module endpoints that return Timesheet data without restricting results to records the caller may read. Any authenticated user, including one with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests to read organisation-wide Timesheet work and billing details.

items.title: CVE-2026-134376
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns the subscription plans linked to a caller-named invoice without checking read permission on that invoice. Authenticated attackers can send crafted requests naming invoices outside their permitted scope to learn whether they belong to subscriptions and read the billed plans.

items.title: CVE-2026-134375
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns Payment Entries for a readable bank record without checking read permission on each Payment Entry. Authenticated users with an Accounts role can request a readable record to obtain metadata of Payment Entries excluded by their user permissions, such as Cost Center restrictions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134374
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Assets module endpoints that return a depreciation schedule for a caller-supplied asset without checking read permission on that asset. Authenticated users can name another company's asset to disclose its purchase value, value after depreciation, and depreciation entries.

items.title: CVE-2026-134373
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 14.0.0 before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Utilities module endpoint that lets any authenticated user retry failed bulk transactions without a role check. Attackers, including portal users with no roles, can send crafted requests for a chosen date to mark site-wide failed bulk transactions as retried, removing them from the normal recovery path, and add background job load.

items.title: CVE-2026-134372
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 4.3.0 before 15.121.6 and 16.x before 16.37.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in an endpoint of the Selling and Buying modules, where a request value validated early can be overridden by caller-supplied data that reaches a database query unvalidated. Any authenticated user, including a portal user with no roles, can send crafted requests to extract sensitive data, including active session data, and take over other accounts such as administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-134371
items.summary: Frappe 8.8.0 before 16.30.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the SMS Settings get_contact_number API that lets attackers read any Contact's phone numbers without permission checks. Attackers can call the endpoint, which uses an uncorrelated EXISTS subquery, to retrieve mobile_no and phone values of arbitrary Contact records, exposing PII.

items.title: CVE-2026-134370
items.summary: Frappe Framework before 15.120.1 and 16.x before 16.33.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in file attachment handling that permits arbitrary file read. Authenticated attackers holding a single ordinary role without write permissions can abuse attachment handling to read server files outside the application boundary.

items.title: CVE-2026-134364
items.summary: pypdf 3.7.1 before 7.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows attackers to guess placeholders in encrypted templated documents by analyzing file identifiers. Attackers with a document sharing the same template and access to other documents' file identifiers can recover placeholder contents from encrypted PDFs.

items.title: CVE-2026-134362
items.summary: Coder 2.6.0 before 2.29.26, 2.30.0 before 2.34.18, 2.35.0 before 2.37.10, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.6 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability because CSRF exemption patterns in coderd/httpmw/csrf.go are matched as unanchored regular expressions, letting affected API routes skip CSRF token and same-origin checks. Attackers controlling a page same-site with the deployment can make signed-in users' browsers send forged POST requests that recreate dev containers or add users whose names contain derp to organizations.

items.title: CVE-2026-134361
items.summary: Coder 2.6.0 before 2.29.21, 2.30.0 before 2.34.10, 2.35.0 before 2.35.8, 2.36.0 before 2.36.5, and 2.37.0 before 2.37.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the workspace agent dRPC API, whose handlers dereference unset request sub-messages and unconfigured Tailnet providers without recovering from panics. Attackers holding a workspace agent token can send UpdateLifecycle, UpdateStartup, or BatchUpdateMetadata messages lacking sub-messages, or call RefreshResumeToken or WorkspaceUpdates, to repeatedly crash coderd.

items.title: CVE-2026-134356
items.summary: AzuraCast 0.19.0 before 0.24.1 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows users with station media rights to add tracks to other stations' playlists by supplying foreign playlist ids to the single-file edit endpoint. Attackers can send sequential playlist ids in the playlists array to inject entries into other stations' AutoDJ rotations and public now-playing metadata, causing failed playback slots.

items.title: CVE-2026-134351
items.summary: Rclone 1.49.0 before 1.76.0 contains an improper authentication vulnerability in Proxy.Call that lets revoked users keep access because cached auth-proxy answers are never revalidated. Revoked users of serve sftp, ftp, http, or webdav can reconnect within five minutes using their original credentials to retain access indefinitely.

items.title: CVE-2026-134350
items.summary: rclone 1.67.0 before 1.76.0 contains a credential leak vulnerability in the Ulozto backend that sends X-Auth-Token and X-User-Token headers to unintended hosts on HTTP redirect because downloads use the authenticated f.rest client instead of f.cdn. Attackers who can observe or redirect CDN download traffic can capture the long-lived API key and session token to gain persistent access to the victim's Ulozto storage.

items.title: CVE-2026-134342
items.summary: actix-http 3.18.10 before 3.20.2 contains an HTTP request smuggling vulnerability in its chunked decoder, which treats a bare LF after the last chunk as the start of a trailer section. Attackers can send a body ending in 0\r\n\n through a connection-reusing proxy so the next request's body is parsed as new requests, bypassing WAF or upstream protections.

items.title: CVE-2026-134339
items.summary: ArcadeDB from 26.11.1-SNAPSHOT before 26.11.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to skip per-type ACL checks when a database is opened on demand. Attackers can send the first POST /api/v1/batch/{database} request to a closed database to read and write types they are not entitled to access.

items.title: CVE-2026-134338
items.summary: ArcadeDB 25.8.1 before 26.11.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability because per-type ACLs are keyed by type name, renames are not propagated to the permission configuration, and requestAccessOnType allows unknown type names by default. Authenticated users holding only updateSchema can run ALTER TYPE NAME on a denied type to gain read, DELETE and TRUNCATE access, immediately for TIMESERIES types and after the next security rebuild for record-backed types.

items.title: CVE-2026-134337
items.summary: ArcadeDB native-image server builds 26.8.1 before 26.11.1 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated clients to perform writes through read-only query paths by nesting statements in SELECT. Missing reflection metadata leaves SqlAstInspector with an empty AST, letting INSERT in projections or LET clauses persist via the query endpoint, MCP read-only mode, and HA follower routing.

items.title: CVE-2026-134334
items.summary: ArcadeDB from 26.7.1 before 26.11.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability because LSMTreeFullTextIndex computes BM25 corpus statistics over all buckets of the indexed type, ignoring bucket access control on subtypes. Authenticated users with read access to a supertype but not its subtype can run EXPLAIN or PROFILE on full-text queries and read totalDocs and per-term df values to count hidden subtype documents containing chosen terms.

items.title: CVE-2026-134327
items.summary: ArcadeDB before 26.11.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read schema definitions of denied types through listings ignoring per-type ACLs. Attackers can query the PostgreSQL wire catalog, GraphQL introspection, or MCP get_schema to reveal property names, indexes, inheritance, and materialized view SQL.

items.title: CVE-2026-134324
items.summary: ArcadeDB 26.3.1 before 26.11.1 contains a read-only bypass vulnerability that allows server administrators to commit writes through the MCP read-only query tool by submitting Groovy-fallback Gremlin scripts. GremlinQueryEngine.analyze() evaluates scripts like Graph API addVertex calls on the auto or groovy engine and classifies them as READ, persisting writes the read-only restriction should refuse.

items.title: CVE-2026-134322
items.summary: better-auth 0.4.12-beta.7 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the phone number plugin that lets sign-up and other flows save unverified phone numbers, which phone OTP sign-in then uses to select the account. Attackers can attach a victim's number to an attacker-controlled account so the victim's valid OTP sign-in yields a session for that account, exposing data the victim then enters.

items.title: CVE-2026-134317
items.summary: @better-auth/stripe 1.2.0-beta.18 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability because the stripeCustomerId user field accepts values from sign-up and update-user requests, letting a user replace their own Stripe customer ID with another customer's. Attackers who know another customer's Stripe ID can open that customer's billing portal to view invoices and billing details, change payment methods, and cancel or modify subscriptions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134315
items.summary: better-auth 1.4.0 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an improper authentication vulnerability because email-change links record the old and new addresses but not the requesting user. Attackers can open a still-valid link issued for their own account after a victim registers the attacker's released old address, gaining a session and changing the victim's email to one they control.

items.title: CVE-2026-134311
items.summary: better-auth 1.3.0 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the admin plugin's /admin/update-user endpoint that lets roles holding user:update change another user's phoneNumber and phoneNumberVerified fields. Attackers can set their own verified phone number on a higher-privileged account and sign in via phone OTP to take it over.

items.title: CVE-2026-134310
items.summary: SurrealDB from 3.2.0 before 3.3.4 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows record users to update protected rows by exploiting table-level PERMISSIONS FOR update predicates referencing COMPUTED fields. Because check_update_permissions evaluates the predicate before computed fields are populated, the field reads as NONE and deny-intended predicates like blocked != true pass, letting attackers modify records.

items.title: CVE-2026-134309
items.summary: SurrealDB 1.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to shadow protected $access, $auth, and $token variables by binding them as FOR loop variables. Attackers can wrap queries in nested FOR loops with forged values to satisfy table permission predicates, enabling unauthorized reads, modifications, or deletions as a VIEWER.

items.title: CVE-2026-134307
items.summary: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a permission bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege database users to read restricted records by calling the GET /export endpoint. Attackers can export raw records that skip table SELECT predicates and field-level SELECT permissions, exposing other users' rows and hidden fields.

items.title: CVE-2026-134306
items.summary: SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in filter_fields_by_permission that allows authenticated record users to read denied child field values. Attackers can query rows where overlapping items[*] and items[*].secret permissions compact arrays, causing shifted elements to retain field values denied by SELECT permissions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134303
items.summary: SurrealKV before 1.1.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the safe InternalKeyRef::from_encoded constructor, which only checks key length with a debug-only assertion. Callers passing keys shorter than 16 bytes, or crafted or corrupted SSTable blocks, trigger unchecked length underflow in timestamp(), seq_num() and trailer(), reading heap bytes before the allocation or panicking.

items.title: CVE-2026-134302
items.summary: SurrealDB 1.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows any user able to run queries to crash the server by triggering unchecked decimal overflow in math::sum or math::product. Attackers can submit a query summing or multiplying large decimal literals or aggregate stored decimals with GROUP ALL, causing a rust_decimal panic that terminates the entire server process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134301
items.summary: SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains a guard bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute write subqueries by embedding them in LIVE query WHERE clauses or field projections. Attackers can inject CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, or RELATE statements that run atomically inside other users' triggering transactions, amplifying writes and exfiltrating document data after permission revocation.

items.title: CVE-2026-134300
items.summary: SurrealDB from 2.2.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in Document::purge_references that lets authenticated users bypass target table PERMISSIONS by triggering REFERENCE ON DELETE cascades. Attackers can delete a referenced record to delete, unset, or run CUSTOM expressions on referencing records despite PERMISSIONS FOR delete or update NONE.

items.title: CVE-2026-134295
items.summary: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in direct filesystem buckets because BucketController::check_permission evaluates key-based ACLs against the un-normalized object key, while FileStore::to_os_path collapses '..' sequences without a traversal check. An authenticated tenant permitted only for certain keys can supply a key such as /public/../private/confidential.txt to read, write, or delete arbitrary files within the storage root.

items.title: CVE-2026-134294
items.summary: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in its bucket storage layer on Windows, where ObjectKey::check_no_traversal splits object keys only on forward slashes while FileStore::to_os_path treats backslashes as directory separators. Attackers can supply object keys such as /..\bucket2\secret to bypass the traversal check and read or modify files in other buckets.

items.title: CVE-2026-134293
items.summary: SurrealDB 3.1.0 before 4.0.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in its Model Context Protocol (MCP) server because the identifier validator (consume_backtick_ident and validate_identifier) treats the first backtick as the closing delimiter, ignoring escape characters that the SurrealQL parser honors. Attackers can supply MCP tool arguments containing an escaped backtick to break out of the quoted identifier and execute arbitrary SurrealQL statements.

items.title: CVE-2026-134291
items.summary: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in its filesystem storage bucket that only canonicalizes the bucket root, not descendant symlinks. Attackers can reference paths through a pre-existing symlink inside the bucket that pass the lexical prefix check, reading and writing files across the host filesystem.

items.title: CVE-2026-134288
items.summary: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows clients with table write access to persist writes refused by THROWing table events within interactive transactions. Attackers can run a guarded statement via RPC begin and query, ignore the returned error, and commit to persist the record and event side effects.

items.title: CVE-2026-134286
items.summary: OpenRemote from 1.2.0 before 1.34.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in AlarmFacade that allows restricted users with write:rules to create alarms for assets outside their ruleset subtree. Attackers can deploy a JSON asset-scoped ruleset using target.custom asset ids to create HIGH severity alarms and trigger operator notifications about arbitrary in-realm assets.

items.title: CVE-2026-134282
items.summary: Vikunja from 0.14.0 before 2.8.0 contains a mass assignment vulnerability that allows authenticated users to set json-hidden fields by sending XML request bodies to the v1 API. Attackers can set BackgroundFileID on project creation to download any stored file via the background endpoint, or create bots with IsAdmin set to gain instance-admin access.

items.title: CVE-2026-134281
items.summary: Vikunja from 2.2.0 before 2.8.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read other users' private projects through the tasks.overdue webhook payload. Attackers can register a personal tasks.overdue webhook with one subscribed overdue task, then receive project titles, descriptions, and owner IDs from other users' reminders at external URLs.

items.title: CVE-2026-134279
items.summary: Vikunja from 0.20.5 before 2.8.0 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the OpenID Connect callback in OpenIdAuth.vue that accepts a valueless state parameter. Attackers can send a crafted callback link with an empty state and their own authorization code to silently log victims into the attacker's account and view the victims' entered data.

items.title: CVE-2026-134278
items.summary: Vikunja 2.3.0 before 2.8.0 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation in the CSV migration module because it does not de-duplicate label column mappings or cap labels per row, and enforces the item limit only after the full import is built. Authenticated users can send one request to /api/v2/migration/csv/migrate with repeated label mappings or many labels per row, exhausting memory until the server is OOM-killed.

items.title: CVE-2026-134277
items.summary: Vikunja from 0.16.0 before 2.8.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that writes users' Trello API tokens to application logs and Sentry by formatting provider errors verbatim in listeners.go. When a Trello migration fails with a transport error, the URL error embeds the token query parameter, letting anyone with log or telemetry access obtain the reusable third-party credential.

items.title: CVE-2026-134275
items.summary: Vikunja from 0.8.0 before 2.8.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated project readers to amplify response size by repeating requested properties in CalDAV PROPFIND requests. Attackers can send PROPFIND requests to the dav projects endpoint with hundreds of duplicate calendar-data properties to exhaust server memory, CPU, and bandwidth.

items.title: CVE-2026-134272
items.summary: Vikunja from 0.9.0 before 2.8.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows project admins to view share creators' email addresses via the link share list endpoint. Attackers with admin permission can request the project shares endpoint and read the shared_by email field, exposing addresses of creators including former project members.

items.title: CVE-2026-134271
items.summary: Vikunja from 1.0.0 before 2.8.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows authenticated users to crash the server by uploading extreme-width images as task attachments. Attackers can request the attachment preview endpoint so Lanczos resampling allocates width-proportional weight tables, OOM-killing the process repeatedly with sub-megabyte PNGs.

items.title: CVE-2026-134270
items.summary: Vikunja from 0.19.0 before 2.8.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated CalDAV users to exhaust server CPU by uploading VTODO properties with many parameters. Attackers can PUT an iCalendar body with thousands of parameters on one line to any valid project ID, triggering superlinear parsing before permission checks.

items.title: CVE-2026-134267
items.summary: Vikunja from 0.21.0 before 2.8.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated users to exhaust memory and CPU by creating tasks with many reminders and long titles. Attackers can store a task whose ParseAlarms rendering in pkg/caldav/caldav.go uses quadratic string concatenation, causing every CalDAV read, including other members' automatic syncs, to allocate gigabytes.

items.title: CVE-2026-134266
items.summary: Vikunja from 0.19.0 before 2.8.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated users to exhaust CPU by supplying unbounded business-day operands in datemath filters. Attackers can send task or time-tracking filters like due_date > now+999999999999b, triggering a per-day loop in go-datemath that pins CPU cores and exhausts the server.

items.title: CVE-2026-134265
items.summary: Vikunja from 2.4.0 before 2.8.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the richtext converter that allows authenticated project writers to exhaust server memory and CPU by storing tables with unbounded rowspan and colspan values. Any project reader or CalDAV client can trigger the expansion through markdown task reads, CalDAV GETs, or the frontend editor, producing 100 MB responses from a 64-byte description.

items.title: CVE-2026-134264
items.summary: Admidio from 5.0.2 before 5.0.17 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows any logged-in member to read server files by placing local paths in img src attributes of eCard messages. Attackers can send an eCard to their own account so sendEcard() embeds files like adm_my_files/config.php via addEmbeddedImage(), disclosing database credentials and /etc/passwd.

items.title: CVE-2026-134261
items.summary: Admidio before 5.0.18 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in mylist.php that loads list configurations by the list_uuid parameter while checking only the organization, not the owner or private flag. Authenticated users with Lists module access who know a victim's list UUID can read its name, selected profile fields, sort order and filter conditions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134260
items.summary: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.18 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in modules/profile/profile_new.php that allows authenticated Group Leaders to bypass field-level profile restrictions. Attackers can request mode=html_selection to read restricted field values and submit mode=save requests to modify restricted member profile fields.

items.title: CVE-2026-134258
items.summary: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.18 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the Documents & Files renameFile() action that allows authenticated users with folder upload rights to move files outside adm_my_files by supplying ../ sequences in adm_new_name. Attackers can relocate an uploaded SVG containing script to the web root, where it is served inline and executes stored cross-site scripting against administrators for account takeover.

items.title: CVE-2026-134257
items.summary: Admidio before 5.0.18 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows attackers to keep account access after a forgot-password reset because User::setPassword() deletes sessions using the visitor ID instead of the reset user's usr_id. Attackers already holding a victim's session or remember-me cookie can continue using it after the victim resets the password, keeping authenticated access to the account.

items.title: CVE-2026-134256
items.summary: Admidio from 5.0.17 before 5.0.18 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated regular users to upload images into the announcements module by abusing the CKEditor upload handler. Attackers can send id=ann_description to ckeditor_upload_handler.php to store images under adm_my_files/announcements/images and retrieve them via show_image.php, abusing the application as an image host.

items.title: CVE-2026-134255
items.summary: Admidio from 5.0.17 before 5.0.18 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject JavaScript by saving a crafted value in their STREET profile field. Attackers can break out of the unencoded title attribute in members_assignment_data.php with an onmouseover handler that executes in the session of role managers hovering over the address icon.

items.title: CVE-2026-134254
items.summary: Admidio from 5.0.0 before 5.0.18 contains a path traversal vulnerability in DocumentsService::renameFile() that allows authenticated users to move files outside adm_my_files by supplying an unvalidated adm_new_name value. Attackers with folder upload permission can submit ../ sequences to file_rename_save to write files and create directories in arbitrary writable locations, including the web root.

items.title: CVE-2026-134251
items.summary: Grav API plugin from 1.0.16 before 1.1.11 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows scoped API key holders to override page permission rules because checks read the owning account's authority instead of the key's scopes. Attackers can use keys minted on super-admin accounts to edit, delete or read pages that deny those actions, or use media-scoped keys to change media on read-only pages.

items.title: CVE-2026-134250
items.summary: Grav Form plugin 1.1.0 before 9.1.40 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Form::uploadFiles(), which sanitizes SVG only when a file's last extension is .svg and accepts markup under unrecognized extensions. Anonymous attackers can upload files like drawing.svg.foo through public any-type upload forms, running script in an administrator's session when opened, enabling super-admin creation on Grav 2.x with Admin2.

items.title: CVE-2026-134248
items.summary: SiYuan 3.6.0 before 3.8.10 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated Readers to read protected documents through block-reference footnote resolution in Markdown export. Attackers can request copyStdMarkdown for a public document referencing a hidden, disabled, or password-protected document to disclose its body text without the publish password.

items.title: CVE-2026-134247
items.summary: SiYuan 3.8.0 before 3.8.10 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows anonymous attackers to read indexed asset text referenced only by publish-disabled attribute-view rows. Attackers can request /api/asset/getDocAssets on a public host document to obtain the leaked asset path, then query /api/search/getAssetContentByPath to retrieve the confidential file's full indexed text.

items.title: CVE-2026-134246
items.summary: SiYuan 3.6.0 before 3.6.2 and 3.7.3 before 3.8.10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the /api/block/getDOMText endpoint, which renders caller-supplied DOM without checking publish access for referenced image paths. When publish authentication is disabled, anonymous visitors can submit DOM referencing a known unpublished, non-encrypted asset path to retrieve its already-cached OCR text.

items.title: CVE-2026-133985
items.summary: A flaw has been found in TRENDnet TEW-657BRM 1.00.1. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /usr/sbin/restore_config.cgi. Executing a manipulation can lead to out-of-bounds read. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor explains: "I am not able to confirm if such vulnerability exists as the product has been EOL for more than 15 years. We will send out an announcement letting customers know." This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

items.title: CVE-2026-133983
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in eigent-ai eigent up to 1.0.2. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file backend/app/controller/chat_controller.py of the component Local Agent Control API. Performing a manipulation results in missing authentication. The attack may be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version 1.0.3 addresses this issue. The patch is named 59f43afcb1b0ba7b2de8c65d585124f196c4aa17. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-134460
items.summary: web-token jwt-framework 1.2.0 before 3.4.10, jwt-experimental before 3.4.10, 4.0.x before 4.0.7, and 4.1.x before 4.1.7 contain a missing integrity check in the experimental Chacha20Poly1305 key-encryption algorithm, which discards the Poly1305 tag in encryptKey() and calls openssl_decrypt() without it in decryptKey(). Attackers on the token path can modify the encrypted content encryption key undetected.

items.title: CVE-2026-134459
items.summary: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.10, 4.0.x before 4.0.7, and 4.1.x before 4.1.7 contain a padding oracle in RSACrypt::decryptWithRSA15() because RSA1_5 decryption lacks implicit rejection, so invalid padding, wrong CEK length, and valid padding take measurably different time. Remote attackers can submit adaptively crafted JWE encrypted_key values and measure these timing differences to recover the wrapped content encryption key.

items.title: CVE-2026-134458
items.summary: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.12, 4.0.x before 4.0.8, 4.1.x before 4.1.10, and 4.2.x before 4.2.4, and jwt-encryption-algorithm-ecdh-es through 3.2.10, have a ConcatKDF::generate() that performs a single SHA-256 round, deriving at most 32 bytes for ECDH-ES and ECDH-SS direct key agreement. Anyone holding a JWE using A256CBC-HS512 can decrypt it under an all-zero AES key, while A192CBC-HS384 content keys have only 64-bit strength.

items.title: CVE-2026-134452
items.summary: Dockhand before 1.0.57 merges stack secret environment variables into the environment used to spawn docker compose during stack deploys without filtering reserved keys such as PATH. An authenticated attacker with stacks:edit permission can set PATH to a directory containing a malicious binary and trigger a deploy, executing arbitrary commands as the Dockhand server process user.

items.title: CVE-2026-129850
items.summary: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. In versions 4.0.0 through 4.0.9, when Fastify routing is configured to be case-insensitive, the router folds the request path to lower case in a way that maps certain non-ASCII Unicode characters to ASCII letters, but @fastify/express matches Express mount paths against the decoded path without applying the same folding. The two disagree, so a request that spells a letter of a mount path with an equivalent Unicode character is routed to the protected handler while the path-scoped middle…

items.title: CVE-2026-129504
items.summary: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. In versions 4.0.0 through 4.0.9, the plugin joins a path-scoped middleware's mount path to the Fastify plugin prefix by string concatenation, so when the plugin prefix ends with a slash or the mount path omits its leading slash, the resulting Express mount path does not line up with the route the Fastify router serves. Express then fails to match and passes the request on while the Fastify router still dispatches the route, so the middleware is silently skipped. An application that uses…

items.title: CVE-2026-134407
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains an authorization flaw in the customer portal Issue list, which scopes records differently from the detail view and skips permission checks on requested records. Authenticated users, including portal users without roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other customers' Issues.

items.title: CVE-2026-134399
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 8.11.1 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 is missing an authorization check in print and portal views, which fail to apply desk users' User Permissions to customer documents. Authenticated desk users with an ordinary job role can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read documents of customers their User Permissions exclude.

items.title: CVE-2026-133312
items.summary: @fastify/rate-limit is the rate-limiting plugin for the Fastify web framework. Starting in version 11.1.0, the plugin documented a manual flow for limiting failed login attempts that peeks at the limiter, runs the password check, and consumes a slot only on failure. Because the peek and the consume are two separate store operations with the password check in between, concurrent requests can all pass the peek before any slot is consumed, so in versions 11.1.0 through 11.2.2 a burst of requests runs far more failed attempts than the configured limit, and the sequential path also allowed one atte…

items.title: CVE-2026-133867
items.summary: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. In versions 4.0.7 through 4.0.9, the plugin does not rewrite regular-expression mount paths to account for a parameterized plugin prefix, so when middleware is mounted with a regular expression inside a plugin registered under a parameterized prefix, the Express matcher treats the prefix parameter as literal text and never matches the real request path. As a result, Express silently skips that middleware while Fastify still runs the route handler, so an application that relies on regula…

items.title: CVE-2026-134363
items.summary: Coder 2.32.0 before 2.34.17, 2.35.0 before 2.36.12, 2.37.0 before 2.37.9, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.5 contain a symlink-following flaw in the Coder Agents read_skill_file tool, which validates skill file paths lexically but follows symlinks outside the skill directory. Attackers who place a malicious skill containing a symlinked supporting file in a victim's workspace can leak other workspace files into the model context and chat history when the victim runs a chat using that skill.

items.title: CVE-2026-134360
items.summary: Heym before 0.0.148 passes Playwright navigate-step URLs to page.goto() without validating the scheme and runs step-based scripts inside the backend container. A signed-in user who can run workflows can navigate to file:// URLs and use getText to read known-path files such as the Kubernetes ServiceAccount token or Docker secrets.

items.title: CVE-2026-134359
items.summary: AzuraCast before 0.24.1 fails to escape backslashes in Liquidsoap annotation values, allowing media managers to break out of quoted annotation strings. Attackers can set a crafted ID3 title ending in a backslash to inject a process: protocol URI, achieving OS command execution in the Liquidsoap container during playback.

items.title: CVE-2026-134354
items.summary: rclone from 1.59.0 before 1.76.0 contains a confinement escape in the local backend's setXattr function that lets attackers write user.* extended attributes outside the destination root via a planted symlink. Attackers who plant a symlink to an outside directory with a pre-existing child can use --links --metadata operations to set attacker-chosen user.* xattrs on files outside the destination.

items.title: CVE-2026-134353
items.summary: rclone before 1.76.0 leaks credentials in its swift, netstorage and seafile backends, which follow HTTP redirects using Go's default policy: swift and netstorage send auth headers or passwords on cross-host or HTTPS-to-HTTP redirects, and seafile sends API tokens or passwords on same-host HTTPS-to-HTTP redirects. Attackers receiving or observing a redirect issued by the configured endpoint can capture these credentials to access storage or replay signed requests.

items.title: CVE-2026-134329
items.summary: ArcadeDB 26.2.1 before 26.11.1 contains an observable response discrepancy in MCPToolUtils.resolveDatabase, which checks database existence before authorization and returns distinct 'not authorized' and 'does not exist' errors; separately, a failed Bolt LOGON from READY leaves the previous principal bound after RESET. Authenticated MCP callers can enumerate names of databases they are not granted by probing tools such as query or get_schema.

items.title: CVE-2026-134321
items.summary: better-auth from 0.8.1-beta.5 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5, and @better-auth/passkey from 1.6.25 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5, let revoked sessions stay valid because secondary storage session lists are updated non-atomically and some routes trust cookie-cached sessions. An attacker holding a valid session can evade bulk revocation or bans, or use a revoked cached session to register a passkey or create a lasting session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134320
items.summary: @better-auth/passkey 1.4.0-beta.16 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5, and the passkey plugin in better-auth 1.2.0-beta.18 before 1.4.0, do not confirm WebAuthn user verification when userVerification is "required" and take the expected origin from the request instead of configuration. Users can register or use passkeys without the required PIN or biometric check, and passkey responses created on another origin under the same relying party ID may be accepted.

items.title: CVE-2026-134316
items.summary: @better-auth/electron 1.5.0-beta.12 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 accepts any validly signed value as its transfer cookie and returns the full endpoint context, including the auth secret and social provider client secrets, in sign-in responses. Authenticated users can obtain these secrets to forge sessions as other users. Attackers knowing a password can exchange desktop authorization codes issued before two-factor verification to bypass the second factor.

items.title: CVE-2026-134313
items.summary: Better Auth (better-auth, @better-auth/kysely-adapter, and @better-auth/drizzle-adapter) before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains a race condition with MySQL or MariaDB serial IDs because the inserted row's ID is read via a separate LAST_INSERT_ID() query that may run on a different pooled connection. Under concurrent load, a user signing in can receive another user's session and act as that user.

items.title: CVE-2026-134298
items.summary: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass that allows users with the read-only VIEWER role to modify database schema, because CREATE on a nonexistent table implicitly defines it without the DEFINE TABLE permission check applied to explicit definitions. Authenticated VIEWER users can issue CREATE statements in non-STRICT databases to add arbitrary empty SCHEMALESS tables, cluttering schemas or colliding with application table names.

items.title: CVE-2026-134292
items.summary: SurrealDB 1.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a capability check bypass in its embedded JavaScript scripting engine, where the surrealdb.functions bridge calls the internal fnc::synchronous() and fnc::asynchronous() dispatchers without enforcing function capability checks. Authenticated users denied access to built-in functions in SurrealQL can execute them by calling them through surrealdb.functions from embedded JavaScript.

items.title: CVE-2026-134290
items.summary: SurrealDB 2.2.0 before 4.0.0 includes the record id of a referencing row in the error returned when a delete is blocked by an ON DELETE REJECT reference, without checking the caller's SELECT permission on that row. An authenticated principal with DELETE permission can attempt to delete a referenced record and read the rejection error to learn the existence and exact ids of referencing records hidden by row-level SELECT permissions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134289

items.title: CVE-2026-134280

items.title: CVE-2026-134276

items.title: CVE-2026-134243

items.title: CVE-2026-134242
