items.title: CVE-2026-129814
items.summary: The SDO Information Get Object Description and Get Entry Description responses copy the object or entry name into the mailbox data area and then write a null terminator byte. The copy loops ran up to the last available byte in the buffer, leaving no room for the terminator. When an object or entry name exactly fills the available space the terminator is written one byte past the end of the mailbox data buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129813
items.summary: The CoE complete-access download handler iterated over all subindices of an object and wrote the master-supplied payload into each writable entry. Entries that hold a constant have write-access flags set but carry a NULL data pointer. The handler did not check for this and wrote the master payload through the NULL pointer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129812
items.summary: An object dictionary entry that holds a constant has no process data storage and carries a NULL data pointer. sizeOfPDO did not check for this when resolving a mapped entry to its descriptor. A master that maps such an entry to a PDO causes COE_pdoPack or COE_pdoUnpack to dereference the NULL data pointer on every process data exchange after the mapping is activated.

items.title: CVE-2026-129811
items.summary: The PDO mapping bit lengths stored in the mapping objects are writable by the master via SDO. sizeOfPDO summed them without checking the total against the size of the rxpdo[] or txpdo[] process data buffers. A master can craft a mapping whose total bit count exceeds those buffers, causing COE_pdoPack and COE_pdoUnpack to write past their ends during each process data cycle after the PREOP to SAFEOP transition.

items.title: CVE-2026-129810
items.summary: ESC_eoeprocess and ESC_eoeprocess_tx can be reached before the application calls EOE_config to supply the callback table pointer. When eoe_cfg is NULL the receive handler dereferenced it while processing an incoming EoE frame, and the transmit polling function dereferenced it on each cycle, causing NULL pointer dereferences.

items.title: CVE-2026-129809
items.summary: ESC_foeprocess can be reached by an incoming mailbox frame before the application calls FOE_config to supply the file table and flush buffer pointers. When foe_cfg or its fbuffer field is NULL the handler dereferenced those pointers while processing the frame, causing a NULL pointer dereference.

items.title: CVE-2026-129808
items.summary: The EoE receive and transmit paths call the handle_recv_buffer and fetch_send_buffer callbacks without first checking whether they are set. Both callbacks are documented as optional; an application that omits either one causes a call through a NULL function pointer when the first EoE frame arrives or when the transmit polling loop runs.

items.title: CVE-2026-129807
items.summary: The FoE file table allows entries to omit a write handler by setting write_function to NULL, making the file read-only. FOE_fopen did not check whether write_function was present before accepting a write request; a master sending a WRQ for a read-only file caused a call through a NULL function pointer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129806
items.summary: The CoE SDO upload handler enters its normal-response path (used for objects longer than 4 bytes) and passes (objd + nsub)->data directly to the pre-object handler and to the response copy. Entries that hold a constant in the value field have data set to NULL; a master can request such an entry and cause a NULL pointer dereference in the upload path.

items.title: CVE-2026-129805
items.summary: An object dictionary entry can carry write-access flags and still have a NULL data pointer, for example when a constant value is held in the value field rather than in addressable storage. The CoE SDO download handler checked write access but not whether storage was present, then wrote the master-supplied payload through the NULL pointer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129804
items.summary: FOE_read and FOE_write store the filename length as uint8_t, truncating it modulo 256. When (mbxheader.length - ESC_FOEHSIZE) is a multiple of 256, the length becomes 0. Additionally, a request whose mailbox length equals ESC_FOEHSIZE exactly also produces a length of 0 without any truncation. In both cases FOE_fopen calls strncmp with a length of 0, which always returns equal, so the first registered file whose password is 0 is opened regardless of the filename the master sent.

items.title: CVE-2026-129803
items.summary: The CoE entry gate accepts frames with mbxheader.length as low as COE_MINIMUM_LENGTH (8), but a normal SDO Download requires at least COE_HEADERSIZE (10) bytes of CoE payload to carry its header fields. With mbxheader.length of 8 or 9, the segmented-transfer branch misevaluates due to unsigned wrap, leaving the declared SDO size unclamped. copy2mbx then reads that many bytes starting past the end of the actual payload and writes them into the object buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129802
items.summary: EOE_set_ip reads each network parameter field (MAC, IP, subnet, gateway, DNS IP, DNS name) from the mailbox payload before checking whether the payload is large enough to contain them. The single bounds check at the end of the function does not prevent the reads from happening. A master can send a Set-IP frame with all flags set and mbxheader.length equal to the minimum, causing all reads to access memory past the end of the payload.

items.title: CVE-2026-129801
items.summary: The FoE DATA frame handler computes the payload length from the master-supplied mailbox length field and passes it directly to FOE_fwrite. The length is checked against the remaining file capacity but not against the physical mailbox buffer size. A master can declare a large length while sending a short frame, causing FOE_fwrite to read past the end of the mailbox buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129800
items.summary: sizeOfPDO, called during state transitions, uses the subindex-0 count of the SM-assign and PDO-mapping objects as loop bounds without checking those counts against the descriptor array sizes. On builds where those subindex-0 values are writable via SDO, a master can write 0xFF and cause sizeOfPDO to read past the end of the descriptor arrays on the next transition to SAFEOP.

items.title: CVE-2026-129799
items.summary: A CoE SDO request for index 0xFFFF matches the object list terminator entry instead of returning not-found. The terminator has a NULL objdesc pointer. Callers dereference it without checking, crashing the slave.

items.title: CVE-2026-129798
items.summary: The CoE SDO segmented download handler advances a write pointer by each incoming segment's size but does not track how many bytes have been written in total. A master can keep sending non-last segments until the pointer has walked past the end of the object buffer or the complete-access staging buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129797
items.summary: SDO_downloadsegment is called whenever a mailbox frame carries the DOWNLOADSEGREQ command byte, regardless of whether a segmented download is actually in progress. ESCvar.data, which the handler writes through, is NULL until a segmented transfer is started. A master can send a DOWNLOADSEGREQ at any time and write through a NULL or stale pointer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129796
items.summary: The CoE SDO download handler for flexible-length objects (VISIBLE_STRING, OCTET_STRING, and similar) does not check that the master-declared transfer size fits within the object before writing. Two distinct writes are affected: the VISIBLE_STRING zero-padding memset and the first-frame copy into the object buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129795
items.summary: When the last EoE fragment has the TIME_APPEND flag set, the handler subtracts 4 from rxframeoffset to strip the timestamp. There is no check that rxframeoffset is at least 4. A fragment carrying fewer than 4 bytes of payload that is also marked LAST causes rxframeoffset to wrap to 0xFFFFFFFC, which is then stored as the buffer length and handed to the TCP/IP stack.

items.title: CVE-2026-129794
items.summary: The EoE fragment reassembly code uses a frame size from the wire as the bound for memcpy into the application receive buffer, without checking that the declared size fits in the actual buffer. A master can write up to 2016 bytes into a buffer the application may have sized much smaller.

items.title: CVE-2026-59987
items.summary: Avahi is a system which facilitates service discovery on a local network via the mDNS/DNS-SD protocol suite. In 0.9-rc4 and earlier, org.freedesktop.Avahi.Server.RecordBrowserNew accepts a domain-name value that avahi_is_valid_domain_name considers valid even though avahi_normalize_name_strdup cannot normalize it. The resulting null key reaches the key assertion in dbus_prepare_record_browser_object. A local low-privileged D-Bus client can trigger the mismatch and terminate the Avahi daemon, causing denial of service. The issue is fixed in 0.9-rc5.

items.title: CVE-2026-132665
items.summary: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the pem.deploy_job_template() function does not check that the caller can access the servers, groups and agents it deploys a job template to. When PEM teams are used to separate access, a user with the scheduled tasks role (pem_manage_schedule_task) can deploy and schedule SQL or shell job steps on agents that belong to other teams. From PEM 10.6.1, PEM checks team access for every server, group and agent a template is deployed to.

items.title: CVE-2026-132664
items.summary: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), any PEM user can read the encrypted passwords that PEM agents use to connect to monitored servers, including the PEM backend superuser password stored when the PEM server is configured. Unless a custom encryption key is configured, these passwords are encrypted with a key that is the same in every PEM installation, so they can be decrypted. From PEM 10.6.1, PEM users can no longer read these passwords.

items.title: CVE-2026-132663
items.summary: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), webhook URLs are not validated, and the PEM agent does not restrict the URL schemes it uses to deliver webhooks. A user with the alert configuration role (pem_config_alert) can set up a webhook with a file:// URL. When the webhook is sent, the agent on the PEM server, which runs as root by default, reads the local file and stores its contents in the webhook error record in the PEM database, where any PEM user can read it. From PEM 10.6.1, PEM accepts and sends only http and https webhook URLs.

items.title: CVE-2026-132662
items.summary: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the SQL Profiler save and load functions in the PEM web application do not keep the client-supplied file name inside the user's storage directory. A user with the SQL Profiler role (pem_comp_sqlprofiler) can read JSON files, and overwrite files that the PEM web server account can write, outside their own storage directory. Overwriting the PEM web application's configuration database stops the web console for all users. From PEM 10.6.1, the SQL Profiler only reads and writes files inside the user's storage directory.

items.title: CVE-2026-132658
items.summary: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the pem_agent role, which every PEM agent login inherits, is a member of the PostgreSQL pg_read_server_files and pg_write_server_files roles on the PEM backend database. An attacker who controls any monitored host, and so its PEM agent certificate, can read and write files on the PEM server host as the postgres operating system user. This includes the PEM certificate authority key, which lets the attacker issue certificates for other agents and act as them. From PEM 10.6.1, PEM agents no longer hold these roles.

items.title: CVE-2026-133622
items.summary: A flaw was found in certmonger. This vulnerability allows a malicious certificate authority or an attacker positioned on an unencrypted network to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by sending oversized or deliberately slow responses. Certmonger fails to enforce size limits or transfer timeouts when downloading and buffering Simple Certificate Enrollment Protocol (SCEP) replies over HTTP. Consequently, an attacker can exhaust host memory, drive CPU usage to capacity, or cause certificate requests to hang indefinitely.

An offset of 2^63 or more is negative and passes "offset > limit". A length above the limit, such as NFS4_UINT64_MAX, wraps "offset > limit - length" and stays unclamped. This needs "xfs: cap the block count of xfs_iomap_write_direct() at one extent".

As a result, an attacker who is able to send a crafted message to a victim could cause the application to crash when the message is received or displayed. A server-side mitigation has been deployed that also protects existing iOS clients that have not been updated to version 26.19.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-133228
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. When a client application enforces step-up authentication or multi-factor authentication (MFA) via a minimum authentication level, Keycloak fails to apply this requirement to login sessions initiated through the credential reset endpoint. An attacker who possesses a user's initial credentials (such as a password) can navigate from the reset interface back to the standard login form and authenticate without completing the required second factor. This flaw allows an attacker to obtain valid access tokens and gain unauthorized access to protected services without sat…

items.title: CVE-2026-133225
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. When processing token requests using the User-Managed Access (UMA) grant, Keycloak fails to verify whether a target client or resource server is enabled before issuing an authorization token. An authenticated remote user can exploit this flaw to obtain valid Requesting Party Tokens (RPTs) for disabled clients, bypassing administrative access controls and permissions restrictions.

items.title: CVE-2026-133224
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. When an administrator revokes tokens by setting a not-before revocation cutoff, Keycloak fails to enforce this boundary when processing User-Managed Access (UMA) grant requests using ID token claims. An authenticated remote user with an active session can submit a previously revoked ID token to receive a fresh Requesting Party Token (RPT). This flaw allows an attacker to bypass token revocation and retain unauthorized access to protected resources.

items.title: CVE-2025-71473
items.summary: lwext4 through 1.0.0 contains a heap buffer overflow in ext4_fs_init_inode_bitmap() in src/ext4_fs.c because it does not validate s_inodes_per_group against the inode bitmap size. Attackers can supply a crafted ext4 image with an oversized s_inodes_per_group so memset writes past the heap buffer, corrupting memory and crashing the mounting application.

items.title: CVE-2026-133528
items.summary: BeamNG.drive before 0.40.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability because JIT-compiled LuaJIT traces omit FFI array bounds checks, letting untrusted Lua escape the sandbox. Attackers supplying a malicious mod can JIT-compile an FFI store loop, write out of range using a tostring() address leak, re-enable ffi.load, and run commands as the game user.

items.title: CVE-2026-133521
items.summary: Bar Assistant 3.0.0 before 6.11.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in BarController::join that allows authenticated users to join bars without a valid invite code. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/bars/join omitting invite_code, matching invite-disabled bars with NULL codes, to read cocktails, ingredients, members, settings and search tokens.

items.title: CVE-2026-133519
items.summary: FFmpeg 7.0 through 9.0.2 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dvdvideo_menu_next_ps_block() in libavformat/dvdvideodec.c when demuxing DVD menu domains. Attackers can craft a DVD image whose last cell sector and NAV next-VOBU pointer bypass the end-of-cell check, overreading pgc->cell_playback and crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2025-71474
items.summary: lwext4 through 1.0.0 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in ext4_fs_init_block_bitmap() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted superblock geometry fields. Attackers can supply an ext4 image with oversized s_reserved_gdt_blocks and BLOCK_UNINIT groups to write past the bitmap buffer, crashing applications that mount it.

items.title: CVE-2026-131877
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via unbounded arc length in OBJECT IDENTIFIER decoding and encoding. The content of an OBJECT IDENTIFIER or RELATIVE-OID element is passed to unpack "w*" on decode, and the arcs of an OID string to pack "w*" on encode. Perl converts each arc to or from its decimal string in time quadratic in the arc's length, and nothing limits that length. An attacker who controls the decoded data, or an OID string passed to encode, can exhaust CPU with a single oversized arc.

items.title: CVE-2026-131868
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via a declared element length passed unchecked to sysread in asn_read and asn_get. The length an element declares in its BER header is passed to sysread as the read size. Perl grows the target buffer to that size before reading, so memory is allocated from the declared length, not from the data received. A 6-byte header can declare a length of up to 4GB. A single header makes the reading process allocate the declared size. Where the allocation fails, perl exits with "Out of memory", which eval cannot catch.

items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with permission to author and run playbooks could add messages to a different playbook run log and cause that run to fail, including runs outside the labels that the user could access. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not verify that playbook API requests use the trusted runtime context for the current playbook run.

items.title: CVE-2026-131295
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to create and run playbooks could start child playbooks on containers outside the authorized label, or repository scope for that user. This could expose container data and affect automation outside that scope. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not bind the identity used to authorize the child playbook run to the parent playbook execution context.

items.title: CVE-2026-131294
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user who can edit and run playbooks on a container label could associate a custom-function callback with another playbook run. The callback could modify the state of a container outside the authorized scope for that user. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not bind playbook API requests to the trusted playbook run and container context.

items.title: CVE-2026-131293
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to edit and run playbooks could read or overwrite persisted data for playbook runs outside the authorized label, or ownership scope for that user. The affected data can include playbook inputs, prompt and block results, outputs, and secrets that playbooks save in run data. Overwriting the data could corrupt results that paused, scheduled, or parent playbook runs later use. The vulnerability is possible because the playbook automation APIs do not bind data operations to the active playbook run.

items.title: CVE-2026-133201
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in smartalock wireguard-lwip up to cfba91666590e86bd67842c71cedf9a423be823a. Impacted is the function mul of the file src/crypto/refc/x25519.c of the component X25519 Ladder. Executing a manipulation can lead to out-of-bounds write. The attack can be executed remotely. This product implements a rolling release for ongoing delivery, which means version information for affected or updated releases is unavailable. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-126956
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via unlimited recursion depth in constructed-form string decoding. Any constructed-form string element causes the decoder to recurse on the element's contents. The BER encoding controls nesting depth at four bytes per level, with no bound checked. Perl recursion is heap-allocated, so the process grows without a stack crash. An attacker who controls the decoded data can exhaust memory with a small deeply nested constructed string.

Perl reads a negative length as an offset from the end of the string, so the decoded value is nearly all of the input that follows the element. In the constructed form each zero-length segment copies the rest of the input again, so memory grows with the square of the input size. An attacker who controls the decoded data can exhaust memory with a short constructed BIT STRING. The resulting value also contains bytes from…

items.title: CVE-2026-126682
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via exponent-notation string in INTEGER encoding. The encoder routes any value with abs >= 2**31 to i2osp without validating that it is an integer. A string in exponent notation such as "1e8000" passes that threshold. Math::BigInt expands it to an 8001-digit integer, and i2osp's per-octet conversion loop is quadratic in that size. An attacker who controls encoded INTEGER values can exhaust CPU with a short exponent-notation string.

An inverted boolean guard ($tb || rather than $tb &&) prevents the need-more-data exit from firing once a tag byte has been decoded. When asn_decode_length returns no value because the length is absent or incomplete, no exit fires for that case either. MSG_PEEK leaves socket data unconsumed, so each re-peek returns at once while the buffer size doubles. A single t…

items.title: CVE-2026-126540
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via quadratic bigint loop in os2ip. Every INTEGER or ENUMERATED longer than four content octets reaches os2ip, which iterates over each content octet with $result = ($result * 256) + $octet. Each multiplication operates on a bigint that grows by one octet per step, so decoding an n-octet value takes O(n^2) bigint work. Nothing limits content length before this loop runs. An attacker who controls the decoded data can exhaust CPU with a single oversized INTEGER or ENUMERATED value.

items.title: CVE-2026-131291
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a Splunk SOAR user who can edit and run playbooks for a permitted container label could associate action and callback state with a running playbook outside that container label. This could affect playbook automation for containers that the user cannot view. The vulnerability is possible because the Playbook Automation API accepts a supplied playbook run identifier without verifying that it is bound to the server-provided playbook execution context. The vulnerability requires a running playbook on a container label that the user cannot view.

items.title: CVE-2026-131290
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to edit and run playbooks could view child playbook status and loop-state metadata for playbook runs outside the authorized scope for that user. The vulnerability is possible because the playbook status API does not bind the requested run to the current execution context before it returns metadata.

items.title: CVE-2026-131289
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user who holds a role that can edit and run playbooks in Splunk SOAR could cause Splunk SOAR to run non-read-only actions from a Safe Mode playbook, resulting in unauthorized state changes. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not verify that the playbook run context in an action request matches the context that the server provided.

items.title: CVE-2026-131288
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with access to the configured load balancer account could replace a load balancer helper that Splunk SOAR later runs with root privileges during cluster lifecycle operations. If a Splunk SOAR administrator performs a cluster lifecycle operation, Splunk SOAR could execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the load balancer. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not verify the integrity or ownership of the load balancer helper before running it with root privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-131286
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to author and run playbooks could view action data outside the authorized scope for that user and change the status and message of another playbook run. The vulnerability is possible because the playbook API does not verify that the requested playbook run is within the authorized scope of the authenticated user.

items.title: CVE-2026-131285
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user who can edit and run playbooks could cause automation batches for other events to stop running. The vulnerability occurs because Splunk SOAR does not bind playbook API requests to the server-provided execution context.

items.title: CVE-2026-131283

items.title: CVE-2026-131282

items.title: CVE-2026-131281

items.title: CVE-2026-131269

When using scoped child clients, a subsequent scoped request can overwrite the shared client configuration. items.title: CVE-2026-130153
items.summary: The Okta Client SDK for Python (okta-client-python) includes client authentication values (client_secret or JWT assertions) as query parameters in the front-channel authorization URL when executing the authorization code flow without Pushed Authorization Requests (PAR). When PAR is disabled, unsupported by the authorization server, or fails, the SDK falls back to standard authorization URL construction, transmitting these parameters via user-agent requests.

items.title: CVE-2026-130151
items.summary: Okta Privileged Access (OPA) Gateway includes a version of the FreeRDP library affected by memory management issues in its smartcard redirection handling. When an RDP session is established meeting specific session criteria, command execution within the context of the local Gateway service account may be allowed.

items.title: CVE-2026-133189
items.summary: A command injection vulnerability was found in OpenStack Cinder's SSH-based storage-driver support. Incomplete validation of shell metacharacters allows an authenticated user who owns a volume on an affected backend to supply crafted connection information and inject additional commands into the storage array's management interface. Commands execute with the privileges of Cinder's configured backend account. This can disclose storage configuration information and, where that account has administrative permissions, could allow changes that affect the integrity or availability of other tenants'…

items.title: CVE-2026-69261
items.summary: Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. From 0.5.0 until 3.8.1, Git LFS may forward a Cookie header after an HTTP redirect to a host other than the one for which the header was intended. That unintended host can therefore receive cookies containing credentials or other confidential values. Authorization headers are never forwarded to inappropriate hosts and are not the affected secret in this vulnerability. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-18883
items.summary: ServiceNow has addressed an indirect prompt injection security issue that was identified in the Email Response AI Agent of Now Assist for CSM. We are not currently aware of malicious exploitation against ServiceNow instances. This remediation was deployed centrally to the Email Response AI Agent (Now Assist for CSM) and does not require a platform version upgrade or hot fix; no version-specific backports apply.

items.title: CVE-2026-131292
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user who can edit and run a playbook on a permitted label could cause Splunk SOAR to return custom-function status and callback state from another playbook run. The issue results from insufficient binding between a custom-function-status request and the playbook run that initiates it.

An authenticated operator can therefore access /baser/api/admin/ endpoints whose permission.php entries have auth => true, including /baser/api/admin/baser-core/site_configs/view.json, even when the corresponding administrative functionality is restricted. items.title: CVE-2026-129933
items.summary: The MongoDB Java Driver does not neutralize NUL characters in the user name and password values it places into the message it builds for SASL PLAIN authentication. A party who can choose the login values that an application passes to the driver can alter where the fields of that message begin and end. This may result in a receiving system reading a login name and secret that differ from the values the application supplied. Authenticating as a different account still requires that account's password. Only deployments that use SASL PLAIN authentication are affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-129931
items.summary: A component of the MongoDB Java Driver that processes connection configuration places credential values taken from that configuration into generated text and error output without replacing them with a placeholder, unlike other parts of the driver. A party able to read output produced by an application that embeds the driver may obtain database or proxy credentials in clear text.

Prior to 3.11.1, the Cosign validator counts valid signature layers rather than distinct trust roots for trustRoot: "*" policies using an explicit threshold or an implicit require-all policy. An attacker who controls one configured trust root's signing key and can attach multiple signatures to an image can satisfy a threshold intended to require multiple independent roots, causing admission without the intended signer quorum. items.title: CVE-2026-133310
items.summary: Wing FTP Server before 8.2.8 contains a file mask bypass vulnerability allowing attackers to upload restricted files via an embedded NUL byte in Upload Link filenames. Attackers can plant a Lua session file with a chosen UID and send a matching UID cookie to execute operating system commands as the service account.

items.title: CVE-2026-133309
items.summary: @scalar/typebox before 0.1.4 contains a code injection vulnerability in TypeCompiler that allows attackers to execute JavaScript by supplying crafted schema strings. Attackers can inject single-quote breakouts into string format, Kind names, property keys or Literal values to run arbitrary JavaScript in the host Node.js process during Compile() and Check().

items.title: CVE-2026-133308
items.summary: ClassiCube before 1.4.0 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds write vulnerability in Png_Reconstruct in src/Bitmap.c that occurs when AVERAGE and PAETH filters process zero-width PNG images. A malicious multiplayer server can supply a crafted texture pack URL or player skin to write past the heap buffer, corrupting memory and crashing connecting clients.

items.title: CVE-2026-133307
items.summary: ClassiCube before 1.4.0 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds write vulnerability in Png_Decode in src/Bitmap.c that allows malicious servers to corrupt client memory by sending a PNG with a duplicate IHDR chunk. Attackers can supply crafted PNGs via texture pack URLs or player skins so the unreset bufferIdx underflows remaining space, letting IDAT data overflow the buffer to crash clients or execute code.

items.title: CVE-2026-133305
items.summary: sqlmap before 1.10.11.89 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that allows attackers to capture user-supplied Cookie and Authorization headers by redirecting requests to another host. Attackers controlling the scanned target or abusing an open redirect can make RedirectHandler.http_error_302 forward session cookies or bearer tokens to an attacker-controlled host.

items.title: CVE-2026-131276

items.title: CVE-2026-131274
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with the system_settings permission could change event custom field definitions without the changes appearing in the audit trail, reducing forensic visibility and change accountability. The issue occurs because Splunk SOAR does not audit custom field definition changes.

items.title: CVE-2026-77380
items.summary: Bolt is a fully open source, adaptable platform for building and running modern websites. Prior to 6.1.5, the /bolt/async/upload-url and /bolt/async/embed endpoints validate only a submitted URL before fetching it server-side. The fetchers then follow redirects without revalidating each destination, allowing an authenticated user to bypass UrlSafetyChecker and cause the server to request internal or cloud-metadata addresses. This issue is fixed in version 6.1.5.

items.title: CVE-2026-77378
items.summary: Bolt is a fully open source, adaptable platform for building and running modern websites. Prior to 6.1.4, SQL injection in ListFormatHelper allows authenticated users with upload permission to execute arbitrary SQL queries through /async/select-options and exfiltrate sensitive database contents when general/caching/list_format is enabled. This issue is fixed in version 6.1.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-77377
items.summary: Bolt is a fully open source, adaptable platform for building and running modern websites. Prior to 6.1.4, the authenticated URL-upload endpoint and authenticated embed endpoint fetch user-supplied URLs server-side without protection against internal targets, allowing an attacker with the applicable backend permission to cause the Bolt server to request those targets. This issue is fixed in version 6.1.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-77376
items.summary: Bolt is a fully open source, adaptable platform for building and running modern websites. Prior to 6.1.4, LoginFormAuthenticator accepts unsafe destinations for the login success redirect and login failure redirect. An attacker can direct a user to an attacker-controlled domain after authentication succeeds or fails, enabling phishing and potential token theft. This issue is fixed in version 6.1.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-99349
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: rxrpc: Fix lack of short-send handling in rxrpc_kernel_send_data() Fix rxrpc_kernel_send_data() to loop around if it detects a short send. David Laight suggested doing it here rather than wrapping all the calls in loops. Further, remove the len argument and use the iterator count instead and return 0 on success, not the amount copied. Note this is also a prerequisite for changing the way rxrpc_send_data() works to return a short send rather than an error if some data was buffered.

items.title: CVE-2026-99348
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: afs: Fix afs to abort the rxrpc call on send error Fix afs_send_empty_reply() and afs_send_simple_reply() to always try to abort the rxrpc call rather than just aborting on -ENOMEM and otherwise abandoning it. If the call is already complete due to network failure or a received abort, this will do nothing. We recommend customers promptly apply appropriate updates or upgrade to a patched release if they have not already done so.

items.title: CVE-2026-99332
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: HID: core: Fix out-of-bounds left shift by 32 in s32ton() Syzbot reported an out-of-bounds shift (32-bit integer shifted left by 32) in the s32ton() routine in the HID core. This will avoid calculating (1 << n) when n is 32, which was the cause of the invalid shift.

items.title: CVE-2026-133245
items.summary: parse5 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains an uncaught exception vulnerability in Preprocessor#_processSurrogate that allows remote attackers to crash applications by supplying two consecutive low surrogates. Attackers can submit input such as U+DC00 U+DC00, which decodes to out-of-range code point 0x110000 and throws a RangeError from parse, parseFragment, or streaming parsers, crashing Node.js processes.

items.title: CVE-2026-133244
items.summary: parse5-html-rewriting-stream 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in RewritingStream#emitText, which skips escaping based on a stale lastStartTagName. Attackers can place entity-encoded markup after a closed script or style element to bypass RewritingStream-based filters and execute script in users' browsers.

items.title: CVE-2026-133242
items.summary: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject script by crafting og:video:secure_url values. Attackers can post links to pages whose allowlisted-prefix video URL contains a quote and onload handler, executing script in readers' sessions when they click the video preview.

items.title: CVE-2026-133240
items.summary: OpnForm before 2.8.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in PublicWebhookUrl::isPublicIp that fails to reject CGNAT, NAT64 and 6to4 address ranges. Authenticated users can configure webhook, form import or PDF image URLs resolving to these ranges to make the server send HTTPS requests to internal hosts.

items.title: CVE-2026-133238
items.summary: SABnzbd through 5.1.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the Sorter that allows attackers to write files outside the Complete folder via crafted propername, episodename or job name (%dn) values. Attackers can supply a malicious NZB with '...' sequences that collapse to '..' after single-pass replacement, moving downloaded files into arbitrary directories writable by SABnzbd.

items.title: CVE-2026-133236
items.summary: Modoboa before 2.13.0 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability that allows Resellers or users with domain add or change permission to inject rspamd DKIM selector map entries by supplying an unvalidated dkim_key_selector through the relay domain API. Attackers can embed a carriage return in the selector to override another tenant's domain selector, causing rspamd to sign its outgoing mail with a nonexistent selector and fail DKIM verification.

items.title: CVE-2026-133235
items.summary: Tandoor Recipes before 2.7.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows space admins to reach internal hosts because Nextcloud.get_client builds WebDAV clients from Storage.url without calling safe_request. Attackers can create a NEXTCLOUD storage via POST /api/storage/ pointing at internal hosts, import a file, then call GET /api/get_recipe_file// to read internal service or cloud metadata responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-133233
items.summary: Quasar before 2.35.3 contains a DOM clobbering vulnerability that allows attackers to break native wrapper detection by injecting HTML elements named Capacitor, cordova, or StatusBar. Attackers can place markup such as a div with id Capacitor into server-rendered or pre-rendered HTML so app.use(Quasar) throws and the application never mounts, or openURL() and AddressbarColor.set() throw.

items.title: CVE-2025-71472
items.summary: littlefs 2.8.0 through 2.11.3 contains a divide-by-zero vulnerability in lfs_mount_() that allows attackers to crash processes mounting crafted filesystem images when block_count is 0. Attackers can supply an image lacking a superblock entry or recording block_count 0, causing lfs->seed % lfs->block_count to trigger SIGFPE and denial of service.

In Puppet Enterprise deployments where task permissions are scoped to node groups defined by facts or trusted facts, this can allow a user to run tasks on nodes outside their permitted scope.

items.title: CVE-2026-133174
items.summary: HotGo 2.18.6 through 2.19.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated backend users to read other administrators' private letters because the messageIds helper omits the receiver filter. Low-privilege users can call GET /admin/notice/pullMessages, which is exempt from role permission checks via exceptAuth, to retrieve titles, contents and senders of private letters.

items.title: CVE-2026-133171
items.summary: Tiptap @tiptap/core 3.7.0 before 3.30.5 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in parseAttributes and parseShortcodeAttributes that allows attackers to exhaust CPU through quadratic backtracking. Attackers can supply Markdown with long crafted attribute strings parsed by createBlockMarkdownSpec, createAtomBlockMarkdownSpec or createInlineMarkdownSpec to stall browser pages or server processes.

items.title: CVE-2026-133170
items.summary: Tiptap @tiptap/core 2.0.0-alpha.0 before 3.30.4 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject DOM attributes via a __proto__ key passed to mergeAttributes(). Attackers can supply untrusted JSON attribute data whose __proto__ replaces the merged object's prototype, causing DOMSerializer.renderSpec to render injected event handlers that execute JavaScript.

items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: abort dirtree repair if the live update hook dies LOLLM notices that if the live update hook for the directory tree repair code hits an error, it will set dl->aborted and stops working. If the repair code ever sees that condition, it ought to bail out immediately instead of continuing with obsolete data.

Add the missing checks.

items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: netfilter: nft_payload: restrict checksum offsets to known values We need to prevent userspace from corrupting e.g. tcp->doff, because many locations in conntrack and conntrack helpers rely on nf_conntrack_in() having validated the packet headers. nft_payload allows to alter headers later which invalidates this assumption. The 'Fixes' commit restricts writes to safe fields, but there is another side channel: the checksum location. Restrict this too. Reported via sashiko/gemini.

items.title: CVE-2026-133074
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient authorization checks in the quiz overrides web service allow an authenticated user with teacher privileges to modify user and group overrides for quizzes they do not have permission to manage. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to improperly alter exam access, deadlines, or testing conditions across unauthorized courses.

items.title: CVE-2026-133073
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's single view grade report web service. A missing authorization check allows authenticated students to view the names of all grade items in a course, including those configured to be hidden. This vulnerability leads to unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133068
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. An improper authorization check when displaying individual glossary entries allows an authenticated user to view approved glossary items from courses they do not have permission to access. This vulnerability leads to unauthorized information disclosure of restricted educational materials.

items.title: CVE-2026-133067
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to missing ownership checks in badge alignments, an authenticated user with badge management privileges can view and modify alignments associated with badges they do not own. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized data disclosure and tampering with badge configurations.

items.title: CVE-2026-133060
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's Blackboard question import format. Insufficient validation of file paths during the question import process allows an authenticated user with permissions to import questions into a question bank to read arbitrary files accessible to the web server process. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to view sensitive files, resulting in unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133059
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. The grade feedback web service does not properly verify group and course enrolment permissions. An authenticated user with non-editing teacher privileges can exploit this vulnerability to access grade feedback and user profile details across groups or courses they are not authorized to view, leading to unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133114
items.summary: Caddy – WooCommerce Side Cart & Free Shipping Bar plugin for WordPress 3.0.0 before 3.2.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the saved-items/add REST endpoint that exposes non-public product data. Authenticated attackers with Subscriber-level access can enumerate product_id values to read names, prices, images and stock status of private, draft, hidden and password-protected products.

items.title: CVE-2026-133112
items.summary: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in gv_send.php because the action=process step never validates a CSRF token via check_secure_form(). Attackers can host an auto-submitting form that makes a logged-in customer send their gift voucher balance to an attacker-controlled email address for redemption.

items.title: CVE-2026-129927
items.summary: A credential-handling weakness in the MongoDB Python Driver allows a configuration option value that protects private key material to be written in clear text into the embedding application's own output and log records when a driver object is converted to text. A party able to read that output may obtain the credential. Obtaining it requires read access to the application's local output or log files.

items.title: CVE-2026-129926
items.summary: The MongoDB Python Driver does not neutralize NUL characters in the user name and password values it places into the message it builds for SASL PLAIN authentication. A party who can choose the login values that an application passes to the driver can alter where the fields of that message begin and end. This may result in a receiving system reading a login name and secret that differ from the values the application supplied. Authenticating as a different account still requires that account's password. Only deployments that use SASL PLAIN authentication are affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-129925
items.summary: The MongoDB Ruby Driver does not neutralize NUL characters in the user name and password values it places into the message it builds for SASL PLAIN authentication. A party who can choose the login values that an application passes to the driver can alter where the fields of that message begin and end. This may result in a receiving system reading a login name and secret that differ from the values the application supplied. Authenticating as a different account still requires that account's password. Only deployments that use SASL PLAIN authentication are affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-129924
items.summary: The MongoDB Ruby driver can include unmasked connection string content in the error it raises when a connection string cannot be parsed. If that connection string carries a secret, the secret may be disclosed in cleartext through the application's error output or logs. No privileges on the driver and no network access are needed to produce the error; a party able to read the application's error output may obtain the secret.

items.title: CVE-2026-99413
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: fix buffer overruns in xfs_ioc_attr_list When we converted the al_offset array in struct xfs_attrlist into a VLA, the size of the object shrank by 4 bytes. Unfortunately, the buffer size validation in the attrlist ioctl wasn't updated to notice this, so the al_offset[0] assignment blindly writes off the end of the buffer. LOLLM noticed the omitted check and complained.

items.title: CVE-2026-99411
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: actually lock the metafile reservation when adjusting after repair LOLLM reported that xrep_reset_metafile_resv performs unlocked loads and stores to the metadata file space reservation counters and thus can race with other threads. Fix this by taking the lock.

items.title: CVE-2026-99410

However, the fork reset function doesn't reset that correctly, which can cause post-repair verifier failures. Fix that.

items.title: CVE-2026-99409

items.title: CVE-2026-99408
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: don't proceed with xattr repair if the live update fails LOLLM observes that we ought to make one last check for failed live updates before replacing the xattr structure. Let's be cautious here.

items.title: CVE-2026-99407

Because we don't do this, repair can install the garbage values into the filesystem, making things worse. Don't do that.

items.title: CVE-2026-129939
items.summary: The MongoDB C Driver places a submitted connection-string option value into a diagnostic message without redaction when that option fails validation. The message is returned to the calling application and is also written to the process's standard error by the driver's default logging behavior. A party that can influence the connection string given to an application using the driver may cause that field's contents to be recorded, which may result in unintended disclosure of information the application placed in that field.

items.title: CVE-2026-129929
items.summary: The MongoDB Node.js Driver does not neutralize NUL characters in the user name and password values it places into the message it builds for SASL PLAIN authentication. A party who can choose the login values that an application passes to the driver can alter where the fields of that message begin and end. This may result in a receiving system reading a login name and secret that differ from the values the application supplied. Authenticating as a different account still requires that account's password. Only deployments that use SASL PLAIN authentication are affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-129928
items.summary: The MongoDB PHP extension includes the full connection string it was given in the error it raises when that string cannot be parsed. A party able to influence any part of the connection string, including a part that holds no secret, can cause the resulting message to carry credentials into the application's standard error output and log files. This may result in unintended disclosure of authentication material to anyone able to read that output.

items.title: CVE-2026-99534

items.title: CVE-2026-87868
items.summary: MRemoteNG uses single MD5 hash with no salt and no iterations for key-derivation. An attacker who obtains the encrypted data can brute-force a weak or moderate passphrase offline at extreme speed and then decrypt every stored connection password. When the default passphrase is in use, no cracking is needed at all; the key is derived from a publicly known value. Vendor did not provide the range of vulnerable versions. Only version 1.76.20 was tested and confirmed vulnerable. Other versions may also be vulnerable.

items.title: CVE-2026-133075
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to insufficient authorization checks in the quiz random question filter web service, an authenticated user with teacher privileges can modify random question settings in quizzes they do not have permission to manage. This flaw allows unauthorized users to alter assessment configurations across courses they do not oversee.

items.title: CVE-2026-133072
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient authorization checks in the quiz editing functionality allow an authenticated user with teacher privileges to view slot details and modify sections of quizzes they do not have permission to manage. An attacker could exploit this flaw to alter quiz configurations or disclose quiz structure information without proper authorization.

items.title: CVE-2026-133071
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to a missing authorization check when editing Lesson activity pages, authenticated users with teacher privileges can view and move lesson pages from courses they are not permitted to access into their own lessons. This issue can lead to unauthorized access and modification of restricted course content.

items.title: CVE-2026-133070
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to a missing authorization check when viewing and restoring wiki page versions, an authenticated user can access content from courses they are not permitted to view. This issue allows an attacker to inspect restricted course material and copy it into their own wiki pages, leading to unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133069
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Missing authorization checks in the forum discussion web services allow authenticated users to view discussion information in courses they do not have permission to access. In addition, users with teacher privileges may lock forum discussions in courses where they lack proper authorization. This issue can lead to unauthorized information disclosure and unauthorized discussion state modification.

items.title: CVE-2026-133066
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Missing ownership verification in Feedback activity templates allows an authenticated teacher to view, use, or delete templates associated with courses other than their own. This can result in unauthorized access, modification, or deletion of course materials.

items.title: CVE-2026-133065
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to insufficient permission checks and input validation in the quiz question bank callback, an authenticated user can access and view questions from question banks they do not have permission to access. Furthermore, this issue allows users to trigger arbitrary class instantiation (creating unintended application objects), potentially leading to further unauthorized actions.

items.title: CVE-2026-133064
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient sanitization of objective identifiers in the SCORM (Sharable Content Object Reference Model) objectives report allows an authenticated user with content upload permissions to inject malicious scripts. When another user views the report, the injected script executes in their browser session, potentially allowing the attacker to access sensitive information or perform unauthorized actions on their behalf.

items.title: CVE-2026-133063
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to insufficient validation when saving activity settings, an authenticated user with teacher privileges can modify activities in courses they are not authorized to access. This flaw allows unauthorized changes to course materials, compromising the integrity of course content.

items.title: CVE-2026-133062
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's external database enrolment plugin. Insufficient sanitization of data passed to queries against the external database allows an authenticated user with course editing permissions to perform a Structured Query Language (SQL) injection attack. When this non-default plugin is enabled, an attacker can exploit this issue to view, modify, or delete sensitive records within the connected external database.

items.title: CVE-2026-133061
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to a missing capability check in the grade items web service, an authenticated user with a student role can view the names of all grade items in a course, including those intended to be hidden. This flaw leads to unauthorized information disclosure of hidden course assessment details.

items.title: CVE-2026-62259
items.summary: HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, the experimental CRAM v4 functions cram_xpack_decode_char and cram_xrle_decode_char do not validate that attacker-controlled decode sizes remain within their expanded input arrays. Crafted CRAM data can therefore make either decoder read beyond the supplied input buffer, potentially disclosing process-state information or crashing the process through invalid memory access. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

items.summary: A flaw was found in libtirpc. As a result, when a short UDP RPC request is received after a longer one, the XDR decoder can read stale bytes left in the reused buffer and interpret them as part of the current request, including credential, verifier, or procedure-argument fields. The highest threat from this vulnerability is to data confidentiality and integrity for services that use a UDP-ba…

items.title: CVE-2026-127231
items.summary: A double free in the X.509 name constraints enforcement of GnuTLS 3.8.13 on all platforms allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service (application crash) via a certificate chain containing a NameConstraints extension processed while the application is under memory pressure. When an already populated name constraints object is reinitialized, previously freed list pointers are not cleared, so a memory allocation failure precisely at reinitialization leaves a dangling pointer that is freed again during a later cleanup.

items.title: CVE-2026-132282

This manipulation causes path traversal. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-132778
items.summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_field_is_sftime_offset() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c that allows attackers to crash MP4Box via crafted files. Attackers can supply an MP4 file whose BIFS scene contains cyclic PROTO IS relations, causing unbounded recursion that exhausts the stack and causes denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-132777
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in Conditional_execute() because SetupConditional() stores a BIFS decoder pointer that gf_sm_load_run_isom() later frees without clearing. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with a BIFS Conditional node processed with -nstatx to crash MP4Box and potentially corrupt the heap.

items.title: CVE-2026-132775
items.summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that allows attackers to corrupt memory by attaching nodes from unrelated proto sub-graphs to field-replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene buffering such a command in a Conditional node, causing gf_node_try_destroy() to access the freed node, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

items.title: CVE-2026-132774
items.summary: Attendize through 2.8.0 contains a cross-account authorization bypass vulnerability in EventAttendeesController::postMessageAttendees() that allows authenticated organisers to message other accounts' attendees by supplying a foreign event_id. Attackers, including self-registered organisers, can post to the attendees message endpoint for another event to send arbitrary emails to all attendees, enabling phishing and impersonation.

items.title: CVE-2026-132773
items.summary: Attendize through 2.8.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in EventOrdersController::postCancelOrder() that allows authenticated organisers to cancel attendees belonging to other accounts' events. Attackers can cancel one of their own orders while supplying foreign attendee IDs, which Attendee::findFromSelection() loads unfiltered, invalidating tickets for any event on the installation.

items.title: CVE-2026-132772
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT parser that leaves parser->command_buffer pointing into a freed InputSensor node. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file triggering a parse error so xmt_node_start() writes NULL into freed memory, corrupting the heap and crashing MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-132771
items.summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in ReplaceDEFNode that allows attackers to crash MP4Box by triggering access to a partly freed child list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file whose InputSensor command buffer cascades prototype sub-graph deletion during gf_sg_vrml_parent_destroy, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-132770
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmt_parse_proto() in loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to crash the process via a redefined ProtoDeclare name. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with a duplicate ProtoDeclare name, causing gf_sg_proto_new() to return NULL and crashing MP4Box during import.

items.title: CVE-2026-132769
items.summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in xmt_parse_script_field() that allows attackers to trigger a heap out-of-bounds read via duplicate Script field names with conflicting types. Attackers can craft an XMT file that, when imported with MP4Box, causes gf_sg_vrml_mf_reset() to treat a single-value field as multi-value, crashing the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-132768
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_find_node() in loader_xmt.c that leaves freed forward-referenced nodes cached in parser->peeked_nodes. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with a node targeted by an SFCommandBuffer command, triggering a later DEF lookup on the freed node and crashing MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-132767
items.summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmt_parse_command() in loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to crash MP4Box via unchecked field lookups. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene whose atIndexField names a non-existent node field, causing a NULL read during import and denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-132766
items.summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in MP4Box because gf_sg_reset frees DEF'd proto sub-graph nodes without removing them from the GF_Proto node_code list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nested PROTOs so gf_sg_proto_del unregisters freed nodes during teardown, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

items.title: CVE-2026-132765
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_node_try_destroy because Conditional node commands keep raw pointers to target nodes freed by gf_sg_reset(). Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene processed with -info or -add to trigger heap use-after-free, crashing the process and corrupting heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-132763
items.summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in gf_xml_sax_peek_node() that allows attackers to write a zero byte outside the heap line buffer via crafted XML attribute values. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with a ROUTE or command referencing an undefined node, imported with MP4Box, to crash the process and corrupt memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-132762
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a divide by zero vulnerability in DumpTrackInfo() in applications/mp4box/filedump.c that fails to check the media timescale for zero. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with a zero media timescale to make MP4Box -infon raise SIGFPE and crash, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-132761
items.summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_node_try_destroy that allows attackers to crash MP4Box by supplying crafted XMT scene files. Commands created inside a PROTO scope keep a raw pointer to a freed prototype sub-scene graph, which is read during teardown, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-132760
items.summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_isom_get_meta() in src/isomedia/meta.c that reads file->moov->trackList without checking the moov box exists. Attackers can supply a crafted ISOBMFF file with malformed AV1 configuration data that leaves moov unset, crashing MP4Box -infon and causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-132759
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability because gf_node_free() frees nodes without detaching routes that still reference them via FromNode. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nested PROTO graphs so gf_sg_route_del() accesses freed memory, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting the heap.

items.title: CVE-2026-132758
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that allows attackers to crash the application through an unmatched closing ProtoDeclare element. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT-A scene file with a mismatched closing ProtoDeclare or ExternProtoDeclare element, causing a dereference of a NULL parsing_proto pointer and denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-132757
items.summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in DoWriteMeta() in src/isomedia/isom_store.c that allows attackers to crash MP4Box via crafted files. Attackers can supply an ISOBMFF file with a meta box containing an iloc entry but no dref box, crashing MP4Box during rewrite operations like -unhint.

items.title: CVE-2026-132756
items.summary: Geany through 2.1.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to run shell commands by embedding metacharacters in filenames substituted into build and execute commands. Attackers can craft a file named with backticks or $(...) that executes via /bin/sh when a user runs Compile, Build or Execute, gaining code execution as the user.

items.title: CVE-2026-132755
items.summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains a heap-based buffer over-read vulnerability in tfsxml_leave() caused by an off-by-one error when handling generic <! markup in truncated XML. Attackers can supply a crafted media file with malformed ADM XML parsed by File_Adm.cpp to crash MediaInfo or applications using MediaInfoLib.

items.title: CVE-2026-132754
items.summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in File_Mpeg4::meta_iloc that allows attackers to trigger a global buffer over-read via oversized iloc field sizes. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with invalid offset_size or length_size values to overrun the BitStream_Fast mask table and crash applications analysing the file.

items.title: CVE-2026-132753
items.summary: MP4v2 through 2.1.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in MP4RtpHintTrack::GetPayload() in src/rtphint.cpp that passes an unchecked rtpmap value to strchr(). Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file whose RTP hint track has a corrupted hinf atom to crash mp4info or applications calling MP4GetHintTrackRtpPayload().

items.title: CVE-2026-132752
items.summary: ScreenTinker before 3.2.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the GET /api/kiosk/:id/render endpoint that allows users with kiosk page edit rights to store javascript: URLs in page buttons. Attackers can trigger script execution in the dashboard origin when an administrator activates the button, hijacking the victim's session and taking full control of the instance.

items.title: CVE-2026-132751
items.summary: yt through 4.4.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute Python code by supplying a crafted con_args attribute in a ytdata HDF5 file. SavedDataset._parse_parameter_file() passes con_args to eval() unrestricted, so loading a malicious .h5 file with yt.load() runs attacker code as the user.

items.title: CVE-2026-132750
items.summary: Meilisearch before 1.55.1 and 1.56.x before 1.56.1 contains a quadratic memory consumption vulnerability in filter-parser that allows attackers with a search API key to exhaust server memory. Attackers can send a roughly 100 KB filter, such as a _geoPolygon with thousands of coordinates, to the search endpoint, crashing the server and taking all indexes offline.

items.title: CVE-2026-132749
items.summary: Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability in ReportRun::generateAdvFilterSql() that allows authenticated low-privileged users to inject SQL via the bw comparator. Attackers can send a crafted advanced_filter parameter containing a single quote to the Reports getRecordsCount action to break out of BETWEEN literals and extract database contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-132748
items.summary: Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains a PHP code injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to inject code via the updatedFields parameter into config.inc.php. Attackers can supply a crafted HELPDESK_SUPPORT_EMAIL_ID value that passes email validation but closes the PHP string literal to execute arbitrary operating system commands.

items.title: CVE-2026-132747
items.summary: Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with export access to inject SQL through unvalidated selected_ids values in ExportData.php. Attackers can send a UNION SELECT payload in selected_ids[] to the ExportSelectedRecords mode and read password hashes and access keys from the exported CSV.

items.title: CVE-2026-132746
items.summary: Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privileged users to inject SQL via unescaped clientid values in the wsapp_map webservice operation. Attackers can register a sync application with wsapp_register, then send delete-mode entries with quoted clientid values processed by SyncServer.php to extract database contents including administrator access keys.

items.title: CVE-2026-132745
items.summary: Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated non-administrative users to inject SQL through the k (does not contain) comparator in list view search_params. Attackers can send crafted search_params to the ListAjax getRecordsCount mode, breaking out of the unescaped NOT LIKE clause to extract database contents via boolean or time-based techniques.

items.summary: MISP contains an authorization flaw in the GalaxyCluster model's captureCluster() function, which handles the import and synchronization of Galaxy Clusters. items.title: CVE-2026-125353
items.summary: An incorrect permission assignment vulnerability in Omada SDN Controller prior to 6.2.20 may cause a database backup generated during the uninstall workflow to remain readable by other local users on the host. Successful exploitation requires local, low-privileged access to the affected host and a retained uninstall backup. An attacker meeting these conditions could access the backup and disclose controller data without controller credentials.

items.summary: MISP contains an authorization bypass in the correlations/eventCorrelations endpoint and the underlying correlation engines (Default and OnDemand). items.title: CVE-2026-132279

items.title: CVE-2026-2307
items.summary: The Elementor Website Builder – More Than Just a Page Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 4.0.5 via `/wp-json/elementor/v1/user` REST endpoint. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Contributor-level access and above, to extract sensitive data including emails, password hashes and usernames for all WordPress users.

items.summary: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command ('OS command injection') vulnerability in Westell Technologies, Inc Remote series products on Linux allows OS Command Injection. This issue affects several generations of Westell Remotes: through firmware version 9.14. It has been reproduced across multiple devices. However, it is confirmed to affect only devices configured for RAS (Remote Access Server - e.g., RADIUS, TACACS).

items.title: CVE-2026-111520
items.summary: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.105.0, contain a Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Code Execution and Elevation of Privilege.

items.title: CVE-2026-111519
items.summary: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.105.0, contain an Improper Authorization in Handler for Custom URL Scheme vulnerability. items.title: CVE-2026-111514
items.summary: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.105.0, contain an Incorrect Default Permissions vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Arbitrary Code Execution and Elevation of Privilege.

items.title: CVE-2026-130791
items.summary: Finsys Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows users with stacks:edit permission to move arbitrary server directories by supplying a crafted oldDir parameter. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/stacks/[name]/relocate with an unvalidated source path to relocate directories into stack paths, disrupting services and exposing their contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-130784
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows restricted clients to create and access default project resources by exploiting entitlement checks against the requested project. Attackers can create bridge networks with raw.dnsmasq directives to execute code as root on the host, or manipulate inherited resources via the ?project= parameter.

items.title: CVE-2026-130782
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows restricted and view-only clients to read default project resources by requesting the default project directly. Attackers knowing resource names can read profiles, images, network zone peer keys and stored credentials, and export custom volume or bucket backups to obtain full contents or S3 admin keys.

items.title: CVE-2026-130781
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the storage bucket S3 listener, which buffers entire signed request bodies in memory before verifying the signature or credential role. Attackers knowing only a valid access key, or holding a read-only credential, can send many concurrent large requests to exhaust daemon memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-130780
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows malicious migration peers to write outside intended directories by supplying unvalidated dependent volume and snapshot names in the migration offer header. Attackers controlling a migration source can create root-owned volumes with attacker content at arbitrary host paths, compromising hosts using dir storage pools, bypassing restricted.storage-pools.access, or crashing the daemon.

items.title: CVE-2026-132560
items.summary: A flaw has been found in MemTensor memmy-agent up to 1.1.1. This impacts an unknown function of the file /api/v1/memory/logs of the component Memory HTTP Service. This manipulation causes information disclosure. The attack is restricted to local execution. The exploit has been published and may be used. Patch name: 421ce6cb33861255d34c3887d39aced009b3ce9b. It is suggested to install a patch to address this issue.

Crafted names or values can break out of generated identifier or string-literal contexts and inject arbitrary Scala that executes when generated code is compiled or endpoints are assembled. The selected file is copied into model storage a…

items.title: CVE-2026-132137
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in Relaticle up to 3.10.0. This affects the function mapToField of the file packages/ImportWizard/src/Livewire/Steps/MappingStep.php of the component Import Wizard. Such manipulation of the argument Target leads to authorization bypass. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-91139
items.summary: Deco BE65 firmware contains a cryptographic weakness in the local web-management authentication flow due to the use of insufficient RSA key sizes. The /login?form=auth endpoint returns a 512-bit RSA public key and sequence value. Successful exploitation may compromise the cryptographic protections applied to local web-management authentication traffic.

Prior to .8.2, 7.7.3, and 7.6.5, the Security Server writes each downloaded federated global-configuration part under the X-Road instance identifier declared by the part itself without checking that the identifier matches the source ecosystem that signed and delivered it. A malicious or compromised federated ecosystem can provide a validly signed SHARED-PARAMETERS part naming a victim ecosystem, causing the part to be written as the victim's authoritative shared-params.xml. The poisoned configuration can persist across refreshes, add attacker…

items.title: CVE-2026-128669
items.summary: A Session Fixation vulnerability exists in the admin login endpoint (/admin/index.php) of PHPGurukul News Portal Project V4.1. The application fails to regenerate the session identifier (PHPSESSID) upon successful authentication. A remote attacker can exploit this by setting a known session ID in the victim's browser prior to login. Once the victim authenticates, the attacker can reuse the fixed session ID to hijack the victim's authenticated session.

items.title: CVE-2026-128667
items.summary: A Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in the admin panel of PHPGurukul News Portal Project V4.1 allows remote attackers to hijack the authentication of administrators and perform unauthorized state-changing actions, such as adding, editing, or deleting posts and sub-admins, or changing passwords, via crafted HTTP requests. This occurs because the application fails to implement anti-CSRF tokens for admin actions and permits destructive operations via HTTP GET requests.

items.title: CVE-2026-127040
items.summary: The RSA-PSK ClientKeyExchange handler in gnutls before 3.8.14 does not return after detecting a memory allocation failure when copying the PSK username, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service for a peer under heap pressure.

items.title: CVE-2026-127039
items.summary: The certificate authentication info handling in gnutls from 2.5.9 up to 3.8.13 does not reset the certificate count and list pointer when re-allocation of raw_certificate_list fails, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service for a peer under heap pressure.

items.title: CVE-2026-91138
items.summary: The Deco BE65 v3 firmware contains a shared hard-coded password hash for the root account in /etc/shadow. Where the corresponding credential is accepted by a production authentication path, an attacker with existing unprivileged shell access may recover or otherwise obtain the plaintext password and use it to escalate privileges. Successful exploitation may grant root-level access to the affected device.
