An attacker who controls a configured mirror, replaces a release asset, or can modify plaintext transport can supply native code that executes when the consumer loads the…

items.title: CVE-2026-130790
items.summary: SemanticMediaWiki from 2.5.0 before 7.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with the smw-patternedit right to inject script by seeding markup reference names in MediaWiki:Smw_allows_pattern. Once an editor annotates the matching Allows pattern value, AllowsPatternValue emits it unescaped on Special:Browse, executing JavaScript in every viewer's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-130788
items.summary: SemanticMediaWiki from 3.0.0 before 7.4.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in CsvFileExportPrinter and DsvResultPrinter via unescaped valuesep and separator parameters. Attackers can craft Special:Ask links using request_type=special_page so export output renders as text/html, executing JavaScript in victims' browsers under the wiki origin.

items.title: CVE-2026-130787
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext before 16.35.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in financial reporting endpoints that allows low-privilege authenticated users to generate reports outside their permitted scope. Attackers can send crafted requests to affected reporting endpoints to read other companies' tax and payment data, including personal and corporate identifiers and financial totals.

items.title: CVE-2026-130786
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a configuration injection vulnerability that allows users who can launch instances from controlled images to inject LXC directives by embedding line breaks in OCI config.json values or oci.entrypoint and oci.cwd keys. Attackers can add liblxc hooks or crafted tmpfs lxc.mount.entry fields to run commands as root on the host or bind-mount host paths, even from restricted projects.

items.title: CVE-2026-130779
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows users permitted to import custom volumes to store unvalidated snapshot names from the backup index configuration section. Attackers can craft a backup with traversal sequences in snapshot names so later deletion removes arbitrary host directories as root, while renaming or mounting operates on arbitrary paths.

items.title: CVE-2026-130777
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows project-restricted authenticated clients to receive other projects' OVN ACL logs because these events are broadcast with an empty project. Attackers can subscribe to network-acl events on one accessible project to observe internal IPs, ports, protocols, and allow/drop decisions across all projects.

items.title: CVE-2026-130776
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows clients with project event-view access to read migration websocket secrets broadcast in operation metadata. Attackers can connect to in-flight migration control and fs websockets before the legitimate peer, hijacking the transfer to obtain instance configuration and filesystem data.

items.title: CVE-2026-130775
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the /dev/incus guest-API image export handler that fails to pin the project parameter to the guest's own project. Container root users with the guest-API image entitlement can supply another project in the project query parameter to export public or cached images, including non-public images pulled from authenticated remotes.

items.title: CVE-2026-130773
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass that allows restricted project users to create resources in the unrestricted default project by targeting projects lacking features.* flags. Attackers can create bridge networks with raw.dnsmasq dhcp-script injection to run scripts as root, or custom volumes with block.create_options mkfs arguments to read host files.

items.title: CVE-2026-130772
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows restricted TLS clients to read other projects' bucket S3 keys and profile configuration through recursive and all-projects responses. Attackers can query bucket listings with recursion=2 or profiles with all-projects=true to obtain S3 secret keys and sensitive environment, cloud-init and user values across projects.

items.title: CVE-2026-130769
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows clients permitted to create instances to crash the daemon by importing a backup with a null snapshot entry in index.yaml. Attackers can trigger an unrecovered nil pointer dereference during configuration rewrite, terminating the daemon and all containers and virtual machines on the node.

items.title: CVE-2026-130768
items.summary: Obot from 0.14.0 before 0.27.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Power Users to bypass outbound protections by supplying unspecified addresses, IPv6 transition addresses, or registry icon URLs. Attackers can add remote MCP servers pointing to 0.0.0.0, ::, or NAT64/6to4/Teredo addresses embedding blocked IPv4 addresses to probe internal services for reachability.

items.title: CVE-2026-130767
items.summary: Obot from 0.9.0 before 0.27.0 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute shell commands by embedding an EOF line in file-type MCP server configuration values. Attackers can terminate the heredoc in the generated init container script to run commands, modify the MCP server files volume, and reach services on Obot's Docker network.

items.title: CVE-2026-130766
items.summary: Obot from 0.26.0 before 0.27.0 fails to validate the resource identifier in remote MCP server protected resource metadata, allowing malicious MCP servers to steal access tokens. Attackers can name a different service and authorization server with chosen scopes, causing Obot to obtain the victim's token for that service and forward it to the attacker.

items.title: CVE-2026-130763
items.summary: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains a CSV formula injection vulnerability in the host inventory export endpoint that allows attackers controlling an enrolled host or enroll secret to plant spreadsheet formulas. Attackers can set osquery-reported fields like hostname or hardware serial to formula values, enabling data exfiltration or DDE command execution when users open the exported CSV.

items.title: CVE-2026-130762
items.summary: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated observer-level users to sort software listings by arbitrary columns via the order_key parameter. Attackers can order by joined hosts table columns such as node keys and use pagination as a binary-search oracle to extract sensitive column values.

items.title: CVE-2026-130761
items.summary: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows enrolled hosts to trigger unbounded per-name database lookups by submitting osquery result logs. Attackers with a valid host node key can send one request to /api/osquery/log containing many distinct query names, exhausting database connections and read replica capacity.

items.title: CVE-2026-130758
items.summary: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the deprecated POST /api/latest/fleet/mdm/apple/enqueue endpoint that allows team-scoped users to enqueue Apple MDM commands outside their teams. Attackers with team admin, maintainer, or GitOps roles can include one own-team host UUID alongside unresolved enrollment IDs to send commands like InstallProfile to deleted or user-channel enrollments without activity logging.

items.title: CVE-2026-130757
items.summary: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows attackers to reuse case-mutated security tokens because MySQL token columns used case-insensitive collation. Attackers holding a case-normalized invite or email-change token can redirect a victim's email for account takeover or redeem invites with roles up to Global Admin.

items.title: CVE-2026-130756
items.summary: pnpm exe before 10.34.8 embeds an outdated Node.js runtime that still trusts compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates during registry TLS connections. Network attackers holding a recovered intermediate key can intercept standalone pnpm registry fetches and serve forged package metadata or tarballs.

items.title: CVE-2026-130755
items.summary: Froxlor before 2.3.16 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated customers to read hidden traffic statistics by calling the Traffic.listing API command. Attackers can authenticate to api.php with their API key and secret to retrieve HTTP, FTP, and mail traffic volumes despite the panel.customer_hide_options restriction.

items.title: CVE-2026-77283

items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a policy bypass vulnerability in the ASE decoder caused by a missing security policy check. Attackers can supply crafted ASE files that evade configured resource policies to cause excessive memory usage and denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-126675
items.summary: Incorrect default permissions on the folder-level JavaScript directory in Nitro PDF Pro before 26.4 on Windows allow a local low-privileged user to execute JavaScript in the context of another user, including an administrator, via a script planted in %ProgramData%\Nitro\PDF Pro\CV\JavaScripts that is automatically run when the victim launches the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-119220
items.summary: The Dokan: AI Powered WooCommerce Multivendor Marketplace Solution – Build Your Own Amazon, eBay, Etsy plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authorization Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 5.3.3. The vulnerability exists because the `matches_mcp_endpoint()` function applies an unanchored regular expression (`#/(?:woocommerce|dokan)/mcp(?:/|$)#`) against the entire `REQUEST_URI` including the query string, meaning any request that contains the literal substring `/dokan/mcp/` or `/woocommerce/mcp/` anywhere in its URI — including inside a query parameter value — is incorrectly treated…

items.title: CVE-2026-130156
items.summary: Bazarr is a companion application to Sonarr and Radarr. Prior to 1.6.3-beta.11, the /api/subtitles/subtitles-info handler uses SubtitleNameContents.get() in subtitles_contents.py and reads the caller-supplied subtitlePath after checking only its subtitle extension; because the resolved path is not confined to files indexed by Bazarr, traversal can read files outside the media library. The /api/subtitles/subtitles handler in subtitles.py passes caller-supplied path and reference to sync and translation without per-path authorization, allowing an out-of-library reference file to be read and outp…

items.title: CVE-2026-109909
items.summary: A out of bounds read after using negative integers during offset calculation during PCF decoding in X.Org libXfont before 2.0.10 could be used by authenticated X clients to crash the X server or expose sensitive information in its memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-130008
items.summary: sqlite-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server for SQLite. Prior to 0.1.2, the default read-only mode can be bypassed through execute_query, which accepts a leading SELECT while the SQLite driver executes trailing statements, and through describe_table, which interpolates the caller-controlled table_name into PRAGMA table_info. Either path can issue ATTACH DATABASE, which opens an attached file read-write despite mode=ro and can make the protected database writable, read other SQLite database files, or create a SQLite-format file at a path writable by the server process. Existing non-empty file…

items.title: CVE-2026-18476
items.summary: Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.11 fail to scope an incoming webhook's direct message target to the webhook's own team, which allows a team administrator to deliver a direct message to a user on a team they have no authority over via a webhook whose posting identity belongs to both teams.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00751

items.title: CVE-2026-88902
items.summary: Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2, 11.11.x <= 11.11.1 fail to bound the work performed while reading EXIF orientation metadata, which allows an authenticated user to cause disproportionate server-side CPU usage by uploading or linking a small image with specially structured EXIF metadata.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00784

items.title: CVE-2026-121591
items.summary: Mattermost Desktop App versions <=6.3 6.0.3 6.3.2.0 fail to bound the Calls widget resize dimensions before applying them to the window, which allows a configured Mattermost server to terminate the Desktop App process via a crafted resizeCallsWidget IPC message sent from the Calls widget window. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00787

items.title: CVE-2026-113699
items.summary: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command ('OS command injection') vulnerability in Aidata Bilişim Kurumsal Tic. Ve San. A.Ş. Aidata WR854GVR allows OS Command Injection. This issue affects Aidata WR854GVR: before V4.0.18_261111.

items.title: CVE-2026-107519
items.summary: Dell PowerStore contains an integer underflow vulnerability. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to denial of service of a cryptographic service.

items.title: CVE-2026-59159
items.summary: Linux Mint Update Manager manages software updates on Linux Mint systems. From 5.4.8 until 5.5.4.3, 5.5.9.1, 5.8.8.1, 5.9.8.1, 6.0.9.1, and 6.1.5.1, mint-refresh-cache passes a user-controlled --parent-window-id value directly to the privileged Synaptic process without validating it as an integer. A local user permitted to execute mint-refresh-cache through sudo can inject additional Synaptic command-line options and achieve arbitrary code execution as root. This issue is fixed in versions 5.5.4.3, 5.5.9.1, 5.8.8.1, 5.9.8.1, 6.0.9.1, and 6.1.5.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-16050
items.summary: Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.11 fail to sanitize channel mentions when rendering permalinked posts, which allows an authenticated user to discover the display names of private channels they do not have access to via a permalink to a post that mentions the channel.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00721

items.title: CVE-2026-132209
items.summary: Hardcoded credentials in the executable file. These can be extracted using the “Strings.exe” tool and could allow an attacker unauthorized access to the database and SMTP server. winSAT.exe

items.title: CVE-2026-132208
items.summary: Hardcoded credentials in the executable file. These can be extracted using the “Strings.exe” tool and could allow an attacker unauthorized access to the database and SMTP server. winCRM.exe

items.title: CVE-2025-64441
items.summary: The ownCloud Desktop Client synchronizes files between an ownCloud server and a desktop. Prior to 6.0.2, an authenticated attacker can share a specially crafted file with a victim. If the file is synced by the client and revealed in the macOS Finder, it can cause operating-system command injection on the victim’s computer. This issue is fixed in version 6.0.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-18079
items.summary: Mattermost versions 11.11.x <= 11.11.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2 Fail to revoke a user's active sessions when a bulk import links an existing user account to a bot record or changes the account's auth_service/auth_data, which allows an attacker in possession of a session token issued before the import to retain full authenticated access to the affected account via a system administrator-triggered bulk import job.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00746

items.title: CVE-2026-17575
items.summary: Mattermost versions 11.8.x <= 11.8.5, 11.7.x <= 11.7.10, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2 fails to validate the type of card property fields which allows a board Editor to make a board or card permanently unopenable for all users via a crafted PATCH request storing a non-string property name or value.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00743

items.title: CVE-2026-132126
items.summary: Weblate 2026.6 through 2026.11.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to enumerate all workspaces through an unfiltered ProjectSerializer.workspace field. Low-privilege users can request the browsable /api/projects/ page to render the project creation form, revealing every workspace UUID and name they cannot access.

items.title: CVE-2026-132122
items.summary: agentic-radar 0.7.0 before 0.14.2 contains an untrusted configuration loading vulnerability that allows malicious repositories to inject environment variables by having load_dotenv() in agentic_radar/cli.py load the scanned repository's .env file. Attackers can set OPENAI_BASE_URL to an attacker-controlled host so that scan openai-agents or --harden-prompts send requests carrying the user's OpenAI API key to the attacker.

items.title: CVE-2026-132121
items.summary: Supergateway 2.4.0 through 4.2.2 contains a cross-site WebSocket hijacking vulnerability in stdio-to-WebSocket mode that allows malicious web pages to connect by bypassing missing Origin header validation. Attackers can open the /message WebSocket from a victim's browser, even against localhost-bound gateways, to initialize an MCP session and invoke wrapped stdio MCP server tools with victim privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-109864
items.summary: CAST Imaging has an access control flaw in the "/api/jobs//logs/download" endpoint. An authenticated low-privilege user can download log archives for any job whose UUID they know, even if they are not authorized to access it. The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

items.title: CVE-2026-109863
items.summary: CAST Imaging allows authenticated, low-privileged users to access parts of the administrator panel. When a user navigates to any URL path the application doesn't recognize, a wildcard route automatically redirects them to the administrative view at "/admin/applications". This allows an attacker to perform certain administrator-restricted actions, including triggering app-to-app link generation, configuring regexes, and changing searchable object properties, resulting in unauthorized modification of application configuration. The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may al…

items.title: CVE-2026-109862
items.summary: CAST Imaging does not properly check whether a user is authorized to modify another user's notification settings in the "/api/admin/user/update-subscriber" endpoint. An authenticated, low-privileged attacker can enable or disable email notifications on another user's behalf, which can suppress important communications such as security alerts and disrupt business processes. The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

items.title: CVE-2026-107518
items.summary: Dell PowerStore contains a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. An authenticated user with limited privileges could potentially exploit this vulnerability to make the appliance connect to attacker-chosen internal systems.

items.title: CVE-2026-130748
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability that allows anonymous attackers to redirect reset links by forging the CloudFront-Forwarded-Proto header. Attackers can send a forgot-password request with a crafted scheme value so the emailed reset link points to their host, capturing the token to take over accounts including super admins.

items.title: CVE-2026-130745
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows anonymous visitors to read protected pages because admin and site scopes share a page cache key. Routine editor activity through the API plugin rebuilds the page index without frontmatter.yaml access rules, exposing members-only page content until the cache is rebuilt.

items.title: CVE-2026-130743
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an insecure blueprint trust vulnerability that allows publisher accounts to read secrets and execute PHP by planting or selecting attacker-controlled blueprint files. Attackers can abuse the import@ directive, uploaded YAML media named as the page template, or form.flash_folder to leak password hashes and keys or invoke static PHP methods for code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-130741
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a Twig sandbox bypass vulnerability that allows publishers to read any server file by abusing allowlisted array_key_value() and page accessor setters such as filePath(). Attackers can repoint page objects or overwrite the assets collections to render private keys and the API signing secret, then forge a super-admin API token.

items.title: CVE-2026-130740
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows publishers and read-only user managers to read password hashes, 2FA secrets and reset tokens through unfiltered account serialization. Attackers can embed a Flex form for the user-accounts directory in a page or query the Flex API with admin.users.read to obtain super admin credentials and take over the account.

items.title: CVE-2026-130735
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a Twig injection vulnerability that allows media-only accounts and anonymous uploaders to execute Twig by placing delimiters in image titles, alt text, class, id, or file names. Attackers can combine injected Twig with the autoescape tag to serve script to every page visitor, including super admins, or expose unpublished page content.

items.title: CVE-2026-130734
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with media upload rights to bypass the upload sanitizer. Attackers can upload SVG files with inner extensions like .svg.defaults, payloads that crash the fail-open sanitizer, or unblocked .xml/.xhtm files to run script when administrators open the raw file URL.

items.title: CVE-2026-130733
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows publishers to overwrite pages their per-page permissions deny by abusing FolderStorage key delimiter collisions and PageStorage folder reconstruction. Attackers can rename a folder like locked*** or save from a page with an unusual prefix width through a front-end Flex pages form, replacing protected content and permissions to access the protected subtree.

items.title: CVE-2026-130731
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.05.3 contains an account takeover vulnerability that allows invited users to complete other invitees' signups because batch invitations share one token across all recipients. Attackers holding a valid batch invite can submit another invitee's email with the shared non-expiring token to set its password and take over that account, including higher-role ones.

items.title: CVE-2026-130727
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in public shared-view endpoints that fetch records by primary key without applying the view's row filter. Anonymous share link holders can enumerate sequential primary keys on link, has-many, and attachment download endpoints to read excluded records' linked data and download their attachments.

items.title: CVE-2026-130725
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to obtain signed download URLs for other bases' attachments by storing foreign attachment paths in their own rows via prepareNocoData. Attackers with write access to an attachment column can have _convertAttachmentType or the attachment download endpoint sign the foreign path, reading cross-base files despite secure attachment mode.

items.title: CVE-2026-130724
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated base Editors to make backend HTTP requests by supplying arbitrary URLs to the integration remote fetch operation. Attackers can control the method, headers, and body to reach internal APIs, loopback services, and cloud metadata endpoints, reading responses and echoed decrypted integration secrets.

items.title: CVE-2026-130718
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows anonymous share link holders to access records excluded by a shared view's row filter, because the read-by-primary-key path ignores the view's filters. Attackers can request the public attachment-download or nested-link listing routes with a record id to mint signed download URLs for hidden files and read linked-record data.

items.title: CVE-2026-130716
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator or Editor users to execute script by injecting markup into fields rendered through URL() formulas. The canvas grid renderer assigns unsanitized formula output to innerHTML, letting attackers steal session tokens from localStorage and take over accounts of users viewing the table.

items.title: CVE-2026-130715
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator or Owner users to execute database functions by supplying zero-argument function calls as column default values. Attackers can plant functions like version() or inet_server_addr() in PostgreSQL or MySQL column definitions and read results through record APIs, disclosing server addresses, role names, and engine details.

items.title: CVE-2026-130711
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in extract-ids.middleware.ts that allows authenticated users to resolve roles against another base by supplying an MCP token id in the query string. Attackers with Viewer access on one base can mint an MCP token and pass its id to read another base's metadata, including table lists and member email addresses.

items.title: CVE-2026-130709
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator or Owner users to execute JavaScript by abusing Handlebars webhook helpers. Attackers can supply property paths like constructor.constructor to pluck, sortBy, filter, or withSort helpers to reach the Function constructor and run operating-system commands.

items.title: CVE-2026-130708
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows workspace Creator users to read plaintext notification webhook URLs by querying the webhook plugin listing endpoint. Attackers can replay exposed Slack, Teams, Discord and Mattermost webhook URLs directly against messaging providers to post arbitrary messages into organization chat channels.

items.title: CVE-2026-130702
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.0 contains an account takeover vulnerability that allows users with the base creator role to hijack other accounts by resending base invitations. Attackers can trigger baseUserInviteResend to mint a new invite_token, read it from the base member list, and reset the victim's password through signup, taking over owner or super admin accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-130701
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an SQL injection vulnerability because select-field option titles are embedded into MySQL or MariaDB enum/set column definitions with only single-quote doubling, leaving backslashes unescaped. A base creator or owner can end an option title with a backslash to escape the literal and append ALTER TABLE clauses, adding, dropping or renaming columns and altering indexes in the connected database.

items.title: CVE-2026-130697
items.summary: NocoDB from 0.301.4 before 2026.10.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated workspace viewers to read pending invitation tokens through the workspace member list. Attackers can redeem an exposed higher-privileged invitation token at signup to claim the invited account and escalate to roles such as workspace owner.

items.title: CVE-2026-130696
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains a credential exposure vulnerability in the connection-test endpoint that allows authorized integration users to redirect stored credentials by overriding connection host, port, and user fields. Attackers can point the test at a server they control to capture offline-crackable PostgreSQL md5 or MySQL handshakes and recover the stored database password.

items.title: CVE-2026-130693
items.summary: NocoDB from 0.253.0 before 2026.09.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in baseUserDelete that allows base Creators to remove higher-privileged Owners due to a broken role power comparison. Attackers holding the Creator role can remove other Owners of a base, since getProjectRolePower returns -1 for the target and never refuses the request.

items.title: CVE-2026-130692
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains a template injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator-role users to execute server-side JavaScript by supplying array-form property paths to Handlebars helpers in webhook templates. Attackers can bypass the string-only prototype guard to reach the function constructor, running operating-system commands with server privileges or exfiltrating process-internal values via outbound requests.

items.title: CVE-2026-118493
items.summary: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server. If Apache Iggy 0.9.0 started without IGGY_ROOT_USERNAME and IGGY_ROOT_PASSWORD, it generated a root password and wrote it to the server log file, which is enabled by default. The system snapshot command (GetSnapshot on the binary transports and POST /snapshot on HTTP) let a user with only the read_servers permission download the server log files. That user could read the generated root password and log in as root. This issue affects Apache Iggy: 0.9.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, w…

items.title: CVE-2026-111508
items.summary: Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. Exploitation could lead to arbitrary command execution with root privileges on the appliance.

items.title: CVE-2026-132079
items.summary: Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy Go SDK. The TCP client method CreatePersonalAccessToken wrote the 32-bit expiry into the upper half of the 64-bit expiry field that the server reads. The server read a nonzero expiry as 2^32 times the requested value. A token created through the Go TCP client therefore stayed valid about four billion times longer than the caller asked for. This issue affects Apache Iggy Go SDK: from 0.5.0 before 0.10.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue. Tokens that an earlier version created keep their lon…

items.title: CVE-2026-128719
items.summary: An issue in PHPGurukul Employee Leaves Management System (ELMS) Version 2.1 allows a remote attacker to escalate privileges via the password recovery functionality

items.title: CVE-2026-120718
items.summary: Description: BIG-IP iControl REST tokens may not expire as expected in all scenarios. Impact: An attacker who has obtained a token may be able to extend its expiry lifetime unless the token owner deletes it. There is no data plane exposure; this is a control plane issue only. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

items.title: CVE-2026-71861
items.summary: The Chainguard SDK is a public Go SDK for integrating with the Chainguard platform. Prior to 0.1.107, auth/aws.VerifyToken trusts the Chainguard-Audience and Chainguard-Identity headers without requiring those headers to be covered by AWS SigV4 SignedHeaders. An attacker with a fresh STS GetCallerIdentity request signed by a victim can rewrite the unsigned binding headers and replay the proof to another relying party, causing the relying party to authenticate the victim’s AWS identity for an attacker-chosen audience and identity. Code that only uses auth/aws.GenerateToken is unaffected because…

items.title: CVE-2026-132224
items.summary: Optimizely Web Experimentation before 2026-11-17 mishandles the account signup flow, leading to presence of attacker-controlled code in the projectJS (aka Project JavaScript) field of certain cdn.optimizely.com assets.

items.title: CVE-2026-130688
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with record edit rights to inject forms, images, and styled overlays into rich text cells, which are sanitized only with DOMPurify's default policy. Attackers can place a page-sized spoofed sign-in form or remote image in a cell to harvest passwords and disclose viewer IP addresses in expanded records, gallery and kanban cards, and shared views.

items.title: CVE-2026-130687
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains a stored CSS injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Commenter or Editor users to inject inline styles by placing single quotes in mention text. Attackers can break out of the single-quoted data-id attribute in comments or rich text cells to overlay or rearrange the interface for other viewers.

items.title: CVE-2026-130686
items.summary: vLLM from 0.6.0 before 0.33.0 lacks a request-wide media budget, allowing remote inference clients to exhaust frontend resources by submitting many remote image URLs in one request. Attackers can send a compact request to /v1/messages or /v1/responses that forces downloading and decoding of every image before prompt-length admission, exhausting memory, CPU, and connections.

items.title: CVE-2026-130680
items.summary: SiYuan from 3.3.0 before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject HTML via unescaped checkbox column names in Gallery and Kanban AttributeView renderers. Attackers can share a crafted .sy.zip document whose rendering in the Electron desktop client with nodeIntegration enabled executes Node.js and host OS commands.

items.title: CVE-2026-130679
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in genAVValueHTML() that allows attackers who can store Attribute View asset values to inject script through an unescaped image src attribute. Attackers can store an image URL containing a double quote and onerror handler that executes OS commands via Node.js in the desktop app when victims open the bound note or row attribute panel.

items.title: CVE-2026-130678
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to execute script by storing malicious Attribute View column names rendered unescaped in col.ts. Attackers can inject HTML via addAttributeViewKey, .sy.zip import, or sync, and when a victim adds or duplicates the column, insertAdjacentHTML runs JavaScript with Node.js privileges for desktop code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-130677
items.summary: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.4 contains an improper session management vulnerability that fails to invalidate existing sessions when 2FA is enabled and allows disabling 2FA without re-authentication. Attackers holding a hijacked or stale session can retain full account access and silently remove 2FA without the password, authenticator code, or recovery code.

items.title: CVE-2026-130676
items.summary: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows low-privilege control panel users to inject JavaScript by poisoning cached license data. Attackers can store a malicious licensed domain via the app/process-api-response-headers endpoint, which executes unescaped in administrators' dashboard license-mismatch warnings.

items.title: CVE-2026-130673
items.summary: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.5 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to inject raw SQL by passing nested array parameters into Element::findOne() criteria. Attackers can set the query's where property through endpoints like users/delete-address and users/save-address to perform blind boolean or time-based injection and read database contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-130672
items.summary: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ChartsController::actionGetNewUsersData() that lacks a viewUsers permission check. Authenticated control panel users can POST to the charts/get-new-users-data action to read aggregate user-registration time series and totals for the site or any user group.

items.title: CVE-2026-130671
items.summary: Parse Server before 8.6.119 and 9.x before 9.10.8-alpha.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows LiveQuery clients without the master key to subscribe to installation and internal classes. Attackers can receive installation IDs and device tokens of other devices when these classes are in liveQuery.classNames, then modify those installations to redirect push notifications.

items.title: CVE-2026-130670
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a heap buffer over-read vulnerability that allows attackers to read beyond allocated memory when BGRO image data is imported. Attackers can supply crafted BGRO data for processing to crash the application or leak adjacent heap memory contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-130669
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a null pointer dereference vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the process by using the -subimage option on a single-image list. Attackers can supply input producing an image list with only one image while -subimage is applied, causing a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-130668
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a double free vulnerability that allows attackers to trigger an invalid memory free by using the DPC compare metric. Attackers can supply images for comparison with the DPC metric to corrupt memory and crash the application, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-130667
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a heap buffer over-read vulnerability in the TIFF decoder that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying a crafted TIFF image. Attackers can provide a malicious TIFF file that, when encoded in a specific output format, triggers a heap buffer over-write causing memory corruption.

items.title: CVE-2026-130665
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a use after free vulnerability in the EXR decoder that is triggered when a specific memory allocation fails. Attackers can supply crafted EXR images processed under memory pressure to trigger the use after free, causing crashes or memory corruption.

items.title: CVE-2026-130662

items.title: CVE-2026-132049
items.summary: A flaw was found in lldpd. The service fails to verify that Link Layer Discovery Protocol - Media Endpoint Discovery (LLDP-MED) location records received from network neighbors match their declared lengths. An adjacent attacker on the local network can exploit this flaw by sending crafted packets, causing client applications using the liblldpctl library to read past buffer boundaries when parsing location data. This issue can lead to an information disclosure of adjacent process memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-129705
items.summary: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1.0 to 2.1.2, a broker with a listener that is configured to use the PROXY protocol v2 is vulnerable to an untrusted proxy providing details that cause the broker to accept fake SSL information. This can be mitigated by following the documented requirements for PROXY listeners: It is very important that only trusted proxies are allowed to connect to any listener using the PROXY protocol, and that clients are not allowed to connect to the listener at all.

items.title: CVE-2026-126708

Starting with OpenSSL 4.0, sha512-pbkdf2 hashing will fail when using the FIPS provider for passwords shorter than 8 characters. This has the effect that newly created passwords would match against any other password with fewer than 8 characters.

items.title: CVE-2026-130491

items.title: CVE-2026-117489

items.summary: The Search & Replace WordPress plugin before 3.2.4 does not restrict one of its database tools to network administrators on multisite installations, allowing administrators of a single subsite to run arbitrary SQL against the whole network's database and make themselves Super Admin.

items.title: CVE-2026-133274 — CVSS 6.5
items.summary: THC-Hydra through 9.7 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in analyze_server_response() of hydra-http-form.c that allows malicious HTTP servers to corrupt memory via crafted Set-Cookie headers. Attackers can send a Set-Cookie header with an extra leading space followed by a repeated cookie name, causing a negative strncpy length that overflows tmpcookie and crashes Hydra.

items.title: CVE-2026-133248 — CVSS 4.8
items.summary: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows administrators with product editing permission to inject script via the products_name field. The unescaped name is rendered in the h1 heading of product detail and reviews pages, executing script in the browsers of shoppers and logged-in customers.

items.title: CVE-2026-133245 — CVSS 7.5
items.summary: parse5 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains an uncaught exception vulnerability in Preprocessor#_processSurrogate that allows remote attackers to crash applications by supplying two consecutive low surrogates. Attackers can submit input such as U+DC00 U+DC00, which decodes to out-of-range code point 0x110000 and throws a RangeError from parse, parseFragment, or streaming parsers, crashing Node.js processes.

items.title: CVE-2026-133240 — CVSS 3.1
items.summary: OpnForm before 2.8.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in PublicWebhookUrl::isPublicIp that fails to reject CGNAT, NAT64 and 6to4 address ranges. Authenticated users can configure webhook, form import or PDF image URLs resolving to these ranges to make the server send HTTPS requests to internal hosts.

items.title: CVE-2026-133242 — CVSS 5.4
items.summary: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject script by crafting og:video:secure_url values. Attackers can post links to pages whose allowlisted-prefix video URL contains a quote and onload handler, executing script in readers' sessions when they click the video preview.

items.title: CVE-2026-133244 — CVSS 6.1

Attackers can place entity-encoded markup after a closed script or style element to bypass RewritingStream-based filters and execute script in users' browsers.

items.title: CVE-2026-133238 — CVSS 3.1
items.summary: SABnzbd through 5.1.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the Sorter that allows attackers to write files outside the Complete folder via crafted propername, episodename or job name (%dn) values. Attackers can supply a malicious NZB with '...' sequences that collapse to '..' after single-pass replacement, moving downloaded files into arbitrary directories writable by SABnzbd.

items.title: CVE-2026-133236 — CVSS 2.7
items.summary: Modoboa before 2.13.0 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability that allows Resellers or users with domain add or change permission to inject rspamd DKIM selector map entries by supplying an unvalidated dkim_key_selector through the relay domain API. Attackers can embed a carriage return in the selector to override another tenant's domain selector, causing rspamd to sign its outgoing mail with a nonexistent selector and fail DKIM verification.

items.title: CVE-2026-133235 — CVSS 7.7
items.summary: Tandoor Recipes before 2.7.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows space admins to reach internal hosts because Nextcloud.get_client builds WebDAV clients from Storage.url without calling safe_request. Attackers can create a NEXTCLOUD storage via POST /api/storage/ pointing at internal hosts, import a file, then call GET /api/get_recipe_file/ / to read internal service or cloud metadata responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-133233 — CVSS 3.1

Attackers can place markup such as a div with id Capacitor into server-rendered or pre-rendered HTML so app.use(Quasar) throws and the application never mounts, or openURL() and AddressbarColor.set() throw.

The extraction fallback validated the symlink at it's archived location but recreated it at the hardlink's shallower path, letting a relative target the filter judged contained escape the destination directory. This allowed a malicious tar archive to create a symlink pointing outside the destination, enabling out-of-destination file reads or writes. This was an incomplete fix of CVE-2025-4330...

items.title: Angelfish: Leader, DAG, or Anywhere in Between
items.summary: arXiv:2509.15847v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: To maximize performance, many modern blockchain systems rely on eventually synchronous, Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) consensus protocols. items.title: Bajillion: Cryptographic Clearing for Micropayments
items.summary: arXiv:2611.21883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Much of the web is funded by advertising, a model that erodes as humans delegate browsing to AI agents acting on their behalf. A natural replacement is for agents to pay for what they consume, often a fraction of a cent per request. At the scale of web traffic, this could mean tens or even hundreds of millions of payments per second. We present Bajillion, a clearing protocol for scalable micropayments. A sender signs a payment request, and an untrusted operator answers with a preconfirmation, which promises the receiver that it will be paid. Peri…

items.title: From Token Changes to Task Failures: Bit Flips in a Shared KV-Cache Block
items.summary: arXiv:2611.22243v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In LLM serving systems with prefix caching, each KV block of a shared system prompt is held in GPU memory as a single physical copy, which every request with that prompt reads. Our earlier work measured change and showed that one bit flip in such a block changes many later responses without making them visibly degenerate. This paper extends that work by measuring how often the changed responses are wrong. items.title: TetherMark: Instance-Level Watermark Authentication Against Cross-Instance Transplantation
items.summary: arXiv:2611.22345v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Robust watermarking is commonly verified by asking whether a hidden payload remains decodable after compression, geometric distortion, or generative editing. Localized and semantic extensions may additionally check whether an expected region or category is still present. items.title: A Little Advice Suffices: Diffie-Hellman Is as Hard as Discrete Logarithm
items.summary: arXiv:2611.22290v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Is computing a Diffie-Hellman key as hard as computing a discrete logarithm? Maurer showed that it is, given a few bits of advice, provided that short intervals contain enough integers with only small prime factors; that proviso has stood for thirty years. We remove it. For every prime $p$ there is an advice string of $O(\log p)$ bits, depending only on $p$, with which discrete logarithms in every group of order $p$ are computed in polynomial time from a Diffie-Hellman oracle. items.title: Fast and Strong Image Protection against Diffusion Personalization
items.summary: arXiv:2611.22494v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Personalized text-to-image diffusion models can reproduce a person from a handful of photographs. Image protection perturbs each image before publication so that fine-tuning on it fails, but it optimizes every perturbation from scratch, so its cost grows with the number of images. items.title: IH-Benchmark: A Conflict-Centered Benchmark for Instruction-Hierarchy Robustness in Large Language Models
items.summary: arXiv:2607.25987v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: When a language model receives conflicting instructions from different priority levels, which one does it actually follow? This question lies at the heart of reliable LLM deployment. Existing benchmarks answer this only partially, often focusing on a single hierarchy component or adapting public datasets with limited tool-use coverage. We present IH-Benchmark, a conflict-centered benchmark for instruction-hierarchy robustness across direct System $\succ$ User (S $\succ$ U) conflicts and tool-mediated User $\succ$ Tool (U $\succ$ T) conflicts.…

items.title: The Safeguard Worked. Is the LLM System Safer?
items.summary: arXiv:2609.00519v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Safeguards for large language model services are typically evaluated by their attack-blocking rates on test suites. Deployment decisions also depend on how much harmful assistance attackers can still obtain from the system, which these rates do not measure. To determine what published evaluations establish about deployment safety, we develop a framework that translates reported results into the minimum and maximum harmful assistance that can remain under a specified outcome and threat model. For safeguards that block attacks through a check,…

items.title: Concave is the New Linear: Sybil Attacks Collapse Anti-Plutocratic DAO Voting
items.summary: arXiv:2605.18990v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) run protocol governance by letting token holders vote on proposals. The dominant rule, voting power proportional to wallet balance, concentrates control among a small number of large holders, fueling the token-control governance attacks that have already compromised real protocols. items.title: Can Power Draw Constrain Covert Compute? Limits of Analogue Verification for AI Governance
items.summary: arXiv:2610.07476v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Frontier AI treaties or agreements on limiting computation require external verification; an external auditor must be able to confirm how much computation actually ran and that parties are adhering to the agreement. Analogue, off-chip measurements such as power draw provide an information channel for verification. We derive a closed form for $\beta$, the largest hidden computation a power t…

items.title: Ghostscriptの脆弱性Upload2Shell、画像・PDFの変換処理からサーバー上のコード実行に到達
items.summary: Ghostscriptの脆弱性CVE-2026-125396により、画像やPDFの変換処理からサーバー上のコマンド実行に至る経路がCUPS、Roundcube、WordPressプラグイン等で実証された。根本原因の修正は9月公開済み。

items.title: Microsoft、セキュリティ製品をWindowsカーネルから分離する新基盤を正式提供。8社が順次対応へ
items.summary: 約850万台をブルースクリーンに陥れた2024年のCrowdStrike障害。セキュリティ製品がカーネルで動く構造そのものに、Microsoftが手を入れた。

items.title: GPGMEに重大脆弱性CVE-2026-129975、細工したOpenPGP鍵で二重解放。Gpg4winとDebianが修正済み
items.summary: GnuPGのライブラリGPGMEに重大な脆弱性CVE-2026-129975が確認された。細工した公開鍵を処理させるとメモリの二重解放が起き、アプリケーション内部のデータが外部に流出するリスクがある。メールクライアントやFlatpakなど広範なソフトウェアが影響を受け、修正版GPGME 2.3.1が公開済み。

items.title: ext4で保存成功を返してもデータ消失　Linux 7.0由来の回帰を報告
items.summary: Linuxのファイルシステムext4で、書き込みと同期が成功を返しながらデータの一部を失う回帰が報告された。標準設定でディスクが満杯でない場合にも再現し、後の読み出しで問題が表面化する。

items.title: Debian 13.8公開、GRUB2やIntelマイクロコードなど139件のセキュリティ勧告を安定版に統合
items.summary: Debian Projectが安定版Debian 13「trixie」の8回目のポイントリリースを発表した。ブートローダーGRUB2のSecure Boot回避やCライブラリglibcの複数の脆弱性を含む139件のセキュリティ勧告と、約120パッケージの不具合修正が一つの更新時点にまとまっている。

items.title: FBIの犯罪情報データベースNCICに侵入疑惑、指名手配・犯罪歴を扱う全米共有基盤
items.summary: FBIが運用する全米犯罪情報センター「NCIC」に外部から不正アクセスされた疑いが浮上し、FBIが調査を進めている。指名手配者や犯罪歴、逮捕状の有無を共有する法執行機関の基幹データベースが標的とされた。攻撃者や侵入経路は明らかになっていない。

items.title: GSSのファイル共有サービスに第三者がアクセス、7月末から約3か月半。原因は非公表
items.summary: デジタル庁は11月20日、政府共通の業務環境GSSのファイル共有サービスで、正規の共有先以外の第三者がファイルにアクセスしていたと発表した。7月30日から11月12日にかけて確認され、漏えいの可能性がある。

items.title: Entra Connect Health、109日間のAPI脆弱性で管理者メールやテナント構成が流出
items.summary: MicrosoftのID監視サービス「Entra Connect Health」のAPIに109日間存在した脆弱性を通じて、管理者メールアドレスやテナント構成情報が外部から読み取られていた。修正は完了したが、流出情報を使った標的型フィッシングのリスクが残る。

items.title: OpenRouter、MiniMax経由のAIプロンプト流出の可能性を顧客に通知。200万件の調査で中継先の侵害も判明
items.summary: AIルーターのOpenRouterが、MiniMaxモデルに送ったプロンプトを第三者が読んだ可能性があると顧客に通知した。Dragosの約200万件の追跡実験では3つのAI事業者の侵害と「データ保存なし」設定の無視が確認されている。

items.title: IETF、IoT機器の一斉通信を保護するGroup OSCOREを標準化　12年前の実験仕様を置き換え
items.summary: IETFが、IoT機器がグループ単位で通信するためのRFC 10020と、その通信を暗号化・認証するGroup OSCORE（RFC 10021）を公開した。2014年にセキュリティ不在のまま出された実験仕様が廃止され、12年越しで暗号化と送信元認証を備えた標準が成立した。

items.title: RPKI信頼起点のCRLなし・有効期間100年問題にRFC 10097で統一選択規則
items.summary: RPKIの信頼起点で複数の有効な証明書が併存する場合の統一選択規則がRFC 10097として公開された。失効手段のない信頼起点では有効期間100年の証明書も残り続けていた。

items.title: Atosの認証局19件が一斉失効、RFC違反のフィールド1つが原因
items.summary: フランスのIT企業Atosが運営する認証基盤で、公開鍵証明書の国際標準に違反する記述が見つかった。Atosは対象となる下位認証局19件を11月20日に失効させたと報告している。影響を受けうる有効な証明書は、同社の申告で合計11万7,129件にのぼる。

items.title: クラウドストライク、ゼロトラスト大手Zscalerの買収を協議。合算時価総額は約2650億ドル
items.summary: クラウドストライクがゼロトラスト大手Zscaler（ゼットスケーラー）の買収を協議している。合算時価総額は約2650億ドル。サイバーセキュリティ業界史上最大規模の取引になりうるが、両社は正式にコメントしていない。

items.title: Signal、iOS 27とAndroidでAIによる画面読み取りを遮断。暗号化の「外側」を守る闘い
items.summary: SignalがiOS 27とAndroidでスクリーンショットを標準で無効にし、OSに組み込まれたAIエージェントによる画面読み取りを遮断する。対策は「不完全」とSignal自身が認めており、OS提供者に開発者向けオプトアウト手段を要求している。

items.title: 三井住友銀行で最大1400万件の情報漏えい、委託先KARTEの侵害は数百社に波及
items.summary: 三井住友銀行は11月20日、委託先プレイドのKARTE（カルテ）への不正アクセスで顧客情報が最大約1400万件漏えいしたと発表した。氏名や口座番号は含まれない。影響はKARTEを導入していた数百社に及んでいる。

items.title: Synologyの重大脆弱性CVE-2026-120382、サポート終了のDSM 6.2も影響対象。公式修正一覧から旧版が欠落
items.summary: SynologyのCVSS 9.8脆弱性SA-26:21は技術説明でDSM 6.2を影響対象に含めているが、修正一覧にDSM 6.2の行はなく、更新履歴にも修正版がない。DSM 7へ更新できない旧型NASの対応経路が見えていない。

items.title: Windows 11のロック画面を回避する「FastUnlock」、BitLocker有効環境でも影響。セキュリティ企業が確認
items.summary: Windows 11のロック画面から認証を完了せずにプログラムを実行できるゼロデイ脆弱性「FastUnlock」が公開された。BitLockerで暗号化した環境でも影響が及ぶ。エンドポイントセキュリティ企業のThreatLockerが独自に手法を検証し、再現を確認している。

items.title: DebianのAPT、旧リポジトリ形式3種を廃止へ。AIセキュリティ研究の進展で互換性より安全を優先
items.summary: APTのメンテナーが、旧リポジトリ形式3種の削除を発表した。最近のAPT脆弱性とAIセキュリティ研究の進展を受け、旧形式を維持する複雑さのリスクが互換性の利益を上回ったと判断。11月23日の週からunstableで削除作業を始める予定。

items.title: NVIDIA、ランサムウェア主張を調査中。6週間前には部品供給元も掲載されていた
items.summary: ランサムウェアグループThe Gentlemenが11月18日にNVIDIAをリークサイトに掲載した。盗んだデータの証拠は一切示されていない。NVIDIAはサードパーティパートナーへの影響を調査中で、自社システムへの侵入は否定している。同グループは6週前にNVIDIAの部品供給元も掲載しており、掲載の出どころがNVIDIA自体かサプライチェーンかは現時点で判別できない。

items.title: 英国裁判所、政府がAppleに暗号化データへのアクセスを命じた事実の公開を認める
items.summary: 英国の調査権限審判所が現地時間11月19日、政府がAppleに暗号化データへのアクセスを命じた事実を公にしても国家安全保障は損なわれないとする判決を下した。命令の適法性は2027年の本格審理に持ち越されている。

items.title: 湘南美容クリニック162万人の個人情報が流出、パスワードは暗号化されずに保存されていた
items.summary: 湘南美容クリニックなどを展開するSBCメディカルグループは11月19日、データベースへの不正アクセスで162万4000人分の個人情報が取得されたと公表した。パスワードは暗号化されずに保存されていた。外部予約サービス「トリビュー」でも56院分の予約情報が不正に閲覧された。

items.title: ASUS Control Center Express、暗号鍵のハードコードでCVSS 10.0。認証なしで管理者権限を奪われる
items.summary: ASUS Control Center Expressに暗号鍵のハードコード脆弱性。CVSS v4.0で最高値の10.0。認証なしで管理者権限を奪われ、管理下の全PCに影響が及ぶ。修正版v1.7.29への即時更新が必要になる。

items.title: Visa・Mastercard・JPMorganの顧客データ、ランサムウェアグループが公開。外部委託先が侵入経路
items.summary: ランサムウェアグループn0nが、Visa・Mastercard・JPMorgan Chaseの顧客データを公開した。カード番号の流出は確認されていない。攻撃されたのは3社の決済システムではなく、マーケティングを担う外部委託先だった。

items.title: Google、Androidアプリの開発者確認を2027年1月から全世界へ拡大。ストア外配布にも適用
items.summary: Googleが2027年1月からAndroidの開発者確認制度を全世界に広げる。Google Playだけでなく、独立系ストアやWeb経由の配布にもGoogleへの身元確認とアプリ登録が必要になる。

items.title: PHPセキュリティ更新で18件修正。FPMの接続再利用が遠隔コード実行の経路に
items.summary: PHPの全サポートブランチに18件のCVEを修正するセキュリティ更新が公開された。最も深刻なPHP-FPMの脆弱性はCVSS 9.2だが、PHP公式は非既定構成でのみ成立するとしている。

items.title: Gemini 4 Neon、Carbonの3倍速で即日提供。AA総合61点で3位
items.summary: Gemini 4ファミリーの3番目のモデルNeonが米国時間11月18日に発表され、APIとGeminiアプリで即日展開が始まった。Carbonから派生しつつ3倍速・コスト40%削減を掲げ、独立評価のAA Intelligence Indexで61点・総合3位を記録している。

items.title: NGINXに認証不要のリモートコード実行、HTTP/2の欠陥は11年前から潜伏
items.summary: NGINXのHTTP/2処理に、認証なしでリモートからコードを実行できるメモリ安全性の脆弱性が2件見つかった。片方は2015年のバージョン1.9.5から存在していた。修正版はオープンソースの1.31.9と1.30.7。

items.title: Butterbian 0.6.0
items.summary: Butterbian is a Debian-based Linux distribution with out-of-the-box support for the Btrfs filesystem and pre-configured Timeshift, an application that takes incremental snapshots of the installed filesystem at regular intervals. These snapshots can be restored, directly from the GRUB menu, to undo all changes to the system. Butterbian boots into a themed Xfce desktop and uses the Calamares system installer. items.title: Genuen 6.1.1
items.summary: Genuen is a spin of Devuan GNU+Linux consisting exclusively of Free Software (as defined by the Free Software Foundation) and a choice of several alternative init systems, such as OpenRC, Runit, s6 and SysV. The distribution ships with the GNU Linux-libre kernel. The project provides installation images for desktop and server deployments, as well as pre-configured live images with JWM, KDE Plasma, Openbox and Xfce desktops available for the i686 and x86_64 architectures.

items.title: MagOS 2025_20261121
items.summary: MagOS Linux is a Russian desktop-oriented distribution based on ROSA, a distribution that was forked from Mandriva Linux in 2011. It uses the RPM package management. items.title: HardenedBSD 15-build-24
items.summary: Founded in 2014 by Oliver Pinter and Shawn Webb, HardenedBSD is a security-enhanced fork of FreeBSD. The HardenedBSD Project is implementing many exploit mitigation and security technologies on top of FreeBSD. The project started with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) as an initial focal point and is now implementing further exploit mitigation techniques.

items.title: Oracle 10.3
items.summary: Oracle Linux is an enterprise-class Linux distribution supported by Oracle and built from source packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL). Some of the special features of Oracle Linux include a custom-build and rigorously-tested Linux kernel called "Oracle Unbreakable Kernel", tight integration with Oracle's hardware and software products including most database applications, and "zero downtime patching" - a feature that enables administrators to update the kernel without a reboot.

items.title: LibreELEC 13.0-beta1
items.summary: LibreELEC is "just enough OS" to run the Kodi media centre. LibreELEC is a Linux distribution built to run Kodi on current and popular hardware. The project is an evolution of the OpenELEC project. LibreELEC software will be familiar to OpenELEC users. The distribution runs on x86 desktop computers, Raspberry Pi devices and ODroid and WeTek computers.

items.title: kumaOS 45.7.0
items.summary: kumaOS is a minimalist and immutable Fedora-based Linux distribution featuring the niri Wayland compositor and a custom-built shell called "kumaUI". The shell provides a complete desktop user interface with a top bar, an application launcher, drawer panels, a lock screen, a file manager, a terminal and a system monitor. Like most immutable distributions, kumaOS also include atomic updates and rollbacks to a previous state.

items.title: Armbian 26.11.2
items.summary: Armbian is a Linux distribution designed for ARM development boards. items.summary: MakuluLinux is a rolling-release, desktop distribution based either on Ubuntu's LTS (long-term support) release or Debian's "Testing" branch. items.title: auryn-docker 0.8.2
items.summary: Dockerfile plugin for Auryn and the first producer of the deployment & infrastructure tier (ADR 0007). A dependency-free Dockerfile parser emits BuildStage nodes, the shared image-keyed `Image` hub (the FROM chain, as resolved:false placeholders) and multi-stage COPY --from edges; a `deploy` enrichment links build stages to the code they package (PACKAGES), recomputes image `resolved` and GCs orphan images. Compose/k8s/Helm/Terraform producers join onto the hub. Depends only on auryn-core.

items.title: auryn-cuda 0.8.2
items.summary: CUDA language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-cuda engine. CUDA is a superset of C++, so it reuses the auryn-cpp extraction engine verbatim (namespaces/classes/structs/enums/methods/fields/params, type hierarchy, templates, includes/macros, calls) and adds the CUDA-only graph signals: an `execution_space` property (`__global__`/`__device__`/`__host__`) and a LAUNCHES edge for `kernel >>` launches. A deep libclang/nvcc pass is the planned second phase.

items.title: auryn-csharp 0.8.2
items.summary: C# language plugin for Auryn: fast tree-sitter parse + deep Roslyn extractor (bundled source, built on demand; requires the .NET SDK).

items.title: auryn-cpp 0.8.2
items.summary: C++ language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-cpp engine extracting namespaces/classes/structs/unions/enums (incl. `enum class`)/methods/fields/params/free functions, the class hierarchy (EXTENDS, multiple inheritance), templates, #includes/macros, and calls -- including out-of-line `Class::method` definitions resolved back to their class. A deep libclang engine (template instantiation, overload resolution, ADL, precise header linking) is the planned second phase.

items.title: auryn-core 0.8.2
items.summary: Core of Auryn: registry/plugin discovery, git+local sources, the FalkorDB graph layer, the MCP server, the viewer, and the `auryn` CLI. Language support ships as separate `auryn-` plugins.

items.title: auryn-compose 0.8.2
items.summary: Docker Compose plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Parses docker-compose files into Service nodes (RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub, DEPENDS_ON other services). A `deploy-compose` enrichment links each service that has both `build:` and `image:` to the Dockerfile stage it builds (`build.target`, else the final stage) with BUILDS_IMAGE, marking the image resolved/internal; the stages come from auryn-docker, so install both. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.

items.title: Recovering from Indirect Branch Obfuscation with Hex-Rays Microcode
items.summary: This article uses samples obfuscated with the Hikari-LLVM19 framework to present a recovery method for AArch64 indirect branch obfuscation. The method is not intended to handle all indirect branches. Different obfuscators may compute target addresses in entirely different ways, so the target resolver still needs to match the specific obfuscation semantics. However, once one or two successors can be reliably identified, the subsequent CFG completion, function range expansion, and microcode rewriting steps can be reused directly.
